548348141.text: Data lake Relational Engine now supports post-quantum-ready hybrid key establishment (ML-KEM) during TLS 1.3 handshakes.
548348141.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) in TLS Connections

548348142.text:
SAP HANA data lake – including both the data lake Files and data lake Relational engine components – is now available through SAP BDC. SAP BDC users can provision data lake instances using SAP for Me. See [Provisioning SAP HANA Cloud, data lake](https://help.sap.com/docs/business-data-cloud/administering-sap-business-data-cloud-dev/provisioning-sap-hana-cloud-9949e90448bd45eba3c1502f66aabc71) in the SAP BDC documentation.
Not all data lake features available in BTP-provisioned instances are available in this release of data lake for SAP BDC. For details see SAP Note [3737180 - SAP HANA Cloud in SAP Business Data Cloud](https://me.sap.com/notes/3737180).
548348142.title: Provision data lake instances in SAP Business Data Cloud (SAP BDC)

548348143.text: The USE_DEPRECATED_OBJECT_QUALIFICATION database option prevents qualifiers from being added when a statement is known to be within the body of a procedure, trigger, or event. See [USE_DEPRECATED_OBJECT_QUALIFICATION Option for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/3f76cb97718849f7beba6e8deb7fb295.html)
548348143.title: USE_DEPRECATED_OBJECT_QUALIFICATION Option

- [CREATE PSE Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/cda6e32786854f6c9f9cc1869c6ddca1.html)

- [SYSPSE System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/e009d26b16a9460b9bb87f92c844c334.html)

- [SYSPUBLICKEY System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/f08f3ff5b3ab4262bb03e7130eee4d8c.html)

548348145.text:
HTML query plans now write to a dedicated subfolder in the diagnostic logs directory in the data lake Files container: /diag/logs/queryplans. The filename now includes USER_ID for increased readability and easier searching.
This new directory structure makes it easier to find your query plans and work with them.
See [Diagnostic Logs for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/02e694dff4c44c0db8e1b3783d599d6b.html).
548348145.title: New directory for query plans

548348146.text: Stored procedures sp_list_query_plans and sp_delete_query_plan now let you manage query plans. See [sp_list_query_plans Stored Procedure](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/04f6083dd66b4dcea2c7c39d83a08aa9.html), [sp_delete_query_plan Stored Procedure](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/d6077d7f5d074746a598967f9f73af4f.html).
548348146.title: List and delete query plans

548348147.text:
The data lake Relational Engine LOAD TABLE statement syntax was extended to let you load data from Delta Tables stored on public Delta Shares. See:
- [LOAD Statement (Non-Parquet Formats)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/7ca3f60902f3473296cb309533d89210.html)
- [Load Data from Delta Shares in Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/eb0b17f0ee294961a8982aed1afbbb5b.html)
- [LOAD Statement (Non-Parquet Formats) for Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HANA DB-Managed)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a898e08b84f21015969fa437e89860c8/97f011fc1d834d8ea920911caa9638f2.html)
- [Load Data From Delta Shares in Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HANA DB-Managed)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/9220e7fec0fe4503b5c5a6e21d584e63/7c0bc902b11c4688895d3cddcbddeb08.html)
548348147.title: Load from Delta Shares

548348148.text:
You can now decouple a data lake Relational Engine thin clone from its parent instance.
See [Decouple a Thin Clone](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/3075eb5fd5b4416eadf50c02a1055b7b.html).
548348148.title: Decouple thin clone

548348149.text:
The DECLARE EXISTING LOCAL TEMPORARY TABLE statement now supports the EXISTING parameter.
See [DECLARE LOCAL TEMPORARY TABLE Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/a61b247c84f2101584efe462c353b5a0.html).
548348149.title: DECLARE EXISTING LOCAL TEMPORARY TABLE Statement

548348150.text:
You can now configure X.509 authentication using a PSE.For more information, see:
- [CREATE PSE Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/cda6e32786854f6c9f9cc1869c6ddca1.html)

- [SET PSE Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/8dcd61c0c5534b228e1bb9b64d67ca18.html)
- [UNSET PSE Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/6ca4d1e358eb41d88f7940687ef6521a.html)

548348150.title: Configure X.509 authentication using PSEs

548348151.text:
You can now include all non-default setting server command line options to the root node in HTML query plans.
See [QUERY_PLAN_COMMAND_LINE Option](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/582b121ae0c646639c8a89612a27364a.html).
548348151.title: QUERY_PLAN_COMMAND_LINE Option

548348152.text: The scripts and guide for migrating your SAP IQ applications to data lake Relational Engine have been updated to streamline the process.See the [SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Migration Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/f70c0f7e072d4f969d3c8b4bc95b4214/84795c5dc3ea41f0982016e57bf2d23f.html) for more information.
548348152.title: Updated migration scripts

548348153.text:
Defining a column definition are now optional when creating an existing local temporary table.
See [CREATE EXISTING TABLE Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/sql-reference-for-data-lake-relational-engine/create-existing-table-statement-for-data-lake-relational-engine).
548348153.title: CREATE EXISTING TABLE Statement

548348154.text:
Database options QUERY_PLAN_VIEW_DEFINITION and QUERY_PLAN_VIEW_DEFINITION_MAX_SIZE have been introduced to display view definitions in query plans.
See [QUERY_PLAN_VIEW_DEFINITION Option for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/sql-reference-for-data-lake-relational-engine/query-plan-view-definition) and [QUERY_PLAN_VIEW_DEFINITION_MAX_SIZE Option for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/sql-reference-for-data-lake-relational-engine/query-plan-view-definition-max-size).
548348154.title: New database options: QUERY_PLAN_VIEW_DEFINITION and QUERY_PLAN_VIEW_DEFINITION_MAX_SIZE

548348155.text:
Users that don't have a full license can now install a developer-license version of the SAP HANA Data Lake Client for Windows.
The developer-license version does not contain cryptographic libraries and is available for download from [SAP Development Tools](https://tools.hana.ondemand.com/#hanatools). The installation allows you to perform development on the client without a full license.
For more information, see [Download the SAP HANA Data Lake Client](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a895964984f210158925ce02750eb580/2fdb23a4fb364e06ace0eea0c9a4afec.html) and [Install the SAP HANA Data Lake Client (Developer License)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/client-interfaces/install-sap-hana-data-lake-client-developer-license).
548348155.title: New developer-license version of the SAP HANA Data Lake Client for Windows

548348156.text:
With the Cloud Connector option enabled, you can now create and query virtual tables to connect data lake Relational Engine to on-premise SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise.
See:
- [CREATE SERVER Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/a619187d84f210158b3081e7245e94a0.html)

- [CREATE EXISTING TABLE Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/a617378084f21015ab5f9b1b9cfa3620.html)
548348156.title: Use virtual tales to connect to on-premise SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise

548348157.text:
You can now specify a service endpoint for Google Cloud Storage using the new ENDPOINT and REGION options.
See:
- [LOAD Statement (Non-Parquet Formats) for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/7ca3f60902f3473296cb309533d89210.html)
- [LOAD Statement (Non-Parquet Formats) for Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HANA DB-Managed)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a898e08b84f21015969fa437e89860c8/97f011fc1d834d8ea920911caa9638f2.html)
- [LOAD Statement (Parquet Format) for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/e048737551b84b2a8b66258adab4a9b3.html)
- [LOAD Statement (Parquet Format) for Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HANA DB-Managed)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a898e08b84f21015969fa437e89860c8/8af588ab4ee44abc971b466b6d857385.html)

- [UNLOAD Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HANA DB-Managed)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a898e08b84f21015969fa437e89860c8/5049a399ee2241dda78d47a0a3cc46e9.html)

- [BACKUP TABLE Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HANA DB-Managed)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a898e08b84f21015969fa437e89860c8/825d3abe4fad45fa82d7619871808c6a.html)
- [RESTORE TABLE Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/a407d9655299472ba67454d6ed26a19b.html)

- [Load Data from Google Cloud Storage in Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/a723d42f6c3d4d5ab9f2a1424130d10c.htm)
548348157.title: Specify service endpoint for Google Cloud Storage

548348158.text: The guides SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Administration Guide for Data Lake Relational Engine and SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Administration Guide for Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HASNA DB-Managead) now contains the content formerly found in SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Relational Engine Load and Unload Management. The latter guide no longer exists.
548348158.title: <cite class="cite">SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Relational Engine Load and Unload Management</cite> content has moved.

548348159.text:
You can now recover the backup of a data lake Relational Engine database using the Actions menu in SAP HANA Cloud Central. A service request is no longer required.
See [Managing Data Lake Instances Using SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/5a52eb9439dc4f758e46f79ed22eae23.html).
548348159.title: Self-service recovery of data lake Relational Engine

548348160.text:
You can now use Cloud Connector to securely connect to on-premise SAP Adaptive Server and insert data into data lake Relational Engine using the INSERT...LOCATION statement.
See:
- [Data Lake Relational Engine Cloud Connector](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/d574628e30c54d53bd4853077ec49f83.html)
- [Data Lake Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/0c18e4cf615e46c895167611fb64715d.html)
- [Create an SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Instance Using the CLI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/17855748b921413bafe0640c974ed191.html)
- [Creating a Connectivity Service Instance](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/8bf04c66d68b4e199879fc1069cfa9a2.html)
- [CREATE SERVER Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/a619187d84f210158b3081e7245e94a0.html)
- [INSERT Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/a61fdeff84f21015aa66b9add387d7f9.html)
- [Troubleshooting Connection Issues with Cloud Connector](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/a58901e9ab034f96ad280ad13bc0ecc1.html)
548348160.title: Insert data from on-premise SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise into data lake Relational Engine using the INSERT...LOCATION statement

548348161.text: Data lake Relational Engine lets you clone an instance for testing and debugging purposes. See [Thin Clone](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/administration-guide-for-data-lake-relational-engine/thin-clone).
548348161.title: Thin Clone

548348162.text:
The functions sp_get_index_definition, sp_get_table_definition, and sp_get_view_definition let you perform a schema unload.
See [sp_get_index_definition Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/sql-reference-for-data-lake-relational-engine/sp-get-index-definition-for-data-lake-relational-engine), [sp_get_table_definition](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/sql-reference-for-data-lake-relational-engine/sp-get-table-definition-for-data-lake-relational-engine), [sp_get_views_definition](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/sql-reference-for-data-lake-relational-engine/sp-get-views-definition-for-data-lake-relational-engine).
548348162.title: Single Object Schema Unload

548348163.text:
The new policies/v1 API endpoint offers increased granularity of data lake Files access policies.
See [Access Policies for Data Lake Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/user-guide-for-data-lake-files/new-access-policies).
548348163.title: New access policies API endpoint for data lake Files

548348164.text:
You can now use Cloud Connector to securely connect to on-premise SAP Adaptive Server using SAP Replication Server.
See:
- [Data Lake Relational Engine Cloud Connector](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/d574628e30c54d53bd4853077ec49f83.html)
- [Data Lake Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/0c18e4cf615e46c895167611fb64715d.html)
- [Create an SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Instance Using the CLI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/17855748b921413bafe0640c974ed191.html)
- [Creating a Connectivity Service Instance](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/8bf04c66d68b4e199879fc1069cfa9a2.html)
- [CREATE SERVER Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/a619187d84f210158b3081e7245e94a0.html)
- [Create an SAP Replication Server On-Premise Remote Server](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/aaff5bf3022b4f44b39f20276a58f402.html)

- [Troubleshooting Connection Issues with Cloud Connector](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/a58901e9ab034f96ad280ad13bc0ecc1.html)
548348164.title: Replicate data from on-premise SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise into data lake Relational Engine using SAP Replication Server

548348165.text:
Data lake Relational Engine SQL on Files is now incompatible with SAP HANA Cloud. Use SAP HANA database native SQL on Files to query data in data lake Files from an SAP HANA database instance.
See:
- [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database SQL on Files Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/8f2295c581d9437894c44e7aebce3198/3ac0672894ae4356b64a32ef6a4deea9.html)
548348165.title: Data lake SQL on Files incompatible change

548348166.text: The JWT identity provider now maps application user claim to XS_APPLICATIONUSER in incoming JWT tokens.
548348166.title: XS_APPLICATION <samp class="ph codeph">USER</samp> Connection Property

548348167.text:
Database restore times are significantly faster.
See [Backup and Recovery of Data in Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/backup-restore-and-data-recovery/backup-and-recovery-of-data-in-data-lake-relational-engine).
548348167.title: Faster restore times for data lake Relational Engine databases

548348168.text:
Users that don't have a full license can now install a developer-license version of the SAP HANA Data Lake Client for Linux. A Windows installation package is not yet available.
The developer-license version does not contain cryptographic libraries and is available for download from [SAP Development Tools](https://tools.hana.ondemand.com/#hanatools). The installation allows you to perform development on the client without a full license.
For more information, see [Download the SAP HANA Data Lake Client](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a895964984f210158925ce02750eb580/2fdb23a4fb364e06ace0eea0c9a4afec.html) and [Install the SAP HANA Data Lake Client (Developer License)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/client-interfaces/install-sap-hana-data-lake-client-developer-license).
548348168.title: New developer-license version of the SAP HANA Data Lake Client for Linux

548348169.text: You can now access a particular worker through the SQL endpoint of your data lake instance. See [Connect Directly to Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/administration-guide-for-data-lake-relational-engine/connect-directly-to-data-lake-relational-engine) for more information.
548348169.title: Access a particular worker at a SQL endpoint

548348170.text:
The [SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake) product page was redesigned and simplified.The page is now divided into these sections:
- What's New
- Getting Started
- Clients
- Security
- Data Lake Files
- Data Lake Relational Engine (Standalone Implementation)
- Data Lake Relational Engine (Integrated with SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database)
548348170.title: Redesigned data lake product page on SAP Help Portal

548348171.text:
The golang driver now supports setting a timeout for sql.DB.PingContext() calls.
For more information, see [Set a Timeout for sql.DB.PingContext() Calls](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a895964984f210158925ce02750eb580/efd12f4d09de4893b24fdb098eeb4552.html).
548348171.title: Set a timeout for sql.DB.PingContext() calls

548348172.text: The guide SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Administration Guide for Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HANA DB-Managed) now contains the content formerly found in SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Relational Engine Column Indexing Reference Guide (SAP HANA DB-Managed). The latter guide no longer exists.
548348172.title: <cite class="cite">SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Relational Engine Column Indexing Reference Guide (SAP HANA DB-Managed)</cite> content has moved

548348173.text:
Data lake Relational Engine now supports designating a JWT claim as the XS_APPLICATIONUSER.
See:
- [CREATE JWT PROVIDER Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/49b7ee108b7b40f880f936b940e2b037.html)
- [ALTER JWT PROVIDER Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/f6b0a31d00884412a259cea30ee39b8f.html)
- [List of Connection Properties](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/3bc695906c5f10148aaabe9d8f52d0e5.html)
- [XS_APPLICATIONUSER Option](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/fcba0d914cfd47f4b55d56f3af3308fd.html)
- [JSON Web Token User Authentication](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a89a0a8384f21015b1e7adbeca456f73/90d07ffd877e4b3db69b66c2e585e2e0.html)
- [Auditing Specific Types of Events](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a89a0a8384f21015b1e7adbeca456f73/640c1c98e6414e03a179b9f1e8fb7bfb.html)
548348173.title: XS_APPLICATION <samp class="ph codeph">USER</samp>

548348174.text:
The golang driver supports setting a socket communication timeout for the following calls:
- sql.DB.QueryContext()
- sql.DB.ExecContext()
- sql.Conn.QueryContext()
- sql.Conn.ExecContext()
- sql.Tx.QueryContext()
- sql.Stmt.QueryContext()
- sql.Stmt.ExecContext()
- sql.Conn.ExecContext()
- sql.Conn.QueryContext()
For more information, see [Setting Network Communication Timeouts for Queries and Executions](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a895964984f210158925ce02750eb580/232c6d34a5c34145a337b3532d95b2e2.html).
548348174.title: Set network communication timeouts for queries and executions

548348175.text:
The golang driver now supports setting a packet size for the following calls:
- sql.DB.PrepareContext()
- sql.Conn.PrepareContext()
- sql.Tx.PrepareContext()
For more information, see [Setting a Packet Size for Queries and Executions](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a895964984f210158925ce02750eb580/5b907f9b967e49f2890412b18b8fce1b.html).
548348175.title: Set a packet size for queries and execution

548348176.text: The ENC TLS connection parameter now lets you specify trusted certificates from both the system certificate store and from PSE (Certificate collection). See [Encryption (ENC) Connection Parameter](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a895964984f210158925ce02750eb580/81408d9a6ce2101493b9c3bd4a39e77e.html) for more information.
548348176.title: ENC TLS trusted_certificate connection parameter

548348177.text: User Management topics are now documented in the [SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Security for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/security-for-data-lake-relational-engine/sap-hana-cloud-data-lake-security-for-data-lake-relational-engine.html).
548348177.title: Security guide for data lake Relational Engine

548348178.text:
You can now use Cloud Connector to securely connect to on-premise SAP HANA or SAP IQ databases.
See:
- [Data Lake Relational Engine Cloud Connector](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/d574628e30c54d53bd4853077ec49f83.html)
- [Data Lake Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/0c18e4cf615e46c895167611fb64715d.html)
- [Create an SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Instance Using the CLI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/17855748b921413bafe0640c974ed191.html)
- [Creating a Connectivity Service Instance](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/8bf04c66d68b4e199879fc1069cfa9a2.html)
- [CREATE SERVER Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/a619187d84f210158b3081e7245e94a0.html)
- [Create an SAP HANA On-Premise Remote Server](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/494a8b264b8e4dfa8fc9b095324191b3.html)
- [Create an SAP IQ On-Premise Remote Server](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/7fa7b84a61bd4312a55f7a68be8dd4a9.html)
- [Troubleshooting Connection Issues with Cloud Connector](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/a58901e9ab034f96ad280ad13bc0ecc1.html)
548348178.title: Connect to on-premise SAP HANA or SAP IQ databases

548348179.text:
The golang driver supports getting more detailed error objects from all SQL package API functions that can return an error.
See [Return Vendor-Specific Errors from SQL Package API Calls](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a895964984f210158925ce02750eb580/259ece7b8550469e959e16d5e718438d.html).
548348179.title: Return Vendor-Specific Errors from SQL Package API Calls

548348180.text: Security topics for data lake Files are now documented in the [SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Files Security Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/fe412ebedacd454684dcf64bd6cd24bd/dff203d127444abf99000bfd6915b17d.html).
548348180.title: Security guide for data lake Files

548348181.text: The SAP Alert Notification service now provides an alert when a possible conflict between the SAP HANA database and date lake Relational Engine TIMESTAMP data type is detected. Also, data lake Relational Engine now prevents the loading of 7-digits of precision TIMESTAMP values into a 6-digits column during an INSERT, UPDATE, or CAST.
548348181.title: Alert notifications for potential <samp class="ph codeph">TIMESTAMP</samp> data type conflicts

548348182.text:
Concise auditing streamlines and simplifies data lake Relational Engine auditing. This is a breaking change in auditing behavior. You can either set the new CONCISE_AUDITING database option to 'Off' before you upgrade to QRC 1/2024 (with no disruption to auditing) or do nothing and let data lake switch to new concise auditing behavior during the QRC 1/2024 upgrade.
See:
- [SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Auditing Migration Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/86c0211675e14d6389471ba4f4f2c83e/38778500666d4887af5190d6bf233d63.html)
- [CONCISE_AUDITING Option for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/742c50f6746f4fb488ed6498e203def4.html)
- [CONCISE_AUDITING Option for Data Lake Relational Engine (SAP HANA DB-Managed)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a898e08b84f21015969fa437e89860c8/e47cf784a3274b41bbaaa416bcc07d97.html)
548348182.title: Concise auditing

592077114.text:
SAP HANA Cloud now tracks SAP-RPT-TS tabular foundation model consumption as data points, a new usage-based billing unit. Data points are visible in the Consumption Monitor alongside memory, compute, storage, and network data transfer.
See [Consumption Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/consumption-monitor).
592077114.title: Data Points Metric in the Consumption Monitor

592077115.text:
Access the Open in Database Objects browser directly from the schema or HDI container page and establish a connection using the latest credential.
See: [Managing SAP HANA Cloud Database Tenants](3ce1a923e4284486987d9b93e140471d.html)
592077115.title: Database objects browser

592077116.text:
The memory consumption can be displayed including dropped tenants (Total Memory Consumption) and excluding dropped tenants (Memory Consumption).
See: [Managing SAP HANA Cloud Database Tenants](3ce1a923e4284486987d9b93e140471d.html)
592077116.title: Aggregated resource usage

592077117.text:
You can now partition tables using two new three-level heterogeneous schemes: HASH-RANGE-RANGE and HASH-HASH-RANGE.
See [Three-Level HASH-RANGE-RANGE and HASH-HASH-RANGE Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/1904e0a4edbf465c9b131ae53cf25972.html).
592077117.title: Three-Level HASH-RANGE-RANGE and HASH-HASH-RANGE Partitioning

592077118.text: The SDI Statistics Monitor has been enhanced with additional statistics, including shadow table record counts and INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE counts, for improved SDI monitoring.
592077118.title: Additional Statistics Available in the SDI Statistics Monitor

592077119.text: Function and Procedure detail view now contains an additional tab called SQL Script Analysis. In this tab, you can select Analyze SQL Script to run the analysis and populate a table of issues.
592077119.title: SQL Script Analyzer in Database Objects

592077120.text: Before provisioning an SAP HANA database instance with a memory size of 12 TB on Azure, you must complete an additional step to pre-reserve the required hardware needed for your instance. Once the pre-reservation process is complete, you can proceed with provisioning the instance. For more information, see SAP Note [3717342](https://me.sap.com/notes/3717342).
592077120.title: Request capacity for 12TB instance on Azure

592077121.text:
The Alerts app now supports Data Access Agent instances. You can view alerts for your Data Access Agent instances and enable or disable alert rules for these instances. Data Access Agent instances appear in the instance filter grouped under the HANA database instance they're associated with.
See [Using Alerts in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/b8cc733919ff40eb8725ef47316c840b.html).
592077121.title: Data Access Agent alerts

592077122.text: When provisioning an SAP HANA database instance, you can now enable a dedicated domain name and DigiCert certificate for the instance.
592077122.title: Enable instance-specific DNS

592077123.text: The cookie consent banner has been removed. Usage data is now collected by default. You can opt out of cookie collection in the Settings dialog. The Functional Cookies toggle is in the Cookies tab.
592077123.title: Cookie Consent Banner Removal

592077124.text:
SAP HANA Cloud Central now lets you limit selected data definition actions to specific schemas, or audit data manipulation actions on an object across all schemas by omitting the schema during object selection. A policy must target either specific schemas or all schemas, but not both.
See:
- [Audit Policies](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/db4b4fb4bb571014a22b8f893c94aeef.html)
- [Auditing Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c6c1dbc66caa41499f173220503aec94.html)
592077124.title: Enhanced Audit Policy Features

592077125.text:
SAP HANA Cloud Central now lets you configure multiple issuer DNs for a single X.509 provider. When creating or editing a provider, you can add or remove issuers using a certificate file, PEM string, or a certificate from the store. The issuer DN is extracted automatically.
See:
- [Add an X.509 Identity Provider](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/35f103e2f81f46ef8409d6125f6dd2e9.html)
- [Identity Providers Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/e4e1a97b76fb4ad6b00031dfdc06cafc.html)
- [X.509 Certificate-Based User Authentication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/2b335f7eec6a450095f110ea961d77cc.html)
592077125.title: Multiple Issuer DNs for X.509 Providers

592077126.text:
SAP HANA Cloud Central now supports importing data from RDF files and exporting RDF knowledge graph catalog objects to RDF files. RDF is available as a data type in the create import and export wizards, with support for SAP Data Lake Files, Azure Storage, Amazon S3, and Google Cloud Storage.
See:
- [Using Import and Export in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/de125916128447f98cde25f14c2e59d2.html)
- [Importing Data in HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/c9ca5258054e49a48f111808ceb96d2b.html)
- [Exporting Data in HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/42e2d2997424491aa23bdeb52b311277.html)
592077126.title: Import and Export RDF Files

592077127.text:
You can now view, add, enable, disable, and remove SQL statement hints in the SQL Statements app.
See:
- [Monitoring SQL Statements in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/4d5dca0665f54dc9aed8d0c53171bbd4.html)
- [Manage Statement Hints](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/67265f42f0ce4d1c971680983c1fa33f.html)
592077127.title: Manage Statement Hints

592077128.text: In SAP HANA Cloud Central, you can now move tenants to instances in other BTP subaccounts within the same region. The Target Database Instance field in the Move Tenant dialog lists both instances in the current subaccount and instances from other subaccounts that have been shared with the current subaccount via an instance mapping.
592077128.title: Move Database Tenants Across Subaccounts

592077129.text:
You can now select which recommendation types (CREATE, DROP, or ALTER) the Index Advisor generates, and set a row count threshold to limit the analysis to tables of a relevant size.
See [About the Index Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/about-index-advisor).
592077129.title: Index Advisor New Recommendation Types and Thresholds

592077131.text:
The Elastic Compute Node application now includes a History tab. Use it to review the provisioning and deprovisioning activity for all ECNs on your instance, including the ECN policy, resource allocation, and outcome of each operation.
See [Monitor ECN Usage](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/monitor-ecn-usage).
592077131.title: View ECN provisioning history

592077132.text:
In the Schemas & HDI Containers app, you can now:
- View HDI containers managed using SAP Service Manager instances in your Cloud Foundry spaces separately.
- Open a service managed HDI container directly in the SQL console.
See [Using Schemas & HDI Containers in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/caf464055fc9424c98257d57c93a0d08).
592077132.title: View service managed HDI containers

592077133.text:
The Performance Heatmap and Statement Trend Chart tabs in the SQL Statement Overview are now combined into a single Trends tab, so you can view heatmap charts and statement trends without switching between tabs.
See:
- [Monitor and Manage Active SQL Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/09bbf686d8974ff58b82ecc5d7e5ccc5.html)
- [Monitor and Manage Cached SQL Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/544449d376634e81b27b6e958498e0df.html)
- [Trace and Manage Expensive SQL Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/e6dcc3023ef449d9a10a042e54bc01bc.html)
592077133.title: Consolidated Trends View in the SQL Statements App

592077134.text:
The Snapshot Restore menu entry is available for stopped instances. The instance will be started as part of the restore operation.
See, [SAP HANA Database Instance Snapshots](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/d7fb197fa2d54b98b5c73cd10db16609.html)
592077134.title: Snapshot Restore from a stopped instance

592077135.text: You can now see a preview of image files in SQL Console.
592077135.title: Preview image files in SQL Console

592077136.text: On Azure and Amazon Web Services, you can now configure private link for the SAP HANA Cloud APIs using the API Gateway endpoint service ID. See [SAP HANA Cloud Private Link](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/3bf51e391ea34461be86406d468ac0ca.html).
592077136.title: Private link for administration APIs on Azure and Amazon Web Services

592077137.text:
You can now view alert information directly on the charts of the Performance Monitor.
See:
- [Using the Performance Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/f2b10bdd546542c9890f00aace7e247b.html)
- [Add and Remove Charts in the Performance Monitor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/074667cbe57941dcb63c2cfda9963c9a.html)
592077137.title: View alerts in Performance Monitor charts

592077138.text:
Explore your data with natural language You can now create Data Exploration Tools in SAP HANA Cloud Central to query your data with natural language. Each tool pair exposes the AI_OBJECT_RETRIEVAL and AI_DATA_RETRIEVAL procedures, which identify the relevant database objects or return the data itself.
See [About Data Exploration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/5001836ae7f74e689eb569b15cd3fb37.html).
592077138.title: Explore your data with natural language

592077139.text:
The Elastic Compute Node application in SAP HANA Cloud Central now provides a demand-based scaling policy type for SQL on Files. The SQL on Files policy automatically adds and removes ECNs based on SQL on Files-based activity.
See:
- [About ECN Policies](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/ecn-policies)
- [Create an ECN Policy for SQL on Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/create-ecn-policy-for-sql-on-files)
592077139.title: ECN Policy for SQL on Files

592077140.text:
You can delete database tenants including containers and credentials in a single step in SAP HANA Cloud Central. The corresponding REST API includes a new cascade parameter.
See [Delete a Database Tenant](2a488140bd144ec5bbcc98b02bda7e10.html).
592077140.title: Delete Database Tenants

592077141.text:
The Workload Classes Management app has new options to view and configure workload classes per node role. You can now control resource consumption on active/active (read-enabled) replica nodes using workload classes and mappings, giving you the same resource management capabilities on replicas as on the source node.
See [Configure Workload Classes for Active/Active Replicas with SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/configure-workload-classes-for-active-active-replicas-with-sap-hana-cloud-central).
592077141.title: Workload Class Support for Active/Active (Read-Enabled) Replicas

592077142.text:
You can now configure instance-specific DNS and certificates directly from SAP HANA Cloud Central.
See [SAP HANA Database Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/e4b6b571863446f496a0476f6407abda.html).
592077142.title: Instance-Specific Certificates and DNS Configuration

592077143.text:
You can now view the underlying SQL GRANT statements for roles and privileges directly from the role and privilege editors in SAP HANA Cloud Central. You can retrieve GRANT statements for a specific selection of roles or privileges, or view all visible GRANT statements for a displayed role, organized and commented by the grantor.
See [Database Roles](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/16a2e6705f8247db9bbfd089696d6eab.html).
592077143.title: View SQL GRANT Statements in the Role and Privilege

592077144.text:
SAP HANA Cloud Central now has import and export wizards, making it simpler to move data and database objects in and out of your SAP HANA Cloud database. With a guided, step-by-step experience, you can:
- Import and export table data or export data from views
- Import and export catalog objects and SAP HANA deployment infrastructure containers
- Review the generated SQL for your import and export tasks before execution
See [Using Import and Export in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/de125916128447f98cde25f14c2e59d2.html).
592077144.title: Import and Export Application

592077145.text: The Instance Mapping section in the Manage Configuration app has been improved by adding a search field, sort button, and a filter button on the top of the instance mapping table. Pressing the Add Mapping button adds a new, highlighted line at the top in the table.
592077145.title: Improvements to Instance Mapping interface

592077146.text:
You can now use the Reload action and define namespaces with MDS Cubes in Database Objects.
See [Reloading MDS Cubes in Database Objects](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/reloading-mds-cubes-in-database-objects).
592077146.title: Reload MDS Cubes in Database Objects

592077147.text:
The Compute – vCPUs parameter for the data lake Relational Engine has been replaced with separate Coordinators and Workers input fields to more accurately calculate the Capacity Unit cost for data lake instances.
See [The SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/sap-hana-cloud-capacity-unit-estimator).
592077147.title: SAP HANA data lake Relational Engine Capacity Unit (CU) estimations are now calculated using coordinators and workers instead of vCPUs.

592077148.text: On the Data Replication card on the Overview page of your instance, you can now create replication tasks of CDS view objects with real-time replication schedule. You can also change your current CDS view replication schedule to real-time. Your current CDS view replications that use snapshot replicas with manual or scheduled refreshes continue to work. New CDS view replications only support real-time replication. To change replication schedule to real-time, see [Manage a Data Replication Task](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/08f0522e4e7e4770ae940403d22f29ea).
592077148.title: CDS view replication from remote ABAP systems (S/4HANA and S/4HANA Cloud) supports real-time replication

592077149.text: New columns have been added to the Attributes, Hierarchies, Variables, and Measures tabs to display additional cube properties in Database Objects.
592077149.title: Improved cube metadata display in Database Objects

592077150.text:
You can now identify the source SQL statement for results in the SQL Console.
See:
- [SQL Console Settings](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/connection-settings)
- [SQL Console Result Toolbar](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/view-chart-and-graphs-in-sql-console)
592077150.title: Identify source SQL for results in the SQL Console

592077151.text: A new Alerts column in the Data Products Monitor app allows you to view and copy any errors associated with failed publishing processes in order to investigate failures.
592077151.title: Error messages displayed in Data Products Monitor app

592077152.text:
Use the available preset views to monitor specific performance scenarios, create, and save custom views by adding charts to existing presets.
See [Create Custom Views in the Performance Monitor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/dde6ba6956e241f798214b38131e5f7a.html?locale=en-US&state=DRAFT&version=dev).
592077152.title: Preset and custom views available in Performance Monitor app

592077153.text:
You can now see and manage alert rule sets created by other users from your same subaccount.
See [Create Alert Rule Sets](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/cfb23c2f65794bffa8a588382a1829b2.html?locale=en-US&state=DRAFT&version=dev).
592077153.title: Alert rule sets visible to subaccount users

592117454.text: You can now use the Visualize Data by selecting the  (Visualize Data) icon in the Result toolbar to view statement results as charts and graphs in the SQL Console.
592117454.title: Visualize Data in the SQL console

592117455.text: You can now use the Fixed-Width Font toggle to adjust the font in the Column Settings of the SQL Console.
592117455.title: Adjust font in the SQL console results settings

592117456.text:
You can now configure automatic cleanup to delete traced plans older than a specified number of days.
See [Plan Trace in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d68fbcc8f050438483b6d493333bbe99.html).
592117456.title: Configure Automatic Cleanup in Plan Trace

592117457.text:
You can now add an optional plan trace name to help identify and correlate traced plan files with the originating application transaction.
See [Plan Trace in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d68fbcc8f050438483b6d493333bbe99.html).
592117457.title: Add the Plan Traces Name parameter

592117458.text:
While tracing is active, captured plans are not refreshed or shown in real time. Captured execution plans become visible only after the plan trace is stopped.
See [Plan Trace in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d68fbcc8f050438483b6d493333bbe99.html).
592117458.title: Plan Trace Refresh Limitation

592117459.text: In the Schemas & HDI Containers app, you now have the options to open the HDI container or the database objects filter by the container schema of an instance under  (More) in the Actions column.
592117459.title: Open HDI container and database objects in Schemas & HDI Containers app

592117460.text: You can now select  (Rerun Statement) in the SQL Console Result tab to refresh your results. You can also select  (Column Settings) to reorder the columns in your results.
592117460.title: Refresh results in the SQL Console Result tab

592117461.text:
You can now provision large instances with memory larger than 12 TB to support enterprise workloads that require substantial memory and processing power.
See:
- [Large SAP HANA Database Instances (>12 TB Memory)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/c4d749b68131403dad30e6e173e96417.html)
- [Memory and Storage Sizes Supported by SAP HANA Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/798c2c6ba7ae41e898f423aa34491ac3.html)
- [3717342](https://me.sap.com/notes/3717342)
592117461.title: Provision large instances with >12 TB memory

592117462.text: In the Data Lake Files app, you can now upload or drag and drop multiple files at once into the File Explorer. There is now an Upload Progress table. See [Using Data Lake Files in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/open-data-lake-files-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
592117462.title: Upload multiple files at once in the Data Lake Files app

592117463.text: The Performance Class Advisor analyzes the workload of your SAP HANA database instance and generates recommendations for resizing it to a more suitable performance class and size. See [About the Performance Class Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/a8d04f9e27724d5792fd6b955375d1f7).
592117463.title: Performance Class Advisor

592117464.text: PRINT_LINE statement outputs now appear in the Console Output section of the Result tab. See [Built-in Library SQLSCRIPT_PRINT](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-sqlscript-reference/built-in-library-sqlscript-print).
592117464.title: View PRINT_LINE statement outputs in the SQL Console

592117465.text: You can now enable or disable scheduled jobs from their details page in Database Objects. The Properties tab displays whether a job is enabled or disabled.
592117465.title: Enable or disable scheduled jobs in Database Objects

592117466.text: In the Syntax Help side panel, the lists of Columns and Parameters are now collapsible. You can filter each list by name or datatype. You can also select a column name to insert it directly into the SQL Console.
592117466.title: Improved Columns and Parameters lists in the Syntax Help side panel

592117467.text: You can now rename, search, and reorder tabs in the SQL Console. See [Managing Tabs](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/managing-tabs).
592117467.title: Rename, search, and reorder tabs in the SQL Console

592117468.text: You can now search your instances in the Connect Instance dialog in the SQL Console and the Database Objects app. You can also filter by instance type and choose to show running instances only.
592117468.title: Filter and search in the Connect Instance dialog

592117469.text:
View effective memory and thread limits applied to each thread in the Threads application. New columns show the resource constraints that were active during thread execution, including inherited limits from parent workload classes.
See [View Effective Thread Limits in the Threads Application](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/view-effective-thread-limits-in-threads-application).
592117469.title: Improved Visibility into Workload Class Thread Limits

592117470.text: You can now generate SQL GRANT statements for roles and privileges directly from the role and privilege editors. This allows you to view the exact SQL commands needed to recreate specific permissions or all permissions for a role, making it easier to understand and document your security configurations without needing to manually write the statements. See [Database Roles](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/16a2e6705f8247db9bbfd089696d6eab.html) and [Manage a Catalog Role](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/f8fa516f2e494a058664a314290cd80d.html).
592117470.title: GRANT Statement Retrieval in Role and Privilege Editors

592117471.text: You can now restore up to 10 of your most recently-closed tabs in the SQL Console. See [Managing Tabs](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/managing-tabs).
592117471.title: Restore closed tabs in the SQL Console

592117472.text:
Create an ECN Policy from an ECN Advisor recommendation, for automated ECN provisioning and deprovisioning based on a schedule or on thresholds (CPU/memory).
See [About ECN Policies](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/ecn-policies).
592117472.title: Create an ECN policy

592117473.text:
Use the Performance Monitor app to identify performance issues of your SAP HANA Cloud database instances, visualize historical data, and use views to analyze specific performance scenarios.
See [Using the Performance Analyzer in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/using-performance-analyzer-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
592117473.title: Performance Analyzer

592117474.text:
You can now monitor SQL statements executed on active/active (read-enabled) replicas directly in the SQL Statements app.
See [Monitoring SQL Statements in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/4d5dca0665f54dc9aed8d0c53171bbd4.html).
592117474.title: Monitor SQL statements executed on replica nodes

592117475.text: Download SQL execution plans from the Top 20 Statements in the Buffer Cache Monitor to analyze query performance in the SQL Analyzer tool for SAP HANA. See [Monitor Buffer Cache](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/view-and-configure-buffer-cache-monitor).
592117475.title: Download SQL statements from the Buffer Cache Monitor

592117476.text: You can monitor and analyze HDI activities by viewing and exporting operations and message log entries in the Operations tab in the HDI Administration app.
592117476.title: SAP HANA Deployment Infrastructure (HDI) operations and message log entries

592117477.text: You can now open the database object settings in the Database Objects app. See [Using Database Objects in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/database-objects).
592117477.title: Open database object settings in the Database Objects app

592117478.text:
Deleted database tenants can be recovered within the database backup retention period using point-in-time tenant recovery.
See [Delete a Database Tenant](2a488140bd144ec5bbcc98b02bda7e10.html).
592117478.title: Extend database tenant deletion time

592117479.text: You can create and edit remote sources in the Database Objects app.
592117479.title: Create remote sources in the Database Objects app

592117480.text: You can choose to upgrade a Data Access Agent without restarting it with minimal downtime.
592117480.title: Upgrading Data Access Agents without a restart

592117481.text: With the Self-Service Migration tool, you can now choose to migrate your full SAP HANA on-premise database with the option to exclude database users, or migrate selectively by schemas, or by XS Advanced service instances. With selective migration, you can migrate your SAP HANA on-premise database in iterations. For more information see [Migrate an SAP HANA On-Premise Database to SAP HANA Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/a2c01518af874b6287fdff81c086ba91/875d41eba28c4f12b272e48fbb55350e.html)
592117481.title: Support for full migration with excluded database users and selective migration now available

592117482.text: You can now use Gen AI in the SQL Console to generate, explain, and optimize SQL statements. See [Using Gen AI in the SQL Console](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/using-gen-ai-in-sql-console).
592117482.title: Use Gen AI in the SQL Console

592117483.text:
You can now see the status of the Plan Trace application in the SQL Performance Management card.
See [Plan Trace in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d68fbcc8f050438483b6d493333bbe99.html).
592117483.title: Plan Trace App Status

592117484.text: The SQL Console now provides code completion suggestions for code snippets, database objects, and column names.
592117484.title: Code completion suggestions in the SQL Console

592117485.text:
Point in time tenant recovery from deleted tenants is now supported in HANA Cloud Central, allowing you to recover database tenants that have been deleted within the retention period (default 14 days).
See:
- [Recover a Database Tenant](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/88c66597fd354447b4cda1546a317368.html)
- [Database Tenant Statuses](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/021cc6922a70493bbc6087b105fdfc68.html)
- [Managing SAP HANA Cloud Database Tenants Using SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/3ce1a923e4284486987d9b93e140471d.html)
592117485.title: Point in Time Tenant Recovery for Deleted Tenants

592117486.text: You can now monitor SAP HANA Smart Data Integration remote sources, including replication status, performance statistics, and counts of remote sources.
592117486.title: Monitor Remote Source Statistics in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117487.text:
You can now monitor and analyze SQL statements in your SAP HANA Cloud instance using the Statement Overview feature in SAP HANA Database Explorer for Visual Studio Code.
See [Using Statement Overview in SAP HANA Database Explorer for Visual Studio Code](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/781e72e4c447485b96fd728322dde9f6.html).
592117487.title: Statement Overview in SAP HANA Database Explorer for VS Code

592117488.text: You can now add advanced options when connecting to an instance in the SQL Console. See [Connecting to an Instance](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/connecting-to-instance-sql-console).
592117488.title: Connect with advanced options in SQL Console

592117489.text: The new Data Products Monitor application in SAP HANA Cloud Central allows you to monitor the status of the most recent publication job for all data products associated with a particular SAP HANA database instance.
592117489.title: New Data Products Monitor

592117490.text: The instance list now has a Created On column. You can view, filter, and sort instances by date.
592117490.title: View, filter, and sort instances by date

592117491.text:
See active alerts for your chosen instance and navigate to the Alerts app from the instance details page.
See [Monitor Alerts](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/monitor-alerts).
592117491.title: Open Alerts from the instance details page

592117492.text:
Each section in the SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator now has an Activity per Month section.
See [The SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/sap-hana-cloud-capacity-unit-estimator?locale=en-US).
592117492.title: Activity per Month sections in the SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator

592117493.text: Using the actions menu in the SQL Console app, you can now open the associated instance and schema in the Database Objects app.
592117493.title: Open Database Objects from the SQL Console

592117494.text: You can now map an instance to a subaccount to create new tenants.See [Map an SAP HANA Database to Another Environment Context](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/map-sap-hana-database-to-another-environment-context).
592117494.title: Subaccount Mapping for Creating Tenants

592117495.text:
You can now view a comprehensive statement overview in the SQL Statements app, including SQL statement performance trends and heatmaps, as well as execution plan overview.
See [Monitoring SQL Statements in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/4d5dca0665f54dc9aed8d0c53171bbd4.html).
592117495.title: SQL Statements app enhancements

592117496.text:
In SAP HANA database, you can choose to enable shared mode for the Cloud Connector. Previously, the Cloud Connector operated only in dedicated mode. It allowed the instance to connect only to Cloud Connectors within its own subaccount using subaccount credentials.In shared mode, you can connect the instance to different Cloud Connectors across subaccounts using subaccount-specific access tokens passed via session credentials.
See [SAP HANA Database Cloud Connector](dfd8627377e44f71b41f6f4cbf431db0.html).
592117496.title: Shared connectivity proxy mode added for Cloud Connector

592117497.text: You can now decouple a thin clone of a data lake Relational Engine from its parent so that it becomes a unique, standalone instance.
592117497.title: Decouple thin clone

592117498.text:
You can now delete selected traced SQL queries and their execution plans.
See [Plan Trace in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d68fbcc8f050438483b6d493333bbe99.html).
592117498.title: Delete Selected Plans from Plan Trace

592117499.text: Database tenants can be copied or moved to other database instances in SAP HANA Cloud Central.
592117499.title: Copy or move database tenants

592117500.text: The Plan Trace application is now available in SAP HANA cockpit and includes the Exclude Cached Queries option, which allows you to reduce the number of PLVs collected by the trace by capturing only compiled ones.See [Monitor and Analyze Statements with Plan Trace](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/a03f9f3ab48a496cb1191c2b31585c94.html).
592117500.title: Plan Trace

592117501.text:
The validity status of a workload class mapping is now shown in the column IS VALID. Mappings may become invalid if, for example, dependent objects, such as the workload class it relates to, are dropped.
See [Create a Workload Class Mapping](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/228d676a6807491294676c38ced2bfc6.html).
592117501.title: Workload Class Mapping

592117502.text:
The Missing Privilege application now displays SAP passport information to better understand authorization errors.
See [Display Information About an Insufficient Privilege Error](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/6ba7674426da444499faab22a20bef8d.html).
592117502.title: Missing Privilege SAP Passport information

592117503.text:
Audit policies now support both the specification of individual users and user groups for explicit inclusion or exclusion in the logging of audit events.See [Audit Policies](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/db4b4fb4bb571014a22b8f893c94aeef.html)
[CREATE AUDIT POLICY Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20d3d56075191014af43d6487fcaa603.html)
592117503.title: Audit policies support for user groups

592117504.text:
The Buffer Cache Monitor application now has the column I/O Read Size to display the disk I/O reads over time.
See [View and Configure the Native Storage Extension Buffer Cache Monitor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/b8b90b2ba46543bd92a9ba4679d4b4e9.html).
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA cockpit for SAP HANA Cloud. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117504.title: I/O Read Size column

592117505.text:
You can now edit the comment on certificates and public keys:
- In the Certificate Store application you can edit the comment on the top right of the selected certificate details screen
- In the Public Keys application click Change in the Comment column
592117505.title: Edit Comments on Certificates and Public Keys

592117506.text:
In the Auditing application you can now edit the loadable unit of the audit log table.
[Edit Load Unit](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/2eea1932a26045c38a49a4a12a03d0a3.html)
592117506.title: Edit Load Unit on the Audit Log

592117507.text:
Options are now available in the Table Distribution and Partitioning app to revise an initial partitioning specification and to make use of additional options for range partitioning. This includes merging partitions, setting the load unit for partitions for NSE data and defining the thresholds required for dynamic range partitioning.
See [Edit a Partitioned Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/fc15fb08724b43259b73f357c5325bd1.html).
592117507.title: Edit Partition Specification

592117508.text:
A number of enhancements have been made to the Authentication app to improve overall usability:
- The app has been renamed Password Policy.
- A link to the Password Policy app is provided on the User & Role Management card.
- The Authentication card on the Database Overview page has been removed.
592117508.title: Authentication App Enhancements

592117509.text: You can now configure a total statement memory limit and/or a total statement thread limit when creating a parent workload class. The user interface for creating and editing hierarchical workload classes has been enhanced to be more user friendly.
592117509.title: Workload Classes App Enhancement

592117510.text:
A number of enhancements have been made to the Data Encryption app to improve overall usability:
- The app has been reworked so that only information relevant in the cloud context is shown.
- The Data Encryption card on the Database Overview page has been removed. A link to the Data Encryption app is provided on the Security Related Links card instead.
592117510.title: Data Encryption App Enhancements

592117511.text: In the Role Assignment and Role Management apps, role group operators can now specify the role group as the granting principal when assigning roles that belong to a role group to users or roles.This feature is not available for SAP HANA service for SAP HANA BTP.
592117511.title: Support for granting roles using role group

592117512.text: In the Privilege Assignment and Role Management apps, user group operators can now specify the user group as the granting principal when assigning privileges on a user group to users or roles.This feature is not available for SAP HANA service for SAP HANA BTP.
592117512.title: Support for granting user group privileges using user group

592117513.text: In the User Management app, you can now disable the password lifetime check of a user's password for local password authentication.
592117513.title: Password lifetime check

592117514.text:
In the Database Configuration app, you can now select more than one database in order to compare the configuration of multiple databases at the same time.
See [Compare Configurations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/9d6cb0f89ab24d90923e2be97c13e080.html).
592117514.title: Compare Database Configuration

592117515.text:
In the SAML Identity Providers and JWT Identity Providers apps, you can now enable automatic user creation in conjunction with LDAP group authorization.This feature is not available for SAP HANA service for SAP HANA BTP.
See:
- [Add an SAML Identity Provider](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/8ccc7fb52a704881a4a2b2e2c927b6f8.html)
- [Add a JWT Identity Provider](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/41190d216fab4ef383bb007403f89a5d.html)
592117515.title: Configuration of JWT and SAML providers for automatic user creation

592117516.text: In the Backup Catalog app, it is now possible to see whether or not a data backup includes configuration (INI) files.This feature is not available for SAP HANA service for SAP HANA BTP.
592117516.title: Availability of configuration files in data backups

592117517.text: A link to data lake Relational Engine diagnostic logs is now available in the SAP HANA cockpit. The link takes you to the Database Diagnostic Files folder in the SAP HANA database explorer.
592117517.title: Diagnostics

592117518.text: When collecting runtime environment diagnostic information, a new section named MEMORY_MANAGER has been added.
592117518.title: Full System Information Dumps

592117519.text:
The Database Information app and Database Information card now display the QRC version of your SAP HANA database instance.
See [Database Information](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/ff82c8c9c2c147548120bd997c5bc734.html).
592117519.title: Show QRC Version

592117520.text: The Table Partition wizard has been redesigned to improve the user experience.
592117520.title: Table Partitioning

592117521.text: You can now generate full system information dumps by host.
592117521.title: Collection of Diagnostic Information

592117522.text: The Failover Group column has been added. To achieve high availability, instance services are grouped into failover groups. The value in this column indicates whether the source and replica services in failover groups are set up in the same or different zones.
592117522.title: Manage Services

592117523.text: The Statement Hash column has been added to Statement Hints.
592117523.title: Statement Hints

592117524.text:
You can now import or export data through Data Lake Files.
When importing and exporting files, PARQUET is now supported as a format alongside CSV.
See:
- [Import Data Into a Table (Data Lake Relational Engine)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/d0afbba9071e45e1a35ea4e61ad788f1.html)
- [Export Data From a Table or View (Data Lake Relational Engine)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/568fb9ac5f7648a5a9056c297a7a103d.html)
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA database explorer for SAP HANA Cloud. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117524.title: Data lake Relational Engine Imports/Exports

592117525.text:
When adding a new SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Relational Engine instance, the option to connect using TLS/SSL has been removed from the Add Instance dialog. Your connections are now secured automatically using TLS/SSL to prevent data eavesdropping.
See: [Add Instances to SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/4e2e8382f8484edba31b8b633005e937.html)
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA database explorer for SAP HANA Cloud. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117525.title: Automatic TLS/SSL connection

592117526.text: You can now delete multiple files or a complete directory in data lake Files using SAP HANA database explorer.
592117526.title: Delete multiple files in data lake Files

592117527.text:
SQL on Files is now accessible through a data lake Files connection. You can manage SQL on Files objects using SAP HANA database explorer.
See [SQL on Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/c1935fb12af4422694ba7c77aead7c04.html).
592117527.title: SQL on Files in data lake Files

592117528.text:
SAP HANA database explorer documentation has been restructured. Data lake Relational Engine topics are now integrated throughout the documentation.
See [SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/7fa981c8f1b44196b243faeb4afb5793.html).
592117528.title: Data lake Relational Engine documentation changes

592117529.title: Move and rename for data lake Files

592117530.text: You can now use the import and export wizards to import data from and export data to Converged Cloud.You can now move and rename files and directories in data lake Files using SAP HANA database explorer.
592117530.title: Converged Cloud import and export

592117531.text:
Data lake Relational Engine catalog objects now have object editor pages.
To open an object editor page, open the context menu for the object and select Show <object-type>.
592117531.title: Object editor pages

592117532.text:
You can now view data lake Relational Engine audit files (ETD files) and console logs (*.console) in SAP HANA database explorer.
See [View Diagnostic Files for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/29b21c70c2b64e3db1b92ebdd91d1bc5.html).
592117532.title: View audit files and console logs

592117533.text: You can now generate a CREATE statement for stored procedures, functions, tables, and views using the context menus for these objects.
592117533.title: You can now move and rename files and directories in data lakeGenerate CREATE statements for data lake Relational Engine objects

592117534.text: Functions and procedures now appear separately in the catalog browser.
592117534.title: Separate functions and procedures in catalog browser

592117535.text:
You can configure auditing using SAP HANA database explorer.
You can configure query plans using SAP HANA database explorer.
See [Configure Auditing for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/9a812fa6a58344c0a749033473a82503.html) and [Configure Query Plans for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/a9e717c212b44944924a1fe39749bd70.html).
592117535.title: Auditing and query plans

592117536.text:
You can now restore overwritten or deleted data in data lake Files using SAP HANA database explorer.
See [Restore Data in Data Lake Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/f2ea997634e6400681ea621f150dd3ea.html).
592117536.title: Restore data in data lake Files

592117537.text:
View diagnostic logs (.iqmsg server logs) using the SAP HANA database explorer.
See [View Diagnostic Logs for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/29b21c70c2b64e3db1b92ebdd91d1bc5.html).
592117537.title: Diagnostic Logs

592117538.text: You can now run a query as a background activity for data lake Relational Engine connections by clicking Run  Run as Background Activity.See [Run a Query as a Background Activity](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/5cad206bde094bbf944efc3701995594.html).
592117538.title: Run a query as a background activity for data lake Relational Engine connections

592117539.text: You can now execute a query on multiple databases for data lake Relational Engine connections by clicking Run  Run on Multiple Databases.See [Execute SQL Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/ca2393accb2b4c82a5cf9a415a15ec14.html).
592117539.title: Execute a query on multiple databases for data lake Relational Engine connections

592117540.text: You can now add a data lake Relational Engine connection with a different user by right-clicking your database in the catalog browser and selecting Add Database with Different User.See [Add Instances to the SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/4e2e8382f8484edba31b8b633005e937.html).
592117540.title: Add a data lake Relational Engine connection with a different user

592117541.text: For data lake Relational Engine connections, you can now change the auto-commit settings for the current SQL console using the View Connection Settings button (). SQL console contents are auto-committed by default.
592117541.title: Auto-Commit toggle for data lake Relational Engine connections

592117542.text:
You can view, upload, and delete data in data lake Files using SAP HANA database explorer.
See [Data Lake Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/fe93baa6bbe8415186c9c3a37f499690.html).
592117542.title: Data Lake Files

592117543.text:
You can now see details on materialized views in data lake Relational Engine.
See [View Objects in Data lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/d5bc06d479db4cd782c505e298996314.html).
592117543.title: Materialized Views

592117544.text:
Users with a data lake Relational Engine connection can save SQL statements in the statement library by clicking the  (Add to Statement Library) icon. You can access the statement library by right clicking the data lake Relational Engine connection in the catalog browser.
See [Use the Statement Library to Administer Your Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/f7e1e69e05cb4314b134ce69e5289697.html).
592117544.title: Statement library for data lake

592117545.text: You can now filter for direct dependencies using the dependency viewer.
592117545.title: Filter for direct dependencies

592117546.text:
In the Add Remote Source dialog, you can now choose JWT as the credential mode when connecting to a remote SAP HANA database using the HANA (ODBC) adapter.
See [Create a Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/ab1450224e784c369d7c6b79817c481a.html).
592117546.title: Support JWT Authentication for Remote Sources

592117547.text:
You can now use the export wizard to overwrite files that already exist under the same name in a specified directory.
See: [Export Data Into a File (SAP HANA Cloud Database)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/97e8ec0306eb4a12a4fd72de8bdd6a62.html).
592117547.title: Overwrite existing files using export wizard

592117548.text:
You can now export data into multiple files by targeting a directory. You can control the number of output files by specifying the row group size.
See: [Export Data Into a File (SAP HANA Cloud Database)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/97e8ec0306eb4a12a4fd72de8bdd6a62.html).
592117548.title: Export data to multiple files

592117549.text:
When adding a new SAP HANA Cloud, HANA Database instance, the option to connect using TLS/SSL has been removed from the Add Instance dialog. Your connections are now secured automatically using TLS/SSL to prevent data eavesdropping.
See: [Add Instances to SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/4e2e8382f8484edba31b8b633005e937.html)
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA database explorer for SAP HANA Cloud. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117549.title: Automatic TLS/SSL connection

592117550.text: The Add Instance dialog for the multi-environment SAP HANA database explorer now includes the HDI Container instance type. The connection values (host, port, user, etc.) can be specified or parsed from the JSON string of a service key. See: [Add Instances to SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-database-explorer/add-instances-to-sap-hana-database-explorer?q=add%20instance)
592117550.title: Allow HDI connections in Multi-Environment

592117551.text: Import wizard now supports OpenTable Format files. See: [Import Data Into a New or Existing Table (SAP HANA Cloud Database)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/ee0e1389fde345fa8ccf937f19c99c30.html).
592117551.title: OpenTable format support

592117552.text: You can now use the import and export wizards to import from and export to Converged Cloud.
592117552.title: Converged Cloud import and export

592117553.text:
HDI containers can now be imported from and exported to Amazon S3 and Azure Storage.See:
- [Import HDI Containers](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/9c7d4b9e37cc44ab8330193e4ba22442.html?q=HDI)
- [Export HDI Containers](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/0394510cb4154e5494e6e44ae84a4478.html?q=HDIhttps://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/0394510cb4154e5494e6e44ae84a4478.html?q=HDI)
592117553.title: Import/Export HDI Containers to Cloud Hyperscaler

592117554.text: You can now select and view multiple spatial geometries in the map viewer.See: [Visualizing Spatial Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/302e72e822ea48b6a1c260119e41d8a7.html)
592117554.title: Visualizing Spatial Data

592117555.text: The Import/Export wizards now support Data Lake Files.
592117555.title: Data Lake Files Import/Export

592117556.text:
The cypher graph algorithm is now available in your graph workspace for select versions of SAP HANA Cloud instances.
See:
- [Work With Graph Workspaces in SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/57e1cbf376064b2aba49f455269f8202.html)
- [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Graph Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/11afa2e60a5f4192a381df30f94863f9/30d1d8cfd5d0470dbaac2ebe20cefb8f.html)
592117556.title: Cypher graph algorithm

592117557.text: In the Add Remote Source dialog, you can now choose X.509 as the credential mode when connecting to a remote SAP HANA database using the HANA (ODBC) adapter.See [Create a Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/ab1450224e784c369d7c6b79817c481a.html).
592117557.title: Mutual authentication with X.509 certificates in Add Remote Source dialog

592117558.text:
You can now view metadata information on fuzzy search indexes using the catalog browser.See:
- [Fuzzy Search Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/79cbd8c7ec3340848e0654c67b45bc00.html)
- [FUZZY Search](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/cc602780bb5710148aa2bf6cab3c015b.html)
