This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA database explorer for SAP HANA Cloud. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117558.title: View metadata for fuzzy search indexes

592117559.text:
In the Statement Library dialog, you can now see when a statement was last modified. When you add to the statement library from the SQL console or import from a file, a timestamp for the corresponding statement shows under Last Modified. For SYSTEM statements, the value in the Last Modified column is N/A.
See [Use the Statement Library to Administer Your Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/f7e1e69e05cb4314b134ce69e5289697.html).
592117559.title: Last Modified Column in Statement Library

592117560.text:
When importing or exporting data to Amazon S3, Azure Storage, Alibaba Cloud OSS, or Google Cloud Storage, you now have the option to use a component-specific credential as opposed to a secret key. If you choose to use a credential, it must already exist and have the component "SAPHANAIMPORTEXPORT".See:
- [Export Data Into a File](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/97e8ec0306eb4a12a4fd72de8bdd6a62.html)
- [Import Data Into a New or Existing Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/ee0e1389fde345fa8ccf937f19c99c30.html)
- [CREATE CREDENTIAL Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_WEB_ANALYTICS/4fe29514fd584807ac9f2a04f6754767/20d3f464751910148968e73782586ed0.html)
592117560.title: Use Database Credentials for Importing and Exporting Data

592117561.text: When previewing data for catalog objects, such as tables and views, you are now able to define potential filters through drag and drop. You also now have the option to right-click on your desired column(s) and click Add to Filters.
592117561.title: Filter Selection in Data Preview

592117562.text:
Groups in SAP HANA Database Explorer no longer need to be empty before you can delete them.
See [Remove Groups from the SAP HANA Database Explorer Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/f0b0263847804bf09eb08dce75cdf68b.html).
592117562.title: Delete Groups

592117563.text: In the Background Activities Monitor, you can now download the SQL results for one or multiple queries by clicking the  (Download SQL Results for Selected Row(s)) icon. See [Run a Query as a Background Activity](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/5cad206bde094bbf944efc3701995594.html).
592117563.title: Download SQL Results for Background Activities

592117564.text: You are now able to visualize your spatial data in SAP HANA Database Explorer. See [Visualizing Spatial Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/302e72e822ea48b6a1c260119e41d8a7.html).
592117564.title: Visualizing Spatial Data

592117565.text: The Overview page now shows the QRC version for your SAP HANA database instance.See [Learn More About Your Database in the SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/f2f8c314bc17495aa99eea4eb55399f3.html).
592117565.title: View QRC Version

592117566.text: You can now see which user is logged in and their login origin by clicking the  (Show user login information) icon.
592117566.title: Show User Login Information

592117567.text: When adding Application Managed Service Instances, support for Instance Manager is being deprecated. The Manager drop-down for Application Managed Service Instances currently includes entries for both service and instance managers. Once Instance Manager is no longer supported, only Service Managers will appear in the drop-down.
592117567.title: Application Managed Service Instances

592117568.text:
The Data Preview editor for dimension calculation views and CUBE calculation views now contains a Hierarchies tab that shows hierarchies and measures details if they are available for the view. For more information about hierarchies see the [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Hierarchy Developer Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/09f734c2169c4661b1aa15c00022ab21/a93c356d32ef4e7fbd6143b554278eab.html), and for hierarchy function syntax, see the [SAP HANA SQL and System Views Reference Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/b4b0eec1968f41a099c828a4a6c8ca0f.html).
For more information about the new Hierarchies tab, see "[Preview Calculation View Output](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/3746eb56b77943b699df025ab2bc7552/903eff885ebd4c5cadb1e0c3e58f681d.html)" in the SAP HANA Modeling Guide.
592117568.title: Data Preview

592117569.text:
You can now import and export data using a JSON file.See:
- [Import Data Into a New or Existing Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/ee0e1389fde345fa8ccf937f19c99c30.html)
- [Export Data Into a File](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/97e8ec0306eb4a12a4fd72de8bdd6a62.html)
592117569.title: JSON file support

592117570.text: A notification panel now appears in SAP HANA database explorer when a high priority notification is received.
592117570.title: System notifications

592117571.text:
You can now enable single sign-on (SSO) authentication when creating new SAP HANA database instances in SAP HANA database explorer. See:
- [Add Instances to the SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/4e2e8382f8484edba31b8b633005e937.html)
- [Enable JWT SSO Login](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9630e508caef4578b34db22014998dba/794b4d35389744a3b3cdc87e66ecaf33.html)
592117571.title: Enable SSO

592117572.text:
You can now remove multiple databases simultaneously by clicking the  (Open the remove databases dialog) icon above the catalog browser on the left of the screen.
See [Remove Databases from the SAP HANA Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/a2cea64fa3ac4f90a52405d07600047b/53f7321706244b499797682b758f5422.html).
592117572.title: Remove Multiple Databases

592117573.text: You can now view a JSON collection in a read-only viewer by right-clicking on the collection in the catalog browser and selecting Show JSON Collections.This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA database explorer for SAP HANA Cloud. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117573.title: Opening JSON Collections

592117574.text:
You can now open a SQL console with a CREATE/SELECT/INSERT statement by right-clicking on a JSON collection in the catalog browser and selecting one of the following options:
- Generate CREATE Statement
- Generate SELECT Statement
- Generate INSERT Statement
See [JSON Document Store Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f2d68919a1ad437fac08cc7d1584ff56/dd1a731414e84b448099b41ef66631c4.html).
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA database explorer for SAP HANA Cloud. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117574.title: Generating Statements for JSON Collections

592117575.text:
A new node, the Job Scheduler, has been added to the catalog browser. The Job Scheduler allows you to view existing jobs. Use SQL to create, alter, or delete jobs.
See:
- [Scheduling Administrative Tasks](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/be4c214b87e54a08bd8047f6149645ec.html)
- [CREATE SCHEDULER JOB Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/d7d43d818366460dae1328aab5d5df4f.html)
592117575.title: Job Scheduler in Catalog Browser

592117576.text:
You can now sign in to your Cloud Foundry account in SAP HANA Database Explorer to populate your HDI Container instance list directly from the Cloud Foundry environment.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA database explorer for SAP HANA Cloud. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117576.title: Log in to the Cloud Foundry Environment

592117577.text: Users can now authenticate themselves using an X.509 certificate instead of entering a user/password. After entering the X.509 certificate, the system will use it to identify what user is connecting, and authenticate the certificate in HANA and HDLRE connections in DBX.
592117577.title: Authenticating an instance using an X.509 certificate

592117578.text:
When you open the SAP HANA database explorer, you are now asked to provide consent for SAP Web Analytics to collect information that will help improve product performance and user experience.
For example, SAP Web Analytics collects the following types of information:
- Which applications and links are most frequently used?
- How much time do customers spend on a wizard?
- What regions are customers accessing the SAP HANA database explorer from?
See [SAP Web Analytics](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_WEB_ANALYTICS/e342b49c78c74d4e8ebc00700a791aee/e90c64af5dc04a238b324b359558cd48.html?locale=en-US&version=cloud).
592117578.title: Consent for SAP Web Analytics

592117579.text:
You can now access Built-In Support in SAP HANA database explorer by clicking the  (Built-in Support) icon. After activating Built-In Support services, you can use the Built-In Support tool to do the following:
- Create, review, and update incidents
- Search the support knowledge base
- Interact with a support Chatbot
See [Overview](https://help.sap.com/docs/Built-InSupport/e642a2b4418143dabed5d336a3f21b0d/a682d0995dde44e2af7122033ea2129b.html).
592117579.title: Built-In Support access

592117580.text: You can now view the instance information of the instance you are connected to in the Database Objects app. You can also sign in with a different user.
592117580.title: View instance information in the Database Objects App

592117581.text:
SAP HANA Cloud Central now supports the creation and maintenance of table placement rules for table distribution.
See [Table Placement Rules](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/59244f4e0c8d437db363e37dfeacac68.html).
592117581.title: Table Placement Rules

592117582.text:
SAP HANA Cloud Central supports the creation and administration of database tenants.
See [SAP HANA Cloud Multitenancy Guide](172f93968dfe45f09bf8c14b2ca9582d.html).
592117582.title: Multitenancy Support

592117583.text:
If there are any ECNs that belong to the SAP HANA Cloud instance, the costs are listed in the Consumption Monitor.
See [Consumption Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/consumption-monitor).
592117583.title: Support ECN in Consumption Monitor

592117584.text:
You can now restrict connections based on authentication method for user groups in SAP HANA Cloud Central.
See [Connect Restrictions](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/882d94847a934f6793f2e009a22a3846.html).
[Troubleshooting Authentication Problems in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/388b33c7148c40caafceb16299e77fc0.html).
592117584.title: Authentication method Connect Restriction

592117585.text:
You can route workload to elastic compute nodes (ECNs) using workload classes. Set different memory and thread limits for different processing locations, for example, nodes or table placement locations.
See [Location-Specific Limits](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/0ab49cdca5c545a992f3dd177cb4596b.html).
592117585.title: Support ECN in Workload Management

592117586.text:
You can add elastic compute nodes (ECNs) to your SAP HANA Cloud instance to add temporary processing resources for workload peaks. Manage ECNs using the functions provided with SAP HANA Cloud Central.
See [SAP HANA Database Size](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/19a526792d5044609ed947a589047d4c.html).
592117586.title: Support ECN in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117587.text:
The Elastic Compute Node (ECN) Advisor is available to support optimal use of ECNs. The advisor analyzes workload on the coordinator node and creates recommendations for adding and deleting ECNs.
See [Elastic Compute Node Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/2e3912cbbba94544a83a35065fc26e21.html).
592117587.title: ECN Advisor

592117588.text:
Use workload classes to set different memory and thread limits for different processing locations, for example, nodes or table placement locations.
See [Set Location-Specific Limits](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/8ef8c310b83f420daaa25bd4ed95e8fc.html).
592117588.title: Support location specific limits on workload class

592117589.text:
The SQL Plan Advisor app's user interface has been updated to streamline workflows, making it easier to navigate and implement recommendations. The SQL Plan Advisor now automatically detects alternative plan candidates, and you can register queries at any time, regardless of the current advisor settings. Additionally, support for advice types has been expanded to include captured abstract SQL plans and plan variants.
See [Using the SQL Plan Advisor in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/using-sql-plan-advisor-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
592117589.title: SQL Plan Advisor

592117590.text: SAP HANA Cloud Central offers more SQL Console settings, including the ability to control actions for SQL execution failures and configure binary data formatting for SQL results. See [SQL Console Settings](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/connection-settings).
592117590.title: New SQL Console setting preferences

592117591.text: You can now download the prepared plan file from the SQL Console. This is an optimized query plan generated by the SQL optimizer before the query is executed. After downloading, you can analyze it using the SQL analyzer tool for SAP HANA.
592117591.title: Download the prepared plan from the SQL Console

592117592.text: The execution plan analysis and export options in the SQL Console have been moved to the Run drop-down menu to improve accessibility and streamline your workflow, giving you quick access to these features while executing queries.
592117592.title: Execution plan analysis and export options moved to the Run menu

592117593.text: SAP HANA Cloud Central offers more SQL Console settings for adjusting auto-pair character behavior, setting font size, customizing NULL values, setting a maximum number of open results, and customizing command separators.
592117593.title: New SQL Console setting preferences

592117594.text: All users logging in with a standard username and password (excluding JWT and X.509 logins) in data lake can now directly change their passwords, regardless of their privilege level.
592117594.title: Enable users to change their own passwords in data lake instances

592117595.text: You can now monitor the capacity units (CUs) used by configuration parameters using the new Monthly Details view in the Consumption Monitor app by clicking the  Monthly Details icon.
592117595.title: Monthly details chart available for Consumption Monitor app

592117596.text: Show Explain Plan functionality now supports parameterized queries in the SQL Console, allowing you to analyze execution plans with or without providing parameter values.
592117596.title: Support for parameterized queries in Show Explain Plan

592117597.text:
You can create SQL on Files virtual tables from the Database Objects app in SAP HANA Cloud Central, enabling you to easily query data stored in external files. See [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database SQL on Files Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide?version=2024_3_QRC).
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/subscribing-to-sap-hana-cloud-administration-tools).
592117597.title: Create SQL on Files virtual tables in the Database Objects page

592117598.text: The Database Objects page now has options to  Sort,  Group, and  Show/Hide Columns. This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117598.title: Additional display options for Database Objects

592117599.text: Predictive Analysis Library (PAL) is now available when provisioning an SAP HANA Database instance on Trial landscapes.
592117599.title: Predictive Analysis Library on Trial landscapes

592117600.text:
In the downtime-optimized migration mode, some of the database tables are migrated while the source database is still operational. The remaining tables, data, and the catalog are migrated during a scheduled business downtime.
[Migrate an SAP HANA On-Premise Database to SAP HANA Cloud](875d41eba28c4f12b272e48fbb55350e.html)
592117600.title: Downtime-optimized migration

592117601.text:
Use the private link configuration option to establish connections between services in your Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) and your SAP HANA database.
[SAP HANA Cloud Private Link](3bf51e391ea34461be86406d468ac0ca.html)
592117601.title: Private Link

592117602.text:
The Data Replication application now supports remote ABAP systems (SAP S/4HANA and SAP S/4HANA Cloud). You can replicate snapshots of CDS views from remote ABAP systems.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117602.title: Replicate data from remote ABAP systems

592117603.text:
You can now create a managed certificate collection to validate JWT provider token signatures in the JWT Guided Provider Creation assistant in the Identity Providers application.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117603.title: Managed certificate collection support in JWT Guided Provider Creation

592117604.text:
A new Auditing card has been added to the Overview page of your SAP HANA database instance. Click the card to monitor and record selected actions performed in the SAP HANA database, providing you with visibility on who did what in the database (or tried to do what) and when.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117604.title: Auditing card

592117605.text:
You can add the Natural Language Processing Feature to your SAP HANA database instance. It provides text analysis and vector embedding functions to convert documents to dense embedding vectors.
[SAP HANA Database Additional Features](3dbe5597a2ef4d48a32f42e0eff283c4.html)
592117605.title: Natural Language Processing (NLP)

592117606.text:
A new tab Linked Data Lake Files is available for SAP HANA database instances. On the Linked Data Lake Files tab, you can manage links from the SAP HANA database to data lake Files instances provisioned within the same subaccount.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117606.title: Link an SAP HANA database to data lake Files

592117607.text:
You can now use the X.509 and JWT authentication modes to sign in to your SAP HANA database instance.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117607.title: X.509 and JWT instance authentication

592117608.text:
You can now view tasks in SAP HANA database instances on the Database Objects page.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117608.title: View tasks in the Database Objects page

592117609.text:
You can now view HDI containers in SAP HANA database instances on the Database Objects page.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117609.title: View HDI containers in the Database Objects page

592117610.text:
Use the Cloud Connector row to determine the number of capacity units (CU) used when you enable Cloud Connector for your data lake Relational Engine instance.
For more information, see [The SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/sap-hana-cloud-capacity-unit-estimator).
592117610.title: New row available for Cloud Connector in the SAP HANA Cloud capacity unit estimator

592117611.text: The Update Mode option has been removed from the General tab of the Manage Configuration app into the confirmation dialog that is displayed every time you make a change in the Manage Configuration app.
592117611.title: Update Mode configuration has moved

592117612.text: You can now monitor the capacity units (CUs) used by configuration parameters using the new Monthly Details view in the Consumption Monitor app by clicking the  Monthly Details icon.
592117612.title: Monthly details chart available for Consumption Monitor app

592117613.text:
You can now view graph workspaces in SAP HANA database instances on the Database Objects page.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117613.title: View graph workspaces in the Database Objects page

592117614.text: A new Consumption card has been added to the Overview page of your data lake Relational Engine instance. Click the card to access the Consumption Monitor application and track the capacity units being used by your instance.
592117614.title: Consumption card for data lake

592117615.text: When copying and downloading SQL results, you can now replace new lines with a space or line feed string (\n). When exporting to a fixed-width text file, new lines are always replaced with one of these options.
592117615.title: Replace new lines in the SQL console

592117616.text:
You can now select which database objects you would like to hide or display on the Database Objects page. You can also use drag and drop to reorder the position of database objects.
To access these settings, click your avatar and select Settings > Database Objects.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117616.title: Show or hide object types on the Database Objects page

592117617.text:
You can now view remote sources in SAP HANA database instances on the Database Objects page.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117617.title: View remote sources in the Database Objects page

592117618.text:
You can now view synonyms in SAP HANA database instances on the Database Objects page.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117618.title: View synonyms in the Database Objects page

592117619.text:
You can now use Cloud Connector to securely connect to on-premise SAP HANA or SAP IQ databases.
See:
- [Data Lake Relational Engine Cloud Connector](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/d574628e30c54d53bd4853077ec49f83.html)
- [Data Lake Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/0c18e4cf615e46c895167611fb64715d.html)
- [Create an SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Instance Using the CLI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/17855748b921413bafe0640c974ed191.html)
- [CREATE SERVER Statement for Data Lake Relational Engine](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/19b3964099384f178ad08f2d348232a9/a619187d84f210158b3081e7245e94a0.html)
- [Troubleshooting Connection Issues with Cloud Connector](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a8937bea84f21015a80bc776cf758d50/a58901e9ab034f96ad280ad13bc0ecc1.html)
592117619.title: Connect to on-premise SAP HANA or SAP IQ databases

592117620.text:
The application Certificate & Public Key Management now supports managed certificate collections (Managed PSEs), a dedicated certificate collection which retrieves trusted certificate/ public keys from another secure location via HTTPS.
See [Create a Certificate Collection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ae502a98d8194395ba040e07221b904d.html).
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117620.title: Managed certificate collections

592117621.text:
You can now enable JWT-based single sign-on using OpenID configuration. Use the assistant Guided Provider Creation in the Identity Providers application to complete the following actions:
- Create a JWT identity provider
- Create a certificate collection
- Import and add certificates to the certificate collection
- Assign the certificate collection to the JWT provider
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117621.title: Enable JWT Single Sign-on with OpenID configuration

592117622.text:
You can now apply the following filters to an export of an audit log CSV:
- Specify the start and end date range
- Export the audit log entries that match the audit log table display filters
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117622.title: Audit log filtering and exporting improvement

592117623.text:
You can now view JSON Collection objects on the Database Objects page.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117623.title: Access JSON Collection objects in the Database Objects page

592117624.text:
The SQL Plan Advisor application identifies queries that could benefit from optimization, compares available query execution plans, provides advice on which plan promises the best performance, and applies the best plan the next time a target query is executed. You can choose either automatic or manual operation.
[Using the SQL Plan Advisor in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/using-sql-plan-advisor-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
592117624.title: New SQL Plan Advisor application

592117625.text:
Use the Consumption Monitor to monitor the CU (capacity units) being used by your instance for backup storage, network data transfer, memory, compute, and storage.
See also:
[The SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/sap-hana-cloud-capacity-unit-estimator).
592117625.title: New Consumption Monitor application

592117626.text:
The multienvironment version of SAP HANA Cloud Central now supports secondary login to the Cloud Foundry environment for creating and mapping SAP HANA Cloud instances.
Note
The Cloud Foundry environment must be enabled for your subaccount. Click the Enable Cloud Foundry button on the General tab of your subaccount's Overview page. You must have the Subbacount Administrator role to enable Cloud Foundry for your subaccount.
592117626.title: Operations on Cloud Foundry in multienvironment version of SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117627.text:
You can now add database objects to your Favorites tab for quick access by selecting the  Favorite Object icon on the details page for an object. You can also view your recently accessed database objects in the Recent tab.
View the favourites and recents on the Overview tab for a selected instance within the Database Objects card.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117627.title: Favorites and recents in database objects

592117628.text:
You can now duplicate a tab when connected to an instance by clicking the Duplicate Tab button in the actions menu.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117628.title: Duplicate a tab in the SQL Console

592117629.text:
Use the new Database Objects page to view objects in your instances. You can also generate SQL statements from the details page for an object.
See [Database Objects](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/f4a90abbab4e45d7aff4912ef855f467.html).
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117629.title: Database Objects

592117630.text:
The Table Partitioning Wizard has been revised and extended to support partitioning at three levels. This is supported for partitioning schemas where the first two partitioning levels use RANGE partitioning.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117630.title: Partitioning

592117631.text:
You can now switch between Editor mode and Library mode in the SQL Console. The Library mode allows you to access and run statements from the statement library while you're connected to an instance.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117631.title: Access the statement library in the SQL Console

592117632.text:
The SQL Console now parses your SQL in real-time. Warning and error messages will appear in the gutter of the SQL editor while connected to a database.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117632.title: Warnings and error messages in the SQL Console

592117633.text:
You can now search and filter results for tables in the SQL Console results tab.Improved search functionality for SQL results in the SQL Console
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).

592117634.text:
You can now delete an instance in SAP HANA Cloud Central if it's in one of these statuses: "Starting", "Stopping", "Upgrading", "Applying Changes", "Recovering", "Recreating", "Taking Over", "Upgrading to Paid Tier", and "Upgrading to Test and Development". This allows you to force-delete an instance if it hangs during start, or during another status change.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117634.title: Delete instances during status change

592117635.text:
To give precise control over selecting exactly which backup is used for recovery, you can now also optionally enter a time value in milliseconds. See [Backup and Recovery](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/89d71f01daca4ecaaa069d6a060167f5.html).
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117635.title: Backup and Recovery (Point in time)

592117636.text:
You can now manage certificates and certificate collections using the Certificate Management app in SAP HANA Cloud Central.See [Managine Certificates in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_DATA_LAKE/a89a0a8384f21015b1e7adbeca456f73/306654a5493140d1ae59f3685d9ef6aa.html).
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117636.title: Certificate management

592117637.text:
You can now enable SAML-based single sign-on using SAML metadata. Use the assistant Guided Provider Creation in the SAML application to complete the following actions:
- Create a SAML identity provider
- Create a certificate collection
- Import and add certificates to the certificate collection
- Assign the certificate collection to the SAML provider
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117637.title: Enable SAML Single Sign-on with SAML Metadata

592117638.text: When creating or editing an SAML identity provider, the required issuer and subject name can now be extracted from a SAML identity provider metadata XML file. This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117638.title: Extract Issuer and Subject Name from SAML Metadata XML File

592117639.text:
You can now validate whether a connect attempt would be possible given the active connect restrictions of a user group. This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
See:
[Connect Restrictions](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/882d94847a934f6793f2e009a22a3846.html)
592117639.title: Validate Connect Restriction

592117640.text:
You can now use the application Table Load Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central to review paging information (in-memory, in buffer cache, unloaded) of all partitions and columns for partitioned and non-partitioned tables. Note
This feature is part of a larger initiative to integrate administration and monitoring tooling into a unified SAP HANA Cloud Central.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
See:
[Monitor Memory Paging for Partitioned and Non-Partitioned Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/3f42cf05c8744d11b06168e32ab42cdc.html)
592117640.title: Table Load Monitor

592117641.text: The About information, which contains the SAPUI5 version and the tool edition type, has been moved to the User Menu on the top right of the screen. The About information now also contains the SAP global account ID and the SAP BTP Subaccount ID for all instances in SAP HANA Cloud Central. This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117641.title: About information moved to User Menu

592117642.text:
If you are connected to an SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database instance, you can now use the Analyze menu from the SQL Console. Use the menu to generate a SQL Analyzer plan file or a compiled execution plan.See:
- [Generate a SQL Analyzer Plan File](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/9c3b2967874e415d98ed14479fa66514.html)
- [View Execution Plans for SQL Statements, Procedures, and Anonymous Blocks](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/941c08281ab1419ba34dd4b9dc9a1a60.html)
- [SQL Analyzer Tool for SAP HANA Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_SQL_ANALYZER/d1a813bf1e334989a33c0364cbb9dffa/e5681cd520e94c308e4c2594b2ad5db8.html)
592117642.title: New Analyze menu in the SQL Console

592117643.text: The private link configuration option is now available for Alibaba Cloud.See [Configure Private Link with Alibaba Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_CN/1f64fe39189f4176bf659e737d62222a/7eea8e6d32264811aece1fa37a48f8fe.html).
592117643.title: Private link for Alibaba Cloud

592117644.text: The private link configuration option is now available for Microsoft Azure.See [Configure Private Link with Microsoft Azure](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/configure-private-link-with-microsoft-azure).
592117644.title: Private link for Microsoft Azure

592117645.text: You can upgrade Data Access Agents to the latest version when it's available. New versions typically include enhancements such as improved adapters and bug fixes. These updates are vital for maintaining optimal performance and security standards.
592117645.title: Version upgrade for Data Access Agents

592117646.text:
You can now select a Compute Location to process SQL on Files queries in parallel across multiple elastic compute nodes (ECNs) using distributed query processing.
See [Set a Compute Location for Distributed Query Processing](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/e5760383353449a0b3cc5536bb694371.html).
592117646.title: Parallel processing of SQL on Files queries on elastic compute nodes

592117647.text:
The active-active (read-enabled) replica capability is now automatically available for all synchronous high-availability replicas. You can use an SQL hint to route read operations to the replica, freeing up resources on the source.
See [Active/Active (Read-Enabled) Replicas](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/cf23102e98b94b86b6cbaca493bca4be.html).
592117647.title: Active-active (read-enabled) replica

592117648.text:
You can now view timestamps for when database security objects were created and relationships were established. This includes creation times for user groups, roles, providers, and security mappings, as well as grant times for permissions. These timestamps are displayed in list and detail views and can be configured as optional or mandatory.
See:
- [User Group Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/899d2b594e1a456cb402cacd9ba5a6ba.html)
- [Database Role and Role Group Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/9e4297e31dc7462780cb766a41732b98.html)
- [Identity Providers Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/e4e1a97b76fb4ad6b00031dfdc06cafc.html)
- [Database User Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/3e602f2b38954a6abd83d85aae7594e6.html)
592117648.title: Creation and Assignment Times for Database Security Objects

592117649.text: SAP HANA Cloud Central now supports creating and managing partitions using partition names, complementing the existing support for partition names in DML and DDL SQL statements in SAP HANA.
592117649.title: Named partitions support

592117650.text:
Added a query testing setting in the SQL Plan Advisor app. You can now configure testing to run automatically or manually. Manual registration in the SQL Plan Advisor app is no longer supported, but you can still manually register queries using the built-in procedure.
See [Using the SQL Plan Advisor in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/3ba8526ff2774af7b7af08da0ebe3f31.html).
592117650.title: SQL Plan Advisor App Enhancement

592117651.text:
You can now save query execution plans directly in your database instance and manage them in the Saved Plans app.
See [Saving and Downloading Execution Plans](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/dbf1a3f3926044959be233b5690f6634.html).
592117651.title: Saved Plans App

592117652.text:
In the Database Objects app, you can now create virtual tables for Apache Iceberg on a SQL on Files remote source that uses the File adapter.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117652.title: Create SQL on Files virtual tables for Apache Iceberg in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117653.text: In the provisioning wizard, the manual configuration flows have been improved with better grouped steps and single-column layout that makes it easier to review and enter settings. The review page has been redesigned to provide a clearer summary of your configuration before provisioning. Additionally, the workflow to create a cloned SAP HANA database now uses the same single-column layout for a more consistent experience.
592117653.title: Improved provisioning wizard

592117654.text:
You can now perform Near Zero Downtime (NZD) operations on SAP HANA Cloud instances with installed plugins, including:
- Upgrading or updating an instance with installed plugins without a restart
- Adding or removing plugins for an instance without a restart
See [Upgrading Without a Restart (Near Zero Downtime Upgrades)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/c26e42e6a7a4411191441c8d48fd9b11).
592117654.title: Near Zero Downtime (NZD) operations for SAP HANA Cloud Instances with Plugins

592117655.text: The Capacity Unit (CU) cost per month is now also displayed in Euros.
592117655.title: The SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator enhancement

592117656.text: The private link configuration option is now available for Google Cloud.See [Configure Private Link with Google Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/configure-private-link-with-google-cloud).
592117656.title: Private link for Google Cloud

592117657.text:
You can now get details on the size and access patterns of your tables to help you asses how critical each table is for your business applications.
See [Analyze Table Usage](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/analyze-table-usage).
592117657.title: Table usage analysis tool

592117658.text: You can now click on the All Instances dropdown menu and select specific views for the All Instances page that allow you to filter your instances by instance type.
592117658.title: Specify All Instances views

592117659.text:
You can now compare alert rule configurations across multiple instances to help maintain consistent monitoring practices and identify configuration discrepancies.
See [Comparing Alert Rules](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/comparing-alert-rules).
592117659.title: Compare alert rules

592117660.text:
Use the Performance Monitor app to get detailed charts and insights into the memory, storage usage, and other key performance indicators (KPIs) of your instances.
See [Using the Performance Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/using-performance-monitor-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
592117660.title: Performance Monitor

592117661.text: You can now view graph workspaces using the Graph Viewer tab in Database Objects.See [View Graph Workspaces in Database Objects](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/work-with-graph-workspaces-in-sap-hana-database-explorer-sap-hana-database).
592117661.title: View Graph Workspaces

592117662.text: You can now run long-running SQL queries in the background without keeping your browser session open. A new Background Statements tab lets you monitor status, view results, download output, and manage activities directly from the SQL Console. See [Run a Query as a Background Statement in SAP HANA Cloud Central](a967d1c4ca4a40989ca1509cbba13a34.html).
592117662.title: Run a Query as a Background Statement in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117663.text:
The SQL Console will now automatically save content. This setting is enabled by default.
See [SQL Console Settings](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/connection-settings?locale=en-US&version=LATEST).
592117663.title: Automatic Saving and Loading of SQL Consoles

592117664.text:
The instance page now displays the KMS key ID used for encrypting the SAP HANA Cloud instance and clearer encryption status display values.
See [Customer-Managed Keys](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/customer-controlled-encryption-keys-ccek).
592117664.title: CMK encryption key status

592117665.text:
The instance page now displays the KMS key ID used for encrypting the SAP HANA Cloud, data lake instance and clearer encryption status display values.
See [Customer-Managed Keys](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/customer-controlled-encryption-keys-ccek).
592117665.title: CMK encryption key status

592117666.text:
It is now possible to view the number of log entries for each audit policy in the Auditing application. Navigate to the column settings to enable the Log Count column.
See [Auditing Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c6c1dbc66caa41499f173220503aec94.html).
592117666.title: Audit Policy Log Count

592117667.text:
It is now possible to configure X.509 identity providers for automatic user creation in conjunction with LDAP group authorization.
See [Add an X.509 Identity Provider](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/35f103e2f81f46ef8409d6125f6dd2e9.html).
592117667.title: Automatic User Creation for X.509 Authentication

592117668.text:
The Index Advisor analyzes database performance and creates recommendations for indexing tables. This can reduce operational costs and improve performance.
See [About the Index Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/about-index-advisor).
592117668.title: Index Advisor

592117669.text:
The Partition Advisor analyzes database performance and creates recommendations for partitioning tables. The partitioning recommendations can help optimize data distribution, lower running costs, and save time for database administrators.
See [About the Partition Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/about-Partition-advisor).
592117669.title: Partition Advisor

592117670.text: Role group-based tenant usage allows for streamlined role management by ensuring roles are granted only within their designated groups.
592117670.title: Role Group-Based Tenant Usage

592117671.text: Your selected filters and sorting preferences in the Plan Trace application are now retained after a page refresh or when navigating to another section.
592117671.title: Persistent filters and sorting in Plan Trace

592117672.text: You can now update all captured abstract SQL plans (ASPs) to the latest SAP HANA database version in the SQL Plan Stability app.
592117672.title: Update captured abstract SQL plans

592117673.text:
Configure multiple alert rules and apply them to one or more instances by creating sets.
See [Creating Alert Rule Sets in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/creating-alert-rule-templates-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
592117673.title: Create alert rule sets

592117674.text: The provisioning wizard presets have been restructured for clarity, with separate options for SAP HANA database and data lake.
592117674.title: Enhanced instance creation presets

592117675.text: You can now create, edit, and delete SAP HANA smart data integration agents, agent groupings, adapters, and remote subscriptions from the Database Objects app.
592117675.title: Manage SAP HANA smart data integration objects

592117676.text: The tables listing all schemas, HDI containers, and credentials of database tenants include a Creation Time column.
592117676.title: Creation time

592117677.text: The private link configuration option is now available for Microsoft Azure.See [Configure Private Link with Microsoft Azure](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/configure-private-link-with-microsoft-azure).
592117677.title: Private link for Microsoft Azure

592117678.text:
The Certificate & Private Key Management application introduces a separate section for displaying own certificates and their chain certificates, improving clarity and organization.
See [Certificate Collection Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/38940aba559b4b6c96920424efc890c4.html).
592117678.title: Enhanced Certificate Chain Display

592117679.text:
You can now view an "Activation Time" column in the Audit Policy application. This enhancement allows you to easily view the activation time of enabled audit policies, providing better visibility and management of policy statuses.
See [Auditing Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c6c1dbc66caa41499f173220503aec94.html).
592117679.title: Activation Time Display in Audit Policy

592117680.text: You can use the new Schemas & HDI Containers application to view information and perform actions on all schemas and HANA Deployment Infrastructure (HDI) containers available in your SAP BTP subaccount.See [Using Schemas & HDI Containers in SAP HANA Cloud Central](caf464055fc9424c98257d57c93a0d08.html).
592117680.title: New Schemas & HDI Containers application

592117681.text:
You can now automatically double your storage size when your disk usage reaches the configured threshold that triggers an Error level HDBDiskUsage alert event.See [SAP HANA Database Size](19a526792d5044609ed947a589047d4c.html).
For related parameters for command line actions, see [Create an SAP HANA Database Instance Using the CLI](03982b3b93664f089b084713285e3c81.html).
592117681.title: Automatic storage upsizing

592117682.text: You can now enable Single Sign-On for data lake Files to access your instance automatically instead of using X.509 certificates.
592117682.title: Single Sign-On support for data lake Files

592117683.text: Use the Schemas & HDI Containers app to view information and perform actions on all schemas and HDI containers available in your SAP BTP subaccount.See [Using Schemas & HDI Containers in SAP HANA Cloud Central](caf464055fc9424c98257d57c93a0d08.html).
592117683.title: Schemas & HDI Containers app now available

592117684.text: When you create a thin clone for your data lake instance, you can now choose a specific backup from which to create the thin clone.
592117684.title: Select backup for creating thin clone

592117685.text: Use the Data Access Agent row to determine the number of capacity units (CU) used when you add DAAs to your SAP HANA Cloud instance.See [The SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/sap-hana-cloud-capacity-unit-estimator).
592117685.title: SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator now includes Data Access Agents (DAAs)

592117686.text: Adapters will now be listed on the home page with properties coming from the PUBLIC.ADAPTERS system table in the Database Objects app. You can also now view agent information from adapter object details, remove an agent from the adapter agent list, and view adapter agent information in adapter object details.
592117686.title: Improvements to Adapter list and Adapter details page in the Database Objects app

592117687.text: The Database Objects app now has Remote Servers and Users object types. The Users object type is available in both data lake Relational Engine and SAP HANA database. The Remote Servers object type is available in data lake Relational Engine.
592117687.title: New remote servers and users object types in the Database Objects app

592117688.text: The free tier license now only supports the minimum configuration of 1 vCPU, 16 GB memory, and 80 GB storage. Downgrading existing free tier instances to 16 GB memory is not supported. You can continue using them, upgrade them to paid tier, or delete them.
592117688.title: Free tier license supports 16 GB memory

592117689.text: You can now filter dependencies for the Table, Function, Graph Workspace, JSON Collection, Procedure, Sequence, Synonym, Table Type, Trigger, and View object types using the Dependencies tab in the Database Objects app.
592117689.title: Filter dependencies in the Database Objects app

592117690.text: You can now choose the hyperscaler SAP Cloud Infrastructure in the SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator to calculate capacity units.See [The SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator](a43859a94085464683f6fef248894ec4.html).
592117690.title: New hyperscaler SAP Cloud Infrastructure available in the SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator

592117691.text: Joule with limited features is free to use until it is replaced with the official Joule. You also no longer need to be a subaccount administrator to enable Joule with limited features for your subaccount in SAP HANA Cloud Central. Instead, you must have the SAP HANA Cloud Administrator role collection.
592117691.title: Joule with limited features

592117692.text: The SAP HANA Cloud Central now has an SAP HANA Smart Data Integration card on the Overview page. This new tile allows you to easily monitor database objects related to SAP HANA Smart Data Integration.
592117692.title: New SAP HANA Smart Data Integration card

592117693.text: When provisioning or updating a data lake Relational Engine instance on AWS, you can now select the High Memory performance class for coordinator and worker nodes. Nodes with this performance class have a larger amount of memory per vCPU than nodes in the Compute performance class.See [Data Lake Relational Engine Size](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/e0ed83be0bce4db5b5678f6f3fd56068.html)
592117693.title: Performance classes (Amazon Web Services)

592117694.text:
You can now hide SAP-managed user and user groups, enabling you to focus on your own work-related objects.See [Manage a Database User](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/170661cb39154d1da84b3c1a41b5bf7b.html)
See [Manage a User Group](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/0348c2350fae4d038c99eb75d613b23a.html)
592117694.title: User and User Group List Filter

592117695.text: You can set the priority when creating X.509 providers to control the order of authentication checks, ensuring preferred providers are prioritized. If no priority value is provided during creation, a lower priority is automatically be assigned.
592117695.title: X.509 Identity Provider Prioritization

592117696.text: You can now view tenant object and user names, allowing for easier analysis of tenant-related activities. This feature is useful for identifying and tracking tenant associations with users and objects.
592117696.title: Audit Log with Tenant Information

592117697.text:
You can now hide SAP-managed certificates and certificate collections, enabling you to focus on your own objects.See [Certificate Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/58313e8058c2430ba6987dde86fb9400.html)
[Certificate Collection Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/a2756b42b90f409ba004ffdcbbf0594e.html)
592117697.title: Certificate Management List Filter

592117698.text: An audit policy can now include a filter based on authentication methods, allowing users to specify which methods should or should not trigger event logging.See [Auditing Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c6c1dbc66caa41499f173220503aec94.html).
592117698.title: Audit Policy with Authentication Method Filter

592117699.text: You can now create tenant role groups to facilitate the secure transfer of roles during tenant moves, ensuring that necessary authorizations are preserved and automatically granted to new tenant users.See [Create a Role Group](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/6690d6427936439fb3570edbdae2264e.html).
592117699.title: Tenant Role Groups

592117700.text: You can now create virtual objects from remote objects for SAP HANA Smart Data Integration (SDI) and SAP HANA Smart Data Access (SDA) remote sources using the Database Objects app.
592117700.title: Create virtual objects from remote sources

592117701.text: You can now preview a table repartition to visualize the mapping between the source and target partitions in the partitioning wizard.
592117701.title: Preview table repartitioning

592117702.text: In the provisioning wizard, you can now create SAP HANA Cloud instances using preset configurations to simplify the instance creation process. Among the presets, you can choose the Most Used, Last Used, or Best Available configurations.You also now have the option of selecting a JSON configuration if you want to either upload your instance configuration as a JSON file or manually enter your configuration parameters in JSON format.
592117702.title: Simplified provisioning wizard

592117703.text:
You can now browse, install, update, and uninstall SAP Business Data Cloud data products for SAP HANA database instances.
See [Consuming Data Products in SAP HANA Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/75fe8d7cad904f858485a2b3aa5aff07.html).
592117703.title: Install, update, and uninstall SAP Business Data Cloud datae products

592117704.text:
In the Database Objects app, you can now create a virtual table for a Delta table on a SQL on Files remote source that uses the File adapter.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117704.title: Create SQL on Files virtual tables for Delta tables in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117705.text:
In the Database Objects app, you can now browse for the remote file path when you create a virtual table for a SQL on Files remote source that uses the File adapter.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117705.title: Browse for files when you create SQL on Files virtual tables in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117706.text:
Create a thin clone of a standalone (non-managed) data lake Relational Engine from the latest available backup.
[Thin Clone](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/administration-guide-for-data-lake-relational-engine/thin-clone)
592117706.title: Create a thin clone of a data lake Relational Engine

592117707.text: You can now configure subaccount level alert rules in SAP HANA Cloud Central for SAP HANA database instances. See [Open Alerts in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/b8cc733919ff40eb8725ef47316c840b.html)
592117707.title: Configure alert rules in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117708.text: You can now filter for tenants in the Database Objects app for SAP HANA database instances only.
592117708.title: Filter for tenants in the Database Objects app for SAP HANA database instances

592117709.text: You can now use the Consumption Monitor to inspect your usage of data lake Files instances. Inspect your usage by selecting See Actual Consumption from the Overview page.See [Consumption Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central | SAP Help Portal](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/consumption-monitor)
592117709.title: Use the Consumption Monitor to inspect your usage of data lake Files instances

592117710.text: You can now increase the amount of time that snapshots will be retained for your data lake Files instance. The minimum snapshot retention time is 15 days. See [Restoring Data in Data Lake Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/user-guide-for-data-lake-files/restoring-data-in-data-lake-files)
592117710.title: Change snapshot retention time for a data lake Files instance in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117711.text:
When provisioning a database instance, you can enable customer-managed keys through integration with SAP Data Custodian Key Management Service.
See [Customer-Managed Keys](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/customer-controlled-encryption-keys-ccek)
592117711.title: Enable customer-managed keys for SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database instances

592117712.text:
You can now disable the document store without a service request. See:
- [SAP HANA Database Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/sap-hana-database-configuration)

Additionally, the Execution Time column in the Traced Plans table has been renamed to Duration. 592117716.title: State column for database tenants

592117717.text:
You now have the ability to bind specific authorizations to specific trusts for data lake Files. Binding trusts to authorizations increases security and simplifies the management of trusts and authorization records.
See:
- [Managing Certificates in Data Lake Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-data-lake/user-guide-for-data-lake-files/managing-trusts-in-data-lake-files-container)

592117718.title: Instance snapshot with synchronous replica

592117719.title: Instance Copying

592117720.text:
You can now recover an SAP HANA instance using a cloning template and deploy it into an existing SAP HANA instance.

592117720.title: Template recovery into existing SAP HANA Cloud instance

For instructions on how to subscribe to and access SAP HANA Cloud Central, multi-environment edition, see [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools (Multi-Environment)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/subscribing-to-sap-hana-cloud-administration-tools).

592117724.text: You can now view adapters, agents, agent groups, and remote subscriptions in the Database Objects app.

592117725.text: You can now directly download an actual execution plan to your local system without the need to first save it to the database diagnostic folder.See [Download an Executed Plan File](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/9c3b2967874e415d98ed14479fa66514.html).
592117725.title: Direct download of execution plans to local system

592117726.text: Use the Elastic Compute Nodes (ECN) row to determine the number of capacity units (CU) used when you enable ECNs in your SAP HANA Cloud Central instance.See [The SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/sap-hana-cloud-capacity-unit-estimator).
592117726.title: SAP HANA Cloud Capacity Unit Estimator now includes Elastic Compute Nodes

592117727.text: You can now view the file content for a data lake Files instance in SAP HANA Cloud Central using the File Content tab.
592117727.title: View file content for a data lake Files instance

592117728.text: You can now view cube objects in the Database Objects app.
592117728.title: View cubes in the Database Objects app

592117729.text: You can now delete objects in SAP HANA Cloud Central using the Database Objects app.
592117729.title: Delete objects in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117730.text: You can now restore snapshots of deleted or overwritten data from data lake Files in SAP HANA Cloud Central.
592117730.title: Restore data lake Files data in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117731.text: You can now use Gen AI in SAP HANA Cloud Central to generate alerts summaries and issue summaries for your database instances. These capabilities provide quick insights and recommended actions to resolve issues.
592117731.title: Alerts and issue summary capabilities in Gen AI

592117732.text: Customer-controlled encryption keys are automatically enabled and configured for data lake instances and don't require a KMS key ID.
592117732.title: Customer-controlled encryption keys automatically enabled for SAP HANA Cloud, data lake instances

592117733.text:
Use the private link configuration option to establish connections between services in your Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) and data lake.
[SAP HANA Cloud Private Link](3bf51e391ea34461be86406d468ac0ca.html)
592117733.title: Private Link

592117734.text: Use the Data Lake Files app to browse files and manage access policies in your data lake Files instance. See [Open Data Lake Files in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/open-data-lake-files-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
592117734.title: Access and review your data lake Files instances

592117735.text: You can now capture details of executed Multidimensional Services (MDS) queries in the Plan Trace application and download their execution plans for further analysis.
592117735.title: Capture multidimensional services queries in Plan Trace

592117736.text:
Gen AI in SAP HANA Cloud Central includes Joule with limited features, along with AI-assisted database administration capabilities. Gen AI in SAP HANA Cloud Central is available at no additional cost until July 2025, subject to usage limits and applicable terms. In SAP HANA Cloud Central, Gen AI includes the following capabilities:
- Alert summary generation
- App navigation
- SQL generation
- Informational Q&A
592117736.title: Gen AI supported in SAP HANA Cloud Central

592117737.text:
Enable the Triple Store additional feature for an SAP HANA database instance to use the SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph engine.
You can view RDF named graphs in SAP HANA database instances on the Database Objects page.
This feature is only available in the multi-environment edition of SAP HANA Cloud Central. To use the multi-environment edition, follow the instructions here: [Subscribing to the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/784a1dbb421a4da29fb1e3bdf5f198ec.html).
592117737.title: SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph engine support

592117738.text:
An optimized design is available for creating and editing workload classes and workload class mappings to manage workload in SAP HANA Cloud Central.
See [Create or Edit a Workload Class](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/create-workload-class)
592117738.title: Create workload classes in SAP HANA Cloud Central

593344768.text: SAP HANA Cloud is available in the following SAP sovereign cloud landscapes: Australia (AWS), Canada (AWS), United Kingdom (AWS), USA (AWS GovCloud), India (AWS), and Europe (SAP Cloud Infrastructure). For more information, see [Data Center Availability in SAP HANA Cloud](6c104f33f16e48579ee52858c13a9405.html) and [Memory and Storage Sizes Supported by SAP HANA Database](798c2c6ba7ae41e898f423aa34491ac3.html).
593344768.title: HANA Cloud available in Sovereign Cloud

593344769.text:
SAP HANA Cloud now offers Agent Memory Service, a service plan (hana-agent-memory) that gives AI agents persistent memory. Provisioned on SAP BTP through SAP HANA Cloud, it stores durable, semantically searchable memories and chronological messages, associated with an agent and invoker, through a standard OData REST API with OAuth 2.0 authentication.
See [SAP HANA Cloud Agent Memory Service Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-agent-memory-service-guide/).
593344769.title: SAP HANA Cloud Agent Memory Service

593344770.text:
Multitenancy in SAP HANA Cloud natively provides tenant-aware data management features. It is now supported in the Alibaba Cloud data center.
Note that Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) are not supported.
See: [SAP HANA Cloud Multitenancy Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_CN/80402af83be54ff39ab39915224c0c0b/172f93968dfe45f09bf8c14b2ca9582d.html)
593344770.title: Multitenancy supported in Alibaba Cloud data center

593344771.text:
Plugin upgrades no longer require instances to be running. When you upgrade plugins on a stopped instance, the changes will be applied automatically the next time the instance starts.
See:
- [SAP HANA Database Upgrades and Patches](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/6ced4d164e234b74aa9bea82435ce9a8.html)

593344771.title: Plugins upgrade automatically when stopped instances restart

593344772.text:
The following capabilities are now supported in SAP HANA Cloud on SAP Business Data Cloud:
- Federation to on-premise SAP HANA, SAP IQ databases, and SAP ABAP systems
- Remote table replication (RTR) from on-premise SAP HANA databases
See: [Data Access in the SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/data-access-in-sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database)
593344772.title: Federation and RTR capabilities in SAP HANA Cloud on SAP Business Data Cloud

593344773.text:
To connect SAP HANA Cloud to on-premise systems using the Cloud Connector, you must now also create a hana-cloud-option service plan instance with the connectivity option in the SAP BTP subaccount where your SAP HANA Cloud instance is deployed using the command-line interface (CLI) or SAP BTP cockpit. Your existing connections continue to work during the transition period. You must create this service instance before October 1, 2026 (date subject to change). If you do not, your Cloud Connector connections to on-premise systems will fail.
See:
- [SAP HANA Database Cloud Connector](dfd8627377e44f71b41f6f4cbf431db0.html)
- SAP Note [3751673](https://me.sap.com/notes/3751673)
593344773.title: New prerequisite for SAP HANA Cloud Connector

593344774.text:
SAP HANA Cloud is now available as a core component in SAP Business Data Cloud. This means you can use SAP Business Data Cloud credits to provision an SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database.
See:
- SAP Note [3737180](https://me.sap.com/notes/3737180 )
- [Provisioning SAP HANA Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/business-data-cloud/administering-sap-business-data-cloud-dev/provisioning-sap-hana-cloud)
593344774.title: SAP HANA Cloud now a core component in SAP Business Data Cloud

593344775.text:
You can now migrate to SAP HANA Cloud with a Visual Studio Code extension. The SAP HANA Application Migration Visual Studio Code extension streamlines the migration process by providing dedicated tools and guidance within the development environment.
See:
- [Install Application Migration Extension for SAP HANA](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-migration-guide/install-application-migration-extension-for-sap-hana)
- [Migrate an XS Classic Application to SAP CAP and SAP HANA Cloud with the SAP HANA Application Migration in Visual Studio Code](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-migration-guide/migrate-xs-classic-application-to-sap-cap-and-sap-hana-cloud-with-sap-hana-application-migration-assistant-in-visual-studio-code)
- [Migrate an XS Classic Application to SAP HANA Native with the SAP HANA Application Migration in Visual Studio Code](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-migration-guide/migrate-xs-classic-application-to-sap-hana-native-with-sap-hana-application-migration-assistant-in-visual-studio-code)

593344775.title: SAP HANA Application Migration Visual Studio Code extension

593344776.text:
New SAP Cloud Infrastructure landscapes US01 in U.S. East, JP01 in Tokyo/Japan, Microsoft Azure landscapes EU22 in Germany West Central, and UK20 in UK South/London are now available.
See: [Domains and IP Ranges](6f4f082320df40c5994765d8c2df0a9b.html)
593344776.title: New landscapes US01, EU22, JP01, and UK20

593344777.text: With the Self-Service Migration tool, you can now choose to migrate only the data of the selected database objects based on your requirements. For more information see [Migrate an SAP HANA On-Premise Database to SAP HANA Cloud](875d41eba28c4f12b272e48fbb55350e.html).
593344777.title: Support for data-only migration now available

593344778.text:
