See: [Domains and IP Ranges](6f4f082320df40c5994765d8c2df0a9b.html)
593344778.title: New landscapes AP01 and US02

593344779.text: With the Self-Service Migration tool, you can now choose to migrate your full SAP HANA on-premise database with the option to exclude database users, or migrate selectively by schemas, or by XS Advanced service instances. With selective migration, you can migrate your SAP HANA on-premise database in iterations. For more information see [Migrate an SAP HANA On-Premise Database to SAP HANA Cloud](875d41eba28c4f12b272e48fbb55350e.html).
593344779.title: Support for full migration with excluded database users and selective migration now available

593344780.text: Regardless of your runtime environment, you can use public APIs to retrieve information on SAP HANA Cloud's available service offerings and their available versions for provisioning and version upgrades. For more information, see [Instance Management on SAP Business Accelerator Hub](https://api.sap.com/api/InventoryServiceAPI/overview).
593344780.title: Instance Management REST APIs to retrieve available service offerings

593344781.text: Before specifying availability zones for a database instance provisioned in a Microsoft Azure region, you must first get the zone mappings between your Microsoft Azure subscriptions and SAP HANA Cloud. You can now use the public API available in [Instance Management on SAP Business Accelerator Hub](https://api.sap.com/api/InventoryServiceAPI/overview) to get the mapping information.
593344781.title: Instance Management REST APIs to retrieve Microsoft Azure zone mappings

593344782.text:

See: [Domains and IP Ranges](6f4f082320df40c5994765d8c2df0a9b.html)
593344782.title: New landscapes AE01, and EU02

593344791.title: Share database tenants

Where supported, replica coverage is activated automatically. See [Replica Support for ESS Alerts and Collectors](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-embedded-statistics-service-catalog-sys-statistics-reference/embedded-statistics-service-sys-vr-replica-schema).
595244588.title: Replica Support for ESS Alerts and Collectors

595244589.text:
You can now provision database instances with 16GB memory for Microsoft Azure regions. Use this option for cost-sensitive workloads that don't require larger instance sizes.
See [Managing Smaller SAP HANA Instances](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/9bce6654977c4dd6ac98f885f15835f5.html).
595244589.title: Support for small 16GB database instances

595244590.text:
The NSE advisor now supports spatial data. You can get recommendations on the load unit of your spatial columns, and tables or partitions with spatial columns, according to how frequently they are accessed.
See [Spatial Columns in SAP HANA's Native Storage Extension](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/4aba163f8928439ba69024c430a9a606.html).
595244590.title: Support of spatial columns in NSE Advisor

595244591.text:
You can now create three-level partitioned tables using HASH-RANGE-RANGE and HASH-HASH-RANGE structures in SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database. Three-level partitioning extends the existing two-level partitioning support. The third level is always range partitioning. For HASH-HASH-RANGE structures, enabling a third level also allows the number of second-level hash partitions to differ across first-level partitions, which is not possible in standard two-level HASH-HASH structures.
See [Partitioning Tables Using SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/1904e0a4edbf465c9b131ae53cf25972.html).
595244591.title: Three-Level Partitioning for Tables

595244592.text:
You can now use the SUBSTRING function as a partition expression to partition tables on a fixed segment of an NVARCHAR column value. Date and time partition expressions such as YEAR(), MONTH(), and HOUR() apply only to date and time columns. For NVARCHAR columns that follow a structured format, you can now use SUBSTRING to achieve equivalent partitioning behavior. For example, you can partition a table by the year segment of an SAP S/4HANA fiscal year period column.
See [Partitioning Using the SUBSTRING Function](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d318d56f2052402f9722b332a1f2943d.html).
595244592.title: SUBSTRING Partitioning for NVARCHAR Columns

595244593.text:
The SAP Alert Notification service for SAP BTP now supports alerts for Data Access Agent instances. Three lifecycle alert rules are available for Data Access Agent instances and can be retrieved and managed via the Alerts API. You can enable or disable these rules per instance, but check interval and severity thresholds cannot be modified.
See [SAP Business Accelerator Hub](https://api.sap.com/api/AlertsAPI/overview).
595244593.title: Alert support for Data Access Agent instances

595244594.text:
You can use the M_JOB_PROGRESS system view to get real-time progress information for remote table replication operations, including table replication activation and the initial load of a remote subscription.
See [M_JOB_PROGRESS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/1f222c2a4cdd4fda9eb4c82788e5a7e5.html).
595244594.title: Monitor real-time progress of the remote table replication initial load

595244595.text:
In a multi-region disaster recovery setup, you can upgrade and apply configuration changes without a restart only on the primary region source instance.
See [Multi-Region Disaster Recovery](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/14c2ffe2d13542fc894383a8536177b4.html).
595244595.title: Near-zero downtime operations on primary source instance

595244596.text:
The Metering API now includes two new metrics for SAP HANA data lake file services: HDLFSNodeRequestCategory1 and HDLFSNodeRequestCategory2, which track the number of object store read and write requests. You can use these metrics to monitor and attribute object store request usage in detail.
See [Metering Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/metering-metrics).
595244596.title: Metrics for SAP HANA Data Lake File Services

595244597.text:
You can now include calculation views alongside tables, views, and functions in the Data Exploration Tools to answer natural language questions based on your data.
See [Managing Data Exploration Tools in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ceb43558ceae4f85b51df0c2a8a5478c.html).
595244597.title: Use Calculation Views in Data Exploration Tools

595244598.text:
You can now configure a custom check interval (in seconds) for ESS alert rules using the Alert Rules PATCH API, enabling per-instance control of alert evaluation frequency. The GET alert rules API returns the configured interval for each rule.
See [SAP Business Accelerator Hub](https://api.sap.com/api/AlertsAPI/resource/Alert_Rules).
595244598.title: Configure custom check interval for ESS alerts

595244599.text:
Two new monitoring views, `M_SERVICE_REPLICATION_SECONDARY` (asynchronous replication) and `M_VOLUME_REPLICATION_REPLICA_STATISTICS` (synchronous replication), are now available in SAP HANA Cloud. Administrators working with active/active (read-enabled) replicas can use these views to verify replica health and routing success.
See:
- [M_SERVICE_REPLICATION_SECONDARY System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/m-service-replication-secondary-system-view)
- [M_VOLUME_REPLICATION_REPLICA_STATISTICS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/m-volume-replication-replica-statistics-system-view)
595244599.title: Monitoring Views for Replica

595244600.text:
SAP HANA now supports ABAP-specific workload routing through the new APPLICATION WORKLOAD workload mapping property and the APPLICATIONWORKLOAD session variable. This allows you to map sessions to the intended workload class dynamically, including optional wildcard-based matching.
See [Properties for Workload Class Mappings](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/properties-for-workload-class-mappings).
595244600.title: ABAP-specific Workload Routing

595244601.text:
The Workload Classes Management app has new options to view and configure workload classes per node role. You can now control resource consumption on active/active (read-enabled) replica nodes using workload classes and mappings, giving you the same resource management capabilities on replicas as on the source node.
See [Configure Workload Classes for Active/Active Replicas with SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/configure-workload-classes-for-active-active-replicas-with-sap-hana-cloud-central).
595244601.title: Workload Class Support for Active/Active (Read-Enabled) Replicas

595244602.text:
You can now create triggers on system-versioned tables that use transactional system-time. Previously, attempting to create a trigger on such tables returned a feature-not-supported error.
See [System-Versioned Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/91302b26f62c4433bbc58e0a951cdc1d.html).
595244602.title: Trigger Creation Now Available for Transactional System-Time Tables

595244603.text:
You can use the Analytics Advisor in HANA Cloud Central to analyze query performance and get recommendations for creating MDS cubes to speed up multidimensional queries.
See [About the Analytics Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/fbbc2664ec7040958d24b76fcdaa292b.html).
595244603.title: New Analytics Advisor for Optimization of Multidimensional Queries

595244604.text:
The NSE advisor now supports vector data. You can get recommendations on the load unit of your vector columns, and tables or partitions with vector columns, according to how frequently they are accessed.
See
- [Vector Columns in SAP HANA's Native Storage Extension](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c40cab369db246f1a17feea1c031ddc1/7fb81e64c9454ae4b088489bd8d41dda.html)
- [How the NSE Advisor Uses the Access Statistics Cache for Recommendations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/8ff17a941e324c7bb0f6453cbd55cea5.html)
595244604.title: Support of vector data in the NSE advisor

595244605.text:
You can now recover a database instance that contains tenants to any previous point in time. This allows you to restore both the main database and all tenant data together in a single recovery operation, ensuring everything remains synchronized and consistent.
See:
- [Feature Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/49d51b60b0bf44d1a657509f09128fd5.html)
- [Recover a Database Tenant](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/88c66597fd354447b4cda1546a317368.html)
595244605.title: Full Instance Recovery with Tenants

595244606.text:
You can now create audit policies that automatically apply to tables with the same name across all tenants. Previously, you had to manually update audit policies every time you added or removed a tenant. With the new wildcard schema support, a single audit policy can now monitor the same table across all tenant schemas without requiring updates when tenants are added or removed.
See:
- [Feature Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/49d51b60b0bf44d1a657509f09128fd5.html)
- [Best Practices and Recommendations for Creating Audit Policies](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/35eb4e567d53456088755b8131b7ed1d.html)
- [Performance Considerations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/7f6ec879e3a449f5a41e15071365ae8a.html)
595244606.title: Multi-Tenant Audit Policy Support

595244607.text:
You can now clone HANA instances that contain multi-tenant enabled HDI containers or schemas. Previously, cloning was blocked when native tenants existed due to tenant ID conflicts and metadata inconsistencies. The enhanced cloning process now properly handles tenant reassignment and metadata synchronization in the infrastructure layer.
See:
- [Feature Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/49d51b60b0bf44d1a657509f09128fd5.html)
- [Managing SAP HANA Cloud Database Tenants](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/3ce1a923e4284486987d9b93e140471d.html)
595244607.title: Instance Cloning with Multi-Tenant Native Tenants

595244608.text:
You can now provision database instances with 16GB memory for AWS regions. Use this option for cost-sensitive workloads that don't require larger instance sizes.
See [Managing Smaller SAP HANA Instances](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/9bce6654977c4dd6ac98f885f15835f5.html).
595244608.title: Support for small 16GB database instances

595244609.text:
You can now connect directly to an active/active (read-enabled) replica, enabling offloading of analytical workloads to the replica node without modifying SQL queries. You can also create replica-specific and source node-specific workload classes to apply differentiated resource limits.
See [Active/Active (Read-Enabled) Replicas](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/active-active-read-enabled).
595244609.title: Direct connection to active/active (read-enabled) replica

595244610.text:
The RESULT_LAG hint for routing queries to active/active (read-enabled) replicas now supports an optional lag time parameter, so you can specify a maximum acceptable replication lag.
See [Active/Active (Read-Enabled) Replicas](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/active-active-read-enabled).
595244610.title: Active/active (read-enabled) replica can be used with result lag time parameter

595244611.text:
The following new tenant resource usage metrics have been added:
- HDBActiveStatementCount
- HDBActiveThreadCount
See [Resource Usage Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/46e370ced3ef4d2bbd0ec2337df5f565.html).
595244611.title: New metrics available in Resource Usage Metrics

595244612.text:
The Threads application now shows effective limits, providing visibility into the memory and thread limits that were applied to each thread during execution. This is particularly helpful in scenarios with hierarchical workload classes. You can view effective limits for Total Statement Memory, Total Statement Thread, Statement Memory, and Statement Thread.
See [View Effective Thread Limits in the Threads Application](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/view-effective-thread-limits-in-threads-application).
595244612.title: Effective thread limits

595244613.text:
The following three new metrics have been added to the metering rest API:
- SharedCloudConnectorMemory
- SharedCloudConnectorNetworkEgress
- SharedCloudConnectorVCPU
See [Metering Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/219835166e9f4051a4bbc4c1dde5b2f3.html).
595244613.title: New SAP HANA Metering Metrics

595244614.text:
A new metric has been introduced AsynchronousReplicaNetworkEgress which shows network egress usage charge of a MR DR data replication feature.
See [Metering Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/219835166e9f4051a4bbc4c1dde5b2f3.html).
595244614.title: New SAP HANA Metering Metric

595244615.text: Download SQL execution plans from the Top 20 Statements in the Buffer Cache Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central to analyze query performance in the SQL Analyzer tool for SAP HANA.See [Monitor Buffer Cache](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/view-and-configure-buffer-cache-monitor).
595244615.title: Download SQL statements from the Buffer Cache Monitor

595244616.text:
When creating Data Exploration Tools, you can now select the AI model to use for the tool pair. Available models are GPT-4.1 (default) and Claude 4.6 Sonnet.
See [Managing Data Exploration Tools in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ceb43558ceae4f85b51df0c2a8a5478c.html).
595244616.title: Select AI Model for Data Exploration Tools

fields.Category: SAP HANA Analytics Catalog (BIMC Views) Reference

595244618.text:
You can classify calculation views with sensitivity labels such as PUBLIC, INTERNAL, or CONFIDENTIAL, and extend the dictionary with custom labels that match your organization's data protection policy.
See:
- [View BIMC_SENSITIVITY_CLASSIFICATION_VIEW](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/88fe5f56472e40cca6ef3c3dcab4855b/c7be8b580e1d4a59be76c571f4e71a09.html)
- [Table BIMC_SENSITIVITY_CLASSIFICATION](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/88fe5f56472e40cca6ef3c3dcab4855b/0d78d669a7ee4a29871368c9b680cfdd.html)
595244618.title: Sensitivity Classifications for Calculation Views

fields.Category: SAP HANA Analytics Catalog (BIMC Views) Reference

595244619.text:
You can retrieve the Core Schema Notation (CSN) representation of a calculation view, together with metadata that identifies the view and its intended usage, from the BIMC_CSN_MODELS_VIEW view.
See [View BIMC_CSN_MODELS_VIEW](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/88fe5f56472e40cca6ef3c3dcab4855b/72e4d0439ace41b7ad494825352a15be.html).
595244619.title: CSN Representation of Calculation Views

595244621.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now choose between Contains and Exact Match modes in the Find Data Sources dialog to improve search accuracy and locate data sources more quickly.
See:
- [Add Data Sources](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/9a0471a69dfd4f92b8c96cf14c731e12.html)
- [Create Analytic Privileges](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/fae191a207674f8bb7b91c37886717ad.html)
595244621.title: Calculation Views

595244622.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the Missing Record Search in the Debug Query tab to pinpoint the node in a calculation view where a specific record is filtered or dropped.
See:
- [Search for Missing Records](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/848c70167613433689b6a241da2341ec.html)
- [Debug Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/d8374203caa5410da8facd34432d398e.html)
595244622.title: Calculation Views

595244623.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now register MCP servers for GitHub Copilot directly from the SAP HANA Explorer and SAP HANA Database Explorer extensions in VS Code. The registration panel writes the correct entry into mcp.json for you, no manual file editing required.
See [Register an MCP Server in VS Code](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0c11ff7d73774f95a32c1dc207196962.html).
595244623.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244624.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use AI assistants such as GitHub Copilot with the SAP HANA Tools MCP server. The MCP server gives the AI live access to your SAP HANA Cloud instance and HDI container, enabling it to validate SQL, deploy HDI artifacts, create virtual tables, and search documentation - without you running any commands manually.
See [Using AI Assistants with the SAP HANA Tools MCP Server](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/ae9a5e600f404a81b84fb5d72926c569.html).
595244624.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244625.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now copy AI-generated table data directly to your clipboard in CSV or SQL format, for the current table or all generated tables. Copied content reflects your current edits, including unsaved changes.
See [Export AI-Generated Table Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/b3639e27f848452d824919f7ef70bb2f.html).
595244625.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244626.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for BAS, you can now bind an application to a multitenancy HDI container from both the hana-multitenancy-admin and hana-multitenancy plans, which the bind wizard lists together.
See [Bind an Application to an SAP HANA Cloud Multitenancy HDI Container](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4ceaeaaa83d74a3c9a0689e7c4127d89.html).
595244626.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244627.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now select and download individual trace files from a Trace Files table in the Database Explorer.
See [Work with Trace Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/af2307a303ca4aeb9ccfd9c2eea56d6c.html).
595244627.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244628.text:
You can now authenticate to SAP HANA databases using an X.509 certificate in the SAP HANA Database Explorer extension for VS Code and SAP Business Application Studio.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595244628.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244629.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, each data preview now opens in its own SQL console, preserving any changes or comments in previously opened SQL consoles.
See [Configuring Data Preview Behavior](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/92883c2b13c74649b183590c4b5744ae.html).
595244629.title: Calculation Views

595244630.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to generate, explain, and optimize expressions directly in the Expression editor
See:
- [Working with Expressions Using AI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/19358c16f6004f9ea06eda13d428f671.html)
- [Create Restricted Columns](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/c93b644f889d437cbfe05cc836990842.html)
- [Create Calculated Columns](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/5b9254316f854d0fbc3c326c88e8d2e8.html)
595244630.title: Calculation Views

595244631.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now assign an alias name and alias label to dimension views in a star join node to distinguish multiple instances of the same dimension view in analytic clients.
See [Create Calculation Views with Star Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/988f5a9bd87c4492ad5c1e6f7936f0b5.html).
595244631.title: Calculation Views

595244632.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now easily copy the calculation view name.
See [Copy the Calculation View Name](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/f9dd3400d75741a7a1d845b869ed0ae6.html).
595244632.title: Calculation Views

595244633.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now visualize the impact of columns.
See [View Column Impact](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/da579d2b54e14f6592069d0c2c376042.html).
595244633.title: Calculation Views

595244634.text:
You can now use the SIMPLE HDI API to grant and revoke privileges in SAP HANA Deployment Infrastructure (HDI) with simplified procedures. The API provides a streamlined alternative to the standard HDI privilege management procedures at three levels: DI, container group, and container.
See [SIMPLE HDI API Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/c95e5bdf13a34446bcf3b6c2f955adf5.html).
595244634.title: Simplified Privilege Management with the SIMPLE HDI API

595244635.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for Business Application Studio, you can now add, update, and delete table data in the Database Explorer without writing SQL. To open the table editor, choose Open Table Editor in the context menu of a table or view.
See [Edit Table Data in the Table Editor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/1f59a967bb404f94b6d3b202b6d2d536.html).
595244635.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244636.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Applications dev space, you can now debug SQLScript procedures, functions, and libraries directly in the SAP HANA Database Explorer extension. Yo can set breakpoints, inspect and modify variables, evaluate watch expressions, and step through code while it runs in the database.
See [Debugging SQLScript in the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/116ab56443e04a7b8f99770f74c2b9ae.html).
595244636.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244637.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for Business Application Sudio, you can now choose whether to include the target container of a database module when you bind or unbind multiple modules at once in the SAP HANA Project Explorer.
See:
- [User Preferences for SAP HANA Native Application Development Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/57e2fe608bb042d48b799d41a8d121a7.html)
- [Bind Applications to Database Services with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/a3865b12c0354c9fa312f88aa4572b7b.html)
595244637.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244638.text:
In SAP Business Application Studio, you can now enable optimized redeployment for calculation views in HDI containers to reduce deployment time when dependent views don't need to be recreated.
See [Optimized Redeployment of Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/4466fb5b5e3f4388a00b44aad5a4bffa/923c8522cc1c45149d7f8a71689b82fc.html).
595244638.title: Calculation Views

595244639.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, input parameter selection in rank nodes, window function nodes, and spatial join nodes now shows all available input parameters with their data types.
See:
- [Create Spatial Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/31fc420f33eb4daeb70858248e7a43e9.html)
- [Create Rank Nodes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/bc4c7c14e8e546458a9c8c8df449a5f4.html)
- [Create Window Function Nodes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/c8147ba7d406441986483f3a88accf0b.html)
595244639.title: Calculation Views

595244640.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use calculated measures in MDS cube definitions in addition to base measures and restricted measures.
See [Define an MDS Cube Based on Elements in a Calculation View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/0e5f70d8c7204cc69839aa9452717753.html).
595244640.title: Calculation Views

595244641.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now convert a join node to a non-equi join node directly from the node's context menu, without having to recreate the node from scratch.
See [Convert Joins to Non-Equi Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/99734ec0a8fe41ee851847ec2bceb9e3.html).
595244641.title: Calculation Views

595244642.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, a key column indicator now appears next to key columns in the Mapping tab for all node types.
See [Create Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/2cb2138c9fc04f6f87a3eb88d87df9d6.html).
595244642.title: Calculation Views

595244643.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, a new execution hint is now available that lets you route queries to an active/active (read-enabled) replica in high availability setups, reducing load on the source node for resource-intensive read workloads.
See:
- [Routing Queries to Active/Active (Read-Enabled) Replicas](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/4466fb5b5e3f4388a00b44aad5a4bffa/8ca921ede09f4393b60dd55d3f95fb1d.html)
- [Supported Execution Hints](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/e43c9257301e4bab9d9ad0d94ab8df2d.html)
595244643.title: Calculation Views

595244644.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the Bind to a recently used HDI container option in the SAP HANA Projects Explorer to quickly rebind a database module to one of its five most recently used HDI container services.
See [Bind an Application to an HDI-Container Service](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/6db6afae316847b99c5a78b6eb2e292e.html).
595244644.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244645.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space of SAP Business Application Studio, the Database Explorer now displays metadata for synonym objects, including details about the synonym and its target database object.
See:
- [Context-sensitive Actions on Database Objects in Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/777b7623ca9c4fb58b27ad9f2d5284a8.html)
- [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html)
595244645.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244646.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, database object names in the Statement Help panel of the SQL Console are now clickable links that open the corresponding detail page in the Database Objects application.
See [Options, Settings, and Tools in the SQL Console for SAP HANA](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/29ffdfba2e0f43cd892734f66e490b3f.html).
595244646.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244647.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now edit AI-generated table data directly in the Data Generation view before saving it to the database.
See [Generate Sample Data for Tables Using Generative AI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/5fef1c5b58114d598aa2063a31073254.html).
595244647.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244648.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Buisiness Application Studio, you can now open the SQL console directly from the context menu of database nodes and HDI containers in the database tree view, making it easier to run SQL in the selected context.
See [Context-sensitive Actions on Database Objects in Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/777b7623ca9c4fb58b27ad9f2d5284a8.html).
595244648.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244649.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now export AI-generated table data as CSV or SQL files, making it easier to reuse generated datasets outside the tool.
See [Export AI-Generated Table Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/b3639e27f848452d824919f7ef70bb2f.html).
595244649.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244650.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now browse and execute diagnostic SQL scripts from the SQL Statement Collection attached to SAP Note 1969700 in a dedicated tree view, making it easier to analyze SAP HANA systems directly from the development environment.
See [Analyze SAP HANA Systems Using the SQL Statement Collection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/d5cddc3c833047ce9036ddc57f3bc244.html).
595244650.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595244651.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, a key column icon now appears next to key columns in the Join Definition and Mapping tabs, helping you identify which columns to join and which cardinality to set. The icon appears in three states: golden for a complete key, golden dashed for an incomplete key, and gray when the key property may have been removed by an intermediate operation.
See [Create Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/2cb2138c9fc04f6f87a3eb88d87df9d6.html).
595244651.title: Calculation Views

595244652.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use incremental loading to update an MDS cube with only newly added records since the last load, reducing processing time and memory consumption.
See [Define an MDS Cube Based on Elements in a Calculation View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/0e5f70d8c7204cc69839aa9452717753.html).
595244652.title: Calculation Views

595244653.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use disk-based execution hints to manage memory consumption of HEX query execution by spilling intermediate results to disk.
See [Optimizing Memory Consumption of HEX Query Execution](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/4466fb5b5e3f4388a00b44aad5a4bffa/831bfac145cf4983a6df6f7df00578c1.html).
595244653.title: Calculation Views

595248054.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now set or modify the data classification of a calculation view to align with organizational data governance policies.
See [Data Classification for Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/4c2a207723a8451e87cecf75b2aab7a8.html).
595248054.title: Calculation Views

595248055.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now configure calculation views with the SAP Business Data Cloud Integration Mode (Flat View or Construction Kit) to expose them for consumption in SAP Business Data Cloud. Once configured and deployed, avoid making structural changes such as modifying the Semantics node or the top view node.
See:
- [Configuring Calculation Views for SAP Business Data Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/148eff49bb35415b899e3e5d684ae3d5.html)
- [Set the Business Data Cloud Integration Mode for a Calculation View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/c3f7422ddf484af1b5dd5b0827bdea5b.html)
- [Impact of the SAP Business Data Cloud Integration Mode on Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/4466fb5b5e3f4388a00b44aad5a4bffa/a43a1b9355844f1fa087ec7a194468b0.html)
595248055.title: Calculation Views

595248056.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, a dedicated icon is displayed on Rank nodes, Window function nodes, and consuming nodes whose input node is shared with multiple consuming nodes. This visual indicator helps you quickly identify where filter pushdown is blocked.
See:
- [Enforce Filter Pushdown](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/a8498d3da4d94685b0678018db1a5a08.html)
- [Pushing Down Filters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/4466fb5b5e3f4388a00b44aad5a4bffa/d79447553ae848a0bc037a8e5ae38718.html)
595248056.title: Calculation Views

595248057.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now also view data sources in the Outline pane, giving you improved visibility into your model structure.
See [Create Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/5aeb56cba39e4df4ae62b43a0dc2fad4.html).
595248057.title: Calculation Views

595248058.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now copy data source names directly from a node in the graphical editor to your clipboard.
See [Copy Data Source Names](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/loio44f243cae26b43d2874302b74c7fff00.html).
595248058.title: Calculation Views

595248059.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now copy a node along with all its descendant nodes and paste them within or between calculation views.
See [Duplicate, Copy, or Remove Nodes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/d6f21304f3dd470f95124b0d7779b535.html).
595248059.title: Calculation Views

595248060.text:
SAP HANA Deployment Infrastructure (HDI) now supports the optimized_constraint_revalidation plugin parameter for optimized revalidation of constraints, indexes, and table data without using the undeploy-deploy mechanism.
See [SAP HDI Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/e2d3e543067e4f3282bf6dbf880c6b2d.html).
595248060.title: Optimized constraint revalidation in HDI

595248061.text:
You can now enable the MDS JSON result cache independently of the MDS Cube Cache. Previously, the JSON result cache could only be enabled when the Cube Cache was also enabled.
See [Cube Cache Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-performance-guide-for-developers/cube-cache-configuration).
595248061.title: Independent MDS JSON Result Cache

595248065.text: Protect database tenants of your SAP HANA database instance by replicating them to a secondary replica instance in another region. This enables system failover in the event of a regional disaster. See [Multi-Region Disaster Recovery with SAP HANA Cloud Multitenancy](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/dd8c24eab8014a96a9120a37eaf750ff.html).
595248065.title: Native Multitenancy Support in Multi-Region Disaster Recovery

595248066.text:
You can now authenticate to your SAP HANA Cloud database using X.509 client certificates when binding applications to multitenant HDI containers. Certificates are automatically generated and delivered through the service binding, so your application can consume them without any additional setup.
See:
- [Database Tenant Container User](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/08a1fb4347d242f787e937e26ad2c71e.html)
- [Recover a Database Tenant](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/88c66597fd354447b4cda1546a317368.html)
595248066.title: X.509 Certificate-Based Authentication for HDI Service Bindings

595248067.text:
You can now use schema wildcards in audit policies to audit identically-named tables across all schemas, eliminating manual policy updates when adding or removing tenants in multi-tenant environments.
See:
- [Best Practices and Recommendations for Creating Audit Policies](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/35eb4e567d53456088755b8131b7ed1d.html)
- [Performance Considerations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/68afa2153a734bdb8b3198fcecc628e7/7f6ec879e3a449f5a41e15071365ae8a.html)
595248067.title: Schema Wildcard Auditing for Tenants

595248068.text:
Pipeline models support AFL state to accelerate inference speed.
You can use native explanation (reason code) when you run the explain function of a pipeline to accelerate explanation speed.
See:
- [Pipeline](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pipeline-pipeline)
- [TSFM](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/tsfm)
595248068.title: AutoML and Pipeline enhancements

595248069.text:
Imputer mode extends PAL_MLP_MULTI_TASK with the ability to train a network that can impute (predict) missing categorical values in a dataset. To activate this mode, declare one or more OVERLAPPED_VARIABLE parameters.
See [Multi-Task Multilayer Perceptron Imputer](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-task-multilayer-perceptron-imputer).
595248069.title: Multi-MLP enhancement on imputer mode (masked attributes)

595248070.text:
PAL now supports Robust Linear (Theil-Sen) regression. For multiple linear regression, you can use Theil-Sen regression as a robust method to estimate a full coefficient vector and intercept. You can train Theil-Sen regression on a dataset that includes some percentage of outlier or contaminated data. The method generates a model that largely ignores these outliers.
See [Robust Linear Regression](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/robust-linear-regression).
595248070.title: Theil-Sen regression

595248071.text:
Time series foundation model (TSFM) is a built-in time series pipeline operator that produces zero-shot forecasts. You can use it for univariate forecasting on tabular series with optional past and future covariates. No per-dataset model training is required.
See [TSFM](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/tsfm).
595248071.title: Time series foundation model support in PAL AutoML

595248072.text:
AutoML now supports voting-based time series outlier detection. You can use the new OutlierVoting operator in your pipeline.
See
- [Pipeline Operator](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pipeline-operator-pipeline-operator)
- [OutlierVoting Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/configuration-of-outliervoting-automl-config-of-outlier-voting-157)
.
595248072.title: Enhancement to AutoML

595248073.text:
Data generation with diffusion is a function that expands your dataset using a sample dataset. It generates additional data that matches the distribution and characteristics of your sample dataset.
See [Data Generation with Diffusion](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/diffusion-process).
595248073.title: Data generation with diffusion

595248074.text:
Univariate Analysis now includes an online procedure that supports large datasets. You can now split large input data into multiple batches and run the online procedure multiple times.
See [Online Univariate Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/online-univariate-analysis).
595248074.title: Online Univariate Analysis

595248075.text:
The Text Tokenize function now supports regular expression input for the allowed and notAllowed lists.
See [Text Tokenize](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-tokenize).
595248075.title: Text Tokenize enhancement

595248076.text:
Unified time series interface adds the following new features:
- Evaluation and cross-validation support
- The FIXED_INTERVAL parameter to support fixed timestamp intervals such as day, week, or month.
See:
- [Unified Time Series](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/unified-time-series-unified-time-series-296)
- [Unified Time Series with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/unified-time-series-with-pivoted-input-data-unified-time-series-with-pivoted-input-data-298)
595248076.title: Enhancements to the unified time series interface

595248077.text:
You can now use the new `LAGGED_REGRESSORS` parameter to support lagged time series analysis.
See [Additive Model Time Series Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/additive-model-time-series-analysis-additive-model-time-series-analysis-7e78d06).
595248077.title: Enhancement to the additive model for time series

595248078.text:
Unified classification and regression now support multi-target output for Multi-task Multilayer Perceptron (Multi-MLP) and Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree (HGBT), including reason code support.
See:
- [Multi-Task Classification in Unified Classification](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-task-classification-in-unified-classification)
- [Multi-Task Classification in Unified Classification (Pivot)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/no-content-for-file-unified-classification-pivot-mt-md)
595248078.title: Enable multi-target output in unified functions

595248079.text:
AutoML added the following enhancements:
- PCA-based dimensionality reduction for vector features in AutoML.
- TF-IDF support in AutoML
See:
- [Text Feature Handling](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-feature-handling)
- [Pipeline](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pipeline-pipeline)
- [Pipeline Operator](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pipeline-operator-pipeline-operator)
595248079.title: AutoML enhancements

595248080.text:
PAL now includes a pre-trained central PCA model. You can use _SYS_AFL.PAL_TEXTEMBEDDING_PCA_PROJECT to reduce the dimensionality of vectors generated by SAP HANA embedding models. The pre-shipped PCA model delivers better accuracy in most cases and eliminates the need for local PCA training.
See [Principal Component Analysis for Text Embedding Vectors](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/textembeddingvectorpca-md).
595248080.title: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for text embedding vectors

595248081.text:
Feature Agglomeration is a new dimensionality reduction method in PAL. It merges related features into composite groups based on pairwise similarities like correlation or distance. This method improves computational efficiency and model interpretability by reducing dataset dimensionality while preserving the most informative aspects of your original data.
See [Feature Agglomeration](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/feature-agglomeration).
595248081.title: New dimensionality reduction method: Feature Agglomeration

595248082.text:
PAL schedules now support composite tasks made up of multiple subtasks. When you invoke a schedule, it runs the specified subtasks in order or in parallel.
See [Calling PAL with Schedule](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/calling-pal-with-schedule).
595248082.title: Scheduler management enhancements

595248083.text:
You can now use real vector types with Affinity Propagation.
See [Affinity Propagation](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/affinity-propagation-affinity-propagation-ec478f5).
595248083.title: Affinity Propagation enhancements

595248084.text:
The Text Classification Model method now supports the float data type, which accelerates calculation speed with minimal accuracy loss.
See:
- [Text Classification with Model (Train)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-classification-with-model-train)
- [Text Classification with Model (Predict)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-classification-with-model-predict)
595248084.title: Accelerated text classification method

595248087.text:
SAP HANA Cloud database now supports post-quantum-ready hybrid key establishment (ML-KEM) during TLS 1.3 handshakes.
See [Secure Communication Between SAP HANA and SAP HANA Clients](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/dbd3d887bb571014bf05ca887f897b99.html).
595248087.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) in TLS Connections

595248088.text:
SAP HANA Cloud now provides improved data privacy controls by allowing you to track and log access to sensitive data at the column level. You can designate specific table columns as sensitive using CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE statements, and any read access to those columns will be automatically recorded in the audit log.
See:
- [Auditing](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/ddcb6ed2bb5710148183db80e4aca49b.html)
- [SAP Audit Policies for SAP HANA Databases](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/e97713b81eee4fe0a2f542808729d35f.html)
- [CREATE TABLE Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/create-table-statement-data-definition)
- [ALTER TABLE Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/alter-table-statement-data-definition)
595248088.title: Data Privacy Protection with Column-Level Access Logging

595248089.text:
SAP HANA Cloud now supports specifying multiple issuer distinguished names (DNs) in a single X.509 provider. Issuer DNs can be added or removed on demand to accommodate sub-CA rotations without creating parallel providers.
See [X.509 Certificate-Based User Authentication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/2b335f7eec6a450095f110ea961d77cc.html).
595248089.title: Support for Multiple Issuers in X.509 Providers

595248090.text:
SAP HANA Cloud now supports SHA-256 for the fingerprint value shown in the FINGERPRINT column of the CERTIFICATES and ROOT_CERTIFICATES views, as well as in the PARSE_CERTIFICATES function. The hashing algorithm is controlled by the new certificate_fingerprint_algorithm parameter, which accepts the values md5 and sha256. The default remains md5 and will change to sha256 in QRC4/2026. After a transition period, the parameter will be removed and the FINGERPRINT column will always display the SHA-256 value.
See:
- [SAP Note 3803891 - Incompatible Change - Algorithm MD5 is replaced by SHA256 for column FINGERPRINT in the views CERTIFICATES, ROOT_CERTIFICATES and in the function PARSE_CERTIFICATES](https://me.sap.com/notes/3803891)
- [Certificate Management](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/1e6042c4402545f7a0574f7bc91fab25.html)
- [SQL Statements and Authorization for Certificate Management (Reference)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/f32bcc9c4b734f24bedaf6253e7981d6.html)
595248090.title: FIPS-Compliant Certificate Fingerprint Algorithm

595248091.text:
You can now use the toggling feature to perform real-time replication of CDS views from remote ABAP systems (SAP S/4HANA and SAP S/4HANA Cloud).
See [Toggling Between Virtual Tables and Replica Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/toggling-between-virtual-tables-and-replica-tables).
595248091.title: Toggling support for real-time CDS view replication

595248092.text:
When you perform remote table replication, fuzzy search indexes created on SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database QRC3/2026 or higher are now included in the replication.
- Fuzzy search indexes created on SAP HANA on-premise systems or SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database QRC2/2026 or lower are not replicated.
See [Remote Table Replication Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/unsupported-data-types-and-other-limitations).
595248092.title: Remote table replication support for fuzzy search indexes

595248093.text:
You can now create virtual tables for read-only access to Apache Iceberg format v3 tables.
- Apache Iceberg format v3 deletion vectors are supported.
- Other features specific to Iceberg format v3, such as variant, geometry, geography, nanosecond-precision timestamps, column default values, and row-level lineage are not supported.
See:
- [Considerations for Remote Sources and Virtual Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/considerations-for-remote-sources-and-virtual-tables)
- [Create a Virtual Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/create-virtual-table)
595248093.title: Virtual table support for Apache Iceberg format version 3

595248094.text:
In SAP HANA Cloud instances provisioned on the SAP Cloud Infrastructure hyperscaler, you can now provision and use Data Access Agents to connect to remote sources, such as Azure SQL and Snowflake.
See [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Data Access Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/12da7a2eef6f4f349bd562c927252f8b.html).
595248094.title: Data Access Agents available for SAP Cloud Infrastructure

595248095.text:
In a multi-region disaster recovery setup, after failover, you can restore connectivity to remote sources and virtual tables in the former secondary region instance. To do this, create Data Access Agents using the same names and adapters as the original Data Access Agents in the primary region instance.
See:
- [Remote Source Connections After Multi-Region Failover](450c61e46499425894ef30e6e648e179.html)
- [Recreate Data Access Agent After Multi-Region Failover](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/90e3c5e8382540e3aff9c5208fecb5ab)
595248095.title: Recreate Data Access Agents after Multi-Region Failover

595248096.text: You can now create a remote source to an SAP IQ on-premise database.See [Create an SAP IQ On-Premise Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/74b3d0807e8846a3a770aa3ca7e20bc2).
595248096.title: Create SAP IQ on-premise remote source

595248097.text:
You can now explicitly specify the metadata version to use for virtual tables on file-based Iceberg tables. A new virtual table property metadata_file_name allows you to specify a file containing the version metadata. Additionally, you can use the new GET_ICEBERG_METADATA_FILES built-in function to discover available metadata files for your file-based Iceberg remote source.
The file adapter selects the metadata file to use in the following order:
- The metadata file you specify in the new metadata_file_name​ virtual table property
- A version-hint.txt​ file in the metadata directory that contains the version number
- The metadata file with the highest version number
See:
- [Create a Virtual Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/replicating-cds-views-from-remote-abap-sources)
- [GET_ICEBERG_METADATA_FILES Function](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/get-iceberg-metadata-files-function)
595248097.title: Specify metadata version for file-based Iceberg table remote sources

595248098.text:
You can now use the abapodbc adapter to perform real-time replication of CDS views from remote ABAP systems (SAP S/4HANA and SAP S/4HANA Cloud). You can choose between automatic system-scheduled replication or manually trigger delta replication.
See [Replicating CDS Views from Remote ABAP Sources](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/replicating-cds-views-from-remote-abap-sources).
595248098.title: Real-time CDS view replication from remote ABAP systems

595248099.text:
In addition to previously-supported Iceberg REST catalog providers and deployment environments, the icebergcatalog adapter now supports catalogs provided by Snowflake and catalogs deployed on Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
See [Create an Apache Iceberg Catalog Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/create-apache-iceberg-catalog-remote-source).
595248099.title: Iceberg REST catalog support for Snowflake, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform

595248100.text:
You can now create virtual tables for Parquet, Iceberg, and Delta table remote sources that use data page v2. See:
- [Considerations for Remote Sources and Virtual Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/8f2295c581d9437894c44e7aebce3198/a354ed7e0ab24ae4829e2f95c9317db5)
- [Create a Virtual Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/8f2295c581d9437894c44e7aebce3198/978b3b2446c5419d8bd71c20b5fabc6d)
595248100.title: Create virtual tables for Parquet data page v2 sources

595248101.text:
You can now create remote sources to access Apache Iceberg tables that are made available through the Apache Iceberg REST catalog API.Note
The icebergcatalog adapter is supported only for external Iceberg REST catalogs provided by Cloudera and Databricks and deployed on Amazon S3.
See [Create an Apache Iceberg Catalog Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/8f2295c581d9437894c44e7aebce3198/877e184989aa4474ac72773aedf0b61a).
595248101.title: Create Iceberg REST catalog remote sources

595248102.text: You can now perform snapshot replication and toggle replica tables when you have a virtual table for a remote Iceberg table. See [Toggle Between Virtual Tables and Replica Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/8f2295c581d9437894c44e7aebce3198/a9752833bc414abd81d891a3f142c817).
595248102.title: Snapshot replication for Apache Iceberg tables

595248103.text: You can now create a remote source to MySQL data sources.See [Create a MySQL Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/fb7cffeb426045f382b243a0b4112e47).
595248103.title: Create MySQL remote source

595248105.text:
You can now control the degree of parallelism for MAP_MERGE and MAP_REDUCE operations using the MAP_MERGE_CONCURRENCY and MAP_REDUCE_CONCURRENCY hints to optimize performance for your workload.
See:
- [MAP_REDUCE Parallelism Control](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d1cb63c8dd8e4c35a0f18aef632687f0/f504f35e065e4ad6bbf14881143f6ee8.html)
- [MAP_MERGE Parallelism Control](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d1cb63c8dd8e4c35a0f18aef632687f0/4e234fdc95924e02aab24eb6316e1dec.html)
595248105.title: MAP_MERGE and MAP_REDUCE Parallelism Control

595248106.text:
The new WITH SQL STATISTICS INTO clause allows per-statement collection of execution statistics, including compile time, execution time, and statement status, directly within SQLScript procedures and anonymous blocks, without requiring access to monitoring views. Statistics are captured into a row variable of type SQLSCRIPT_STATEMENT_STATISTICS_TYPE and can be used for logging, diagnostics, or error handling within the same code block.
See [SQLScript Statement Statistics Collection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d1cb63c8dd8e4c35a0f18aef632687f0/bfa59adca7df4001ba07e779103f1a30.html).
595248106.title: SQLScript Statement Statistics

595248107.text: When using the WITH REMOTE clause, the specified audit metadata can be configured to apply only to the virtual table. The source table created has no audit columns defined. See [CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/d2a0406155f24a49aa6c549e0c428bd7.html).
595248107.title: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE statement

595248108.text: This new view provides detailed information about currently running takeover operations. See [M_SYSTEM_REPLICATION_TAKEOVER_PROGRESS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/c80d741d4d9a488dbce931b2e5d30900.html).
595248108.title: M_SYSTEM_REPLICATION_TAKEOVER_PROGRESS system view

595248109.text: This new view provides detailed information about executed takeovers. See [M_SYSTEM_REPLICATION_TAKEOVER_SERVICE_COMPONENT_HISTORY System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/8271ce6a7c134f84be53c0d1bf260dfb.html).
595248109.title: M_SYSTEM_REPLICATION_TAKEOVER_SERVICE_COMPONENT_HISTORY system view

595248110.text: For catalog imports, you can now ignore DDL errors the during object creation phase. See [IMPORT Statement (Data Import Export)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f75ade751910148492a90e5e375b8f.html).
595248110.title: IMPORT statement

595248111.text: This new function returns which database user would be authenticated when providing a specific user certificate. See [GET_X509_USER_MAPPING_DETAILS Function (Miscellaneous)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/89c99bb8d96844898cf557cd218ac850.html).
595248111.title: GET_X509_USER_MAPPING_DETAILS function

595248112.text: The ROUTE_TO and NO_ROUTE_TO hints have been extended to support the target strings aliases and table placement locations. See [HINT Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/4ba9edce1f2347a0b9fcda99879c17a1.html).
595248112.title: HINT details

595248113.text: The EXPORT statement now supports archiving multiple catalog files into a single zip file (catalog.zip). See [EXPORT Statement (Data Import Export)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20da0bec751910148e69c9668ea3ccb8.html).
595248113.title: EXPORT statement

595248114.text:
The X.509 provider now supports multiple issuers.See:
- [CREATE X509 PROVIDER Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/3b3163d6ad0f4eb9bd73c7c060f49649.html)
- [ALTER X509 PROVIDER Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/4f7e59d60616461cbfaa00bda366b9f2.html)
- [X509_PROVIDERS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/07a362793a194647957d86b521f086a9.html)
595248114.title: CREATE / ALTER X509 PROVIDER statements

595248115.text: This view provides information on the multiple issuers now supported for X.509 providers. See [X509_PROVIDER_ISSUERS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/0d7f86c345154c768fdb7407317d23e8.html).
595248115.title: X509_PROVIDER_ISSUERS system view

595248116.text: The recovery history view provides a complete history of recovery events for a particular SAP HANA instance. See [M_RECOVERY_HISTORY System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/738fe146653b497d8377e35f14f1eb18.html).
595248116.title: M_RECOVER_HISTORY system view

595248117.text:
Views now support structured column masks to hide sensitive data in columns.See:
- [CREATE VIEW Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/create-view-statement-data-definition)
- [ALTER VIEW Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/alter-view-statement-data-definition)
- [CREATE STRUCTURED COLUMN MASK Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/create-structured-column-mask-statement)
- [ALTER STRUCTURED COLUMN MASK Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/alter-structured-column-mask-statement)
- [DROP STRUCTURED COLUMN MASK Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/drop-structured-column-mask-statement)
- [VIEWS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/views-system-view)
- [HINT Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/hint-details)
595248117.title: Structured column mask

595248118.text:
Workload mapping properties have been extended to include APPLICATION WORKLOAD.See:
- [CREATE WORKLOAD MAPPING Statement (Workload Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/create-workload-mapping-statement-workload-management)
- [ALTER WORKLOAD MAPPING Statement (Workload Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/alter-workload-mapping-statement-workload-management)
595248118.title: CREATE / ALTER WORKLOAD MAPPING statements

595248119.text: The columns APPLICATION_WORKLOAD and APPLICATION_WORKLOAD_WILDCARD have been added to the view, to support routing ABAP workloads by type. See [WORKLOAD_MAPPINGS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/workload-mappings-system-view).
595248119.title: WORKLOAD_MAPPINGS system view

595248120.text:
These system views have been extended to support column read access auditing.See:
- [TABLE_COLUMNS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/table-columns-system-view)
- [M_TEMPORARY_TABLE_COLUMNS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/m-temporary-table-columns-system-view)
595248120.title: TABLE_COLUMNS and M_TEMPORARY_TABLE_COLUMNS system views

595248121.text:
The LAST_INVALIDATION_REASON column now includes more detailed invalidation reasons for several cases when HEX plans are recompiled:
- Table size exceeds a predefined threshold
- Column dictionary is not sorted in binary order
- A required index was dropped
- No vector index exists
Other invalidation reasons are caused by new records that break plan assumptions:
- Value order ID order not preserved
- Unexpected NULL values
- Column min/max values have changed
- Maximum partition value ID exceeded
- Maximum value ID exceeded
- Single-value constraint invalidated
Previously, many cases appeared only with a catch-all WITHOUT-FALLBACK RECOMPILE reason provided.
See [M_SQL_PLAN_CACHE System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20c57b8e75191014b22fcc8222b15970).
595248121.title: M_SQL_PLAN_CACHE system view

595248122.text:
The TABLE ADMIN system privilege now lets you alter the load unit on indexes, tables and system audit log.See:
- [ALTER TABLE Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/alter-table-statement-data-definition)
- [ALTER INDEX Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/alter-index-statement-data-definition)
- [ALTER SYSTEM ALTER AUDIT LOG (System Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/alter-system-alter-audit-log-system-management)
595248122.title: TABLE ADMIN system privilege

595248123.text: Two new hints that help reduce compile time have been introduced. See [HINT Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/hint-details).
595248123.title: HINT Details

595248124.text:
An ON ERROR clause has been introduced to these functions.See:
- [LOCALTOUTC Function (Datetime)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/localtoutc-function-datetime)
- [UTCTOLOCAL Function (Datetime)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/utctolocal-function-datetime)
595248124.title: LOCALTOUTC / UTCTOLOCAL functions

595248125.text:
Using VOLUME REPLICATION ROLE, you can now map a workload class exclusively to the SMVR replica or SMVR source node.See:
- [CREATE WORKLOAD MAPPING Statement (Workload Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/create-workload-mapping-statement-workload-management)
- [ALTER WORKLOAD MAPPING Statement (Workload Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/alter-workload-mapping-statement-workload-management)
- [WORKLOAD_MAPPINGS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/workload-mappings-system-view)
595248125.title: CREATE / ALTER WORKLOAD MAPPING statements

595248126.text: The column WAITING_RECORD_KEY has been added to the view to display the primary key values for locked records. See [M_BLOCKED_TRANSACTIONS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/m-blocked-transactions-system-view).
595248126.title: M_BLOCKED_TRANSACTIONS system view

595248127.text: Importing encrypted exports from on-premise systems now supports CSV and BINARY DATA formats. See [IMPORT Statement (Data Import Export)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/import-statement-data-import-export).
595248127.title: IMPORT statement

595248128.text: Additional wild card parameters are now supported when creating an audit policy. See [CREATE AUDIT POLICY Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/create-audit-policy-statement-access-control).
595248128.title: CREATE AUDIT POLICY statement

595248129.text:
Volume Snapshot Service (VSS) is now enabled across all AliCloud landscapes. This infrastructure enhancement improves backup and recovery capabilities for SAP HANA Cloud instances running on AliCloud, providing more reliable and efficient snapshot operations.
See [SAP HANA Database Instance Snapshots](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/d7fb197fa2d54b98b5c73cd10db16609.html).
595248129.title: Volume Snapshot Service Enabled on AliCloud

595248130.text:
You can now retrieve resource usage statistics for active statements running in your SAP HANA database instance using the SAP HANA Cloud Metrics API.
See [Resource Usage Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/46e370ced3ef4d2bbd0ec2337df5f565.html).
595248130.title: Metrics for Active Statements

595248131.text:
The SAP HANA Cloud Metrics API now supports the resourceTypes query parameter, enabling you to filter service instance types in API responses for more targeted metrics retrieval.
See [Resource Usage Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c20295e8e76345da98f2c374a94bda3c.html).
595248131.title: ResourceTypes filter for Metrics API

595248132.text:
SQL on Files queries can be processed in parallel across multiple elastic compute nodes (ECNs) using distributed query processing.
See [Set a Compute Location for Distributed Query Processing](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/set-compute-location-for-distributed-query-processing).
595248132.title: Parallel processing of SQL on Files queries on ECNs

595248133.text:
You can now add custom string labels to your template backups using the optional labels parameter, making it easier to organize and identify your backups without needing full recovery.
See [Create and Use a Cloning Template Using the CLI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/ea7d595b01704e2690cd8c4ceef01377.html).
595248133.title: Custom Labels for Template Backups

595248134.text:
Plan Trace now captures runtime information from elastic compute nodes (ECN), so you can analyze workload routing and investigate performance bottlenecks.
See [Monitoring ECNs Using SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/monitoring-ecns-using-sap-hana-cloud-central).
595248134.title: Monitoring ECNs Using SAP HANA Cloud Central

595248135.text: Remote table replication now supports repartitioning and dynamic range partitioning, ensuring that replication continues reliably even when partition structures change.
595248135.title: Repartitioning and dynamic range partitioning in RTR

595248136.text:
The active-active (read-enabled) replica capability is now automatically available for all synchronous high-availability replicas. You can use an SQL hint to route read operations to the replica, freeing up resources on the source.
See [Active/Active (Read-Enabled) Replicas](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/active-active-read-enabled).
595248136.title: Active-active (read-enabled) replica

595248137.text:
You can now get details on the size and access patterns of your tables to help you asses how critical each table is for your business applications.
See [Analyze Table Usage](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/analyze-table-usage).
595248137.title: Table usage analysis tool

595248138.text:
Added a query testing setting in the SQL Plan Advisor app. You can now configure testing to run automatically or manually. Manual registration in the UI is no longer supported, but you can still manually register queries using the built-in procedure.
See [SQL Plan Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ba3b3413ff4541da9a05debdf3d720c0.html).
595248138.title: SQL Plan Advisor application enhancement

595248139.text:
You can now save query execution plans directly in your database and manage them in the Saved Plans app.
See [Saving and Downloading Execution Plans](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/dbf1a3f3926044959be233b5690f6634.html).
595248139.title: Saved Plans app

595248140.text:
Plan Trace now captures prepared statements that are executed from the cache.
See [Plan Trace in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d68fbcc8f050438483b6d493333bbe99.html).
595248140.title: Plan Trace application enhancement

595248141.text:
SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database now supports multi-level partitioning with HASH–HASH–RANGE and HASH–RANGE–RANGE layouts. This enables more flexible partitioning strategies for large tables with mixed access patterns and NSE-optimized fields, improving both performance and memory efficiency.
See [Partitioning Over Three Levels](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/17633d723f6c44ac9f00c06bd03cbdc7.html).
595248141.title: New Partitioning Layouts: HASH–HASH–RANGE and HASH–RANGE–RANGE

595248142.text:
Configure multiple alert rules and apply them to one or more instances by creating sets.
See [Creating Alert Rule Sets in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/creating-alert-rule-templates-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
595248142.title: Create alert rule sets

595248143.text:
You can now update all captured abstract SQL plans (ASPs) to the latest SAP HANA database version in the SQL Plan Stability app.
See [Manage SQL Plan Stability in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/7409ab624db846a3b878c09dc2ec2fb4.html).
595248143.title: SQL Plan Stability

595248144.text:
The DBADMIN user is now exempt from the connection limit for an instance. This supports troubleshooting by database administrators in situations where the connection limit has been reached.
See [User Management with the SAP HANA Database Administrator DBADMIN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/user-management-with-sap-hana-database-administrator-dbadmin).
595248144.title: Database Troubleshooting

595248145.text:
You can now retrieve resource usage and metering statistics for data access agents using the SAP HANA Cloud Metrics API.
See [APIs for Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/apis-for-metrics).
595248145.title: Metrics for Data Access Agents

595248146.text:
The new Index Advisor analyzes database performance and creates recommendations for indexing tables. This can reduce operational costs and improve performance.
See [About the Index Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/about-index-advisor).
595248146.title: Index Advisor

595248147.text:
The new Partition Advisor generates recommendations for optimizing the distribution of table data in SAP HANA Cloud databases
See [About the Partition Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/about-partition-advisor).
595248147.title: Partition Advisor

595248148.text: If the preferred availability zone for an ECN is unavailable during provisioning, an automatic mechanism provisions the ECN in a fallback availability zone. See [SAP HANA Database Availability Zone and Replicas](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/sap-hana-database-availability-zone-and-replicas).
595248148.title: Backup availability zone for ECNs

595248149.text:
The Elastic Compute Node Advisor can now analyze workload spanning up to two weeks when generating data-driven recommendations. This enables better decision-making when routing workload to temporary elastic compute nodes, ensuring efficient management of peak workloads.
See [Create and Apply an Elastic Compute Node Policy](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/create-and-apply-elastic-compute-node-policy).
595248149.title: Elastic Compute Node creation

595248150.text:
