The metric HDBEstimatedMemorySize has an updated description to accurately reflect its function, and the new metric HDBEstimatedMemoryMinSize can be used to determine the minimum memory size to which the instance can be downsized.
See:
- [Resource Usage Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/46e370ced3ef4d2bbd0ec2337df5f565.html)
- [Change the Size of an SAP HANA Database Instance Using the CLI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/5f4823c45d654d1da28682f03f58ccf7.html)
- [3605655](https://me.sap.com/notes/3605655)
595248150.title: Behavioral Change of HDBEstimatedMemorySize

595248151.text:
A system copy can now be created using a specific point in time as the source, even if the original instance has been overwritten. This feature is useful for restoring data from a specific moment within a 14-day retention period, ensuring data integrity and recovery options.
See [Copying an SAP HANA Database Instance](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/b70ec48d975e4cf484231bcea4819b8c.html).
595248151.title: System Copy From an Overwritten Instance

595248152.text:
The new columns TOTAL_STATEMENT_MEMORY_LIMIT and TOTAL_STATEMENT_THREAD_LIMIT in the monitoring views M_SERVICE_THREADS and M_SERVICE_THREAD_SAMPLES show the workload class resource limits effective at the time a statement is executed.
See [Hierarchies of Workload Classes](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/hierarchies-of-workload-classes).
595248152.title: Workload Classes

595248153.text:
The SQL Plan Advisor now supports NO_HUP_OPTIMIZER advice type for UPDATE DML (Data Manipulation Language) statements.
See [SQL Plan Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/sql-plan-advisor).
595248153.title: SQL Plan Advisor

595248154.text:
You can now configure subaccount level alert rules in SAP HANA Cloud Central for SAP HANA database instances.
See [Open Alerts in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud/sap-hana-cloud-administration-guide/alerts).
595248154.title: Configure alert rules in SAP HANA Cloud Central

595248155.text:
The HDBDiskUsage alert now stays active even if the HANA instance has stopped or is unreachable. In the latter case, it displays the last recorded value.
See [HDB Disk Usage](https://help.sap.com/docs/alert-notification/sap-alert-notification-for-sap-btp/hdb-disk-usage?version=Cloud).
595248155.title: HDBDiskUsage alert remains active despite SAP HANA instance unavailability

595248156.text:
The numeric interval property for dynamic range partitioning has been enhanced. Columns defined as NVARCHAR data with values up to 38 characters in length can now be used for the interval by casting the data as integer.
See [Dynamic Range Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/6ebea7782b9e4758baeed923e388ee32.html).
595248156.title: Dynamic Range Partitioning

595248157.text:
You can now use an API to update the alert rules of multiple service instances in an SAP HANA Cloud Central subaccount.
See [APIs for Alerts](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/apis-for-alerts)
595248157.title: Batch configure alert rules in SAP HANA Cloud Central

595248158.text:
You can now use the Buffer Cache Monitor in SAP HANA Cloud Central to manually or automatically configure the unload threshold value.
See [Buffer Cache Monitor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/3ea43f5d6d0246f18c438c3e1250382e.html)
595248158.title: Unload threshold configuration in SAP HANA Cloud Central

595248159.text:
You can now recover an SAP HANA instance using a cloning template and deploy it into an existing SAP HANA instance. You can do this either when provisioning a new instance in SAP HANA Cloud Central or from the command line.
See [Cloning an SAP HANA Database Instance](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/59cc7a523fad4164aa511f7a58278c3e.html)
595248159.title: Template recovery into existing SAP HANA Cloud instance

595248160.text:
You can now restore an SAP HANA instance to a state copied from another SAP HANA instance at a specific point in time. You can do this in SAP HANA Cloud Central or from the command line.
See [Copying an SAP HANA Database Instance](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/b70ec48d975e4cf484231bcea4819b8c.html)
595248160.title: Instance Copying

595248161.text:
Improve cost efficiency and scalability for massive vector datasets in SAP HANA Cloud by leveraging the disk-based storage in native storage extension, allowing you to handle ever-growing data volumes.
See [Vector Columns in SAP HANA's Native Storage Extension](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c40cab369db246f1a17feea1c031ddc1/7fb81e64c9454ae4b088489bd8d41dda.html)
595248161.title: Support of vector data with the native storage extension (NSE)

595248162.text:
Starting with QRC 3/2024, data and log backups in SAP HANA database instances are automatically compressed.
See [Backup and Recovery](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/89d71f01daca4ecaaa069d6a060167f5.html).
595248162.title: Backup Compression

595248163.text:
It is now possible to use the HDI container (or container-group) API to import into SAP HANA Cloud an HDI container that was exported from SAP HANA Platform 2.0.
See [Import an SAP HDI Container for Copy Purposes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/54fa5466cdeb4e488b08d6c7da0244f2.html).
595248163.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248164.text:
SAP HDI administrators can now add the new HDI plug-in "Document Store Collection Adjacency Indexes" (.hdbcollectionadjindex) to their containers.
See [Document Store Collection Adjacency Indexes (.hdbcollectionadjindex)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/6ed7a55ab9a24c81b116c72d4176efc4.html).
595248164.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248165.text:
The PERISTENCE_TYPE column contains the value UNIFIED for all columns with unified persistence format, independent of the load unit.
See [M_CS_COLUMNS_PERSISTENCE](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_PLATFORM/4fe29514fd584807ac9f2a04f6754767/14905bf0250c4c019abf9dd6a32c7083.html)
595248165.title: Unified Persistency

595248166.text:
The buffer cache can automatically calculate the unload_threshold value in regular intervals, based on the actual NSE data persistence size in the system.
See [Adjusting the Buffer Cache Size](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/2436bae042054ec880ff5d1f436ef0a0.html)
595248166.title: Automatic calculation of the unload_threshold

595248167.text:
The Elastic Compute Node (ECN) is now available making it possible to run temporary (computeserver) processing nodes in your database instance to handle peaks in workload. The ECN can be easily added and dropped when no longer required. It incurs additional costs while the computeserver is running but helps to optimize the total cost of running the SAP HANA Cloud service.
See [SAP HANA Cloud Elastic Compute Node](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/93dc81da7ba5457fa60f30cdd858b4df.html)
595248167.title: Elastic Compute Node (General Availability)

595248168.text:
You can now assign permanent names to range partitions in heterogeneous partitioning schemas and use the name in SQL statements to identify the partition. This avoids the need to refer to logical partition ids which are not permanent.
See [Partition Properties](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d82cb8dfcc1444d0a663c5cfc0931d4c.html).
595248168.title: Aliases for Range Partitions

595248169.text:
The SQL Plan Advisor now automatically detects alternative plan candidates. Additionally, you can register queries at any time, regardless of the current advisor settings. Lastly, the SQL Plan Advisor has expanded its support for advice types, now including NON_HEX captured abstract SQL plans and plan variants.
See [SQL Plan Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/sql-plan-advisor).
595248169.title: SQL Plan Advisor

595248170.text:
The numeric interval property for dynamic range partitioning has been enhanced. Columns defined as NVARCHAR data with values up to 38 characters in length can now be used for the interval by casting the data as integer.
See [Dynamic Range Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/6ebea7782b9e4758baeed923e388ee32.html).
595248170.title: Dynamic Range Partitioning

595248171.text:
API calls have been introduced to support the administration of alert rules. You can now retrieve details of rules in a subaccount and also configure alerts by enabling or disabling and setting threshold severity values.
In the QRC3 release these APIs are available for Cloud native alerts, and in the QRC4 release they also support alerts generated by the Embedded Statistics Server.
See [APIs for Alerts](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/81d5c960888741cc8875ab225c540f0a.html).
595248171.title: Alerts APIs

595248172.text:
A default set of trusted root certificates is now installed within each provisioned HANA database so that it is no longer necessary to add certificates manually.
See [Importing and Exporting Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/261937915fa5438ca545b8278b2979b7.html).
595248172.title: CA Certificates

595248173.text:
Import and Export functionality has been enhanced to support Google Cloud regional endpoints. A new path format has been introduced to support this feature.
See [Importing and Exporting with Google Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/f975e58e44354dbfb21028532555da4b.html).
595248173.title: IMPORT / EXPORT Google Cloud

595248174.text:
Import and Export functionality has been enhanced to support Azure DNS Zone endpoints. A new path format has been introduced to support this feature.
See [Importing and Exporting with Microsoft Azure Storage](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/fd45a3b7917349a1a8cbc81e202c5cdd.html).
595248174.title: IMPORT / EXPORT Azure DNS Zone

595248175.text:
The new HDI build plug-in .hdbstructuredfilter transforms a design-time, DDL-based, structured-filter resource into a structured-filter object in the database.
See [Structured Filter (.hdbstructuredfilter)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/6671c48d5f314417807aac11e6ae26cf.html?).
595248175.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248176.text:
The new HDI build plug-in parameter optimized_replace enables the HDI administrator to ensure that an optimized replacement strategy is used instead of the undeploy-deploy mechanism when modifying HDI artifacts.
See [SAP HDI Parameters (Build Plug-in Parameters)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/e2d3e543067e4f3282bf6dbf880c6b2d.html#build-plug-in-parameters).
595248176.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248177.text:
The new HDI parameter format indicates the format to be used for exporting data.
See [SAP HDI Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/e2d3e543067e4f3282bf6dbf880c6b2d.html#sap-hdi-parameters).
595248177.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248178.text:
The plan decision recorder now logs recompiled execution plan details in sqlplan trace files to help analyze SQL query performance fluctuations.
See [Plan Decision Recorder](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/plan-decision-recorder).
595248178.title: Plan Decision Recorder

595248179.text:
Options to filter and manage the data as it is imported using the COLUMN LIST syntax have been enhanced.
See [Importing and Exporting](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/41d9c51cc69a4178b01db4bda77fb94a.html).
595248179.title: IMPORT / EXPORT CSV and Parquet Files

595248180.text:
Two enhancements have now been applied in the area of Dynamic Range Partitioning:
- Background scan job: The frequency of the background job (the time interval at which dynamic range tables are scanned) can now be set differently for individual tables using the table property DYNAMIC RANGE CHECK INTERVAL.
- Bidirectional growth for negative number ranges: A limitation related to partition ranges which are used to store negative values has been removed. These partitions can now accept values in both numerical directions (that is values which are at both the lower and higher ends of the range). The partitioning SQL syntax has been extended to support this.
See [Dynamic Range Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/6ebea7782b9e4758baeed923e388ee32.html).
595248180.title: Dynamic Range Partitioning

595248181.text:
SQL Plan Cache has been enhanced to save SQL plan variants for parameterized queries. A variant is saved for each parameter set which has been used for the query. The feature can be enabled generally or applied to individual queries by appending a hint to the SQL statement.
See [SQL Plan Cache for Parameterized Queries](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ac43f5c3114a4798913582669094e4af.html).
595248181.title: Variant Plans

595248182.text:
A metering REST API is now available so that you can retrieve metrics values related to consumption of computing resources.
See [Metering Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/219835166e9f4051a4bbc4c1dde5b2f3.html).
595248182.title: Metrics API

595248183.text:
You can now retrieve metric values from multiple specified instances in a single call using the parameter serviceInstanceIDs to submit a list of instances.
See [APIs for Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c20295e8e76345da98f2c374a94bda3c.html).
595248183.title: Metrics API

595248184.text:
A new metric (HDBHostVCPUCount) is now supported by the Metrics API that retrieves details of the compute resources available on the instance.
See [Resource Usage Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/46e370ced3ef4d2bbd0ec2337df5f565.html).
595248184.title: Metrics API

595248185.text:
A new warning alert has been introduced (HDBInstanceMovePending) to inform administrators when a restart of the instance is required. This may be necessary due to infrastructure maintenance where instances are moved to different hardware.
See [Maintenance Windows and Upgrade Strategies](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/97fee41e29ed49738df800119170e80f.html).
595248185.title: Restart Instance Required

595248186.text:
An unavailability microservice is integrated into SAP HANA Cloud clusters, this is invoked if a HANA instance is not available, the URS then returns an explanatory error message to the client, such as: instance stopped, key revoked, instance upgrading and so on. Message texts are related to a set of SQL error codes (ERR_URS* in the range 1888-1919) which are reserved exclusively for this purpose and are available for use by application developers.
See [SQL Error Codes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20a78d3275191014b41bae7c4a46d835.html).
595248186.title: Reserved SQL error codes for Unavailability Reason Service

595248187.text:
A new trace type is available to help analyze performance fluctuation of parameterized queries.
See [ALTER SYSTEM CLEAR TRACES Statement (System Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/alter-system-clear-traces-statement-system-management).
595248187.title: Plan Decision Recorder

595248188.text:
The limitation that generated columns and identity columns cannot be used as partitioning columns has been lifted in this release.
See [Table Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c2ea130bbb571014b024ffeda5090764.html).
595248188.title: Partitioning key columns

595248189.text:
Fine-grained control of the maximum size of individual caches is now supported by configuring (in the SYSTEM database) a maximum limit for each cache.
See [Limit Cache Memory Usage](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/12c493156a194b71acd7fc2f6d20559b.html).
595248189.title: Cache Management

595248190.text:
Import of nested data in parquet format is now supported by writing the data for the group of nested values as a single text string in JSON format (data types NVARCHAR/NCLOB) to the table.
See [Importing and Exporting Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/fd45a3b7917349a1a8cbc81e202c5cdd.html).
595248190.title: Support for nested parquet data

595248191.text:
A new metric (HDBServiceActive) is now supported by the Metrics API to test for the availability of a service.
See [Overview of Available Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/46e370ced3ef4d2bbd0ec2337df5f565.html).
595248191.title: Metrics API

595248192.text:
SQL Plan Cache can now detect the poor performance of a query and then on the basis of this assessment remove the query plan entry from the cache so that recompilation is triggered.
See [SQL Plan Cache, Auto Recompilation](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/f0aaab730a1540758a8f36c9aee2118a.html).
595248192.title: Auto Recompilation

595248193.text:
A user-defined application lock has been introduced in SAP HANA Cloud. This is for use with custom applications and can be acquired or released by calling a procedure.
See [Application Locks (see also link to SAP Note 3432435)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/a66cb10f359c47b7aeecd823f54be376.html).
595248193.title: User-defined application locks

595248194.text:
Changes have been made in the way alerts are filtered and displayed on screen in SAP HANA Cloud Central. Only the most severe occurrence of an alert is displayed. If you apply a filter to show only CURRENT alerts then time range filter values are not applied and all active alerts are displayed.
See [Alerts](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/b8cc733919ff40eb8725ef47316c840b.html).
595248194.title: Alert selection and filtering behavior

595248195.text:
The HDI .hdbstructuredprivilege plug-in now supports wild cards.
See [Structured Privileges (.hdbstructuredprivilege)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/c3827df3a9dc4c45b5b4e2f7b1070b08.html).
595248195.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248196.text:
The HDI hdbfabricvirtualtable plug-in enables you to add a system-owned replica to a virtual table from a design-time fabric virtual table.
See [Fabric Virtual Tables (.hdbfabricvirtualtable)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/001965588c394dadb02ee999c0d0cda7.html).
595248196.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248197.text:
The Workload Management app in SAP HANA Cloud Central (HCC) now shows workload-class-relevant global limits.
See [Managing Workload Classes in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/managing-workload-classes-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
595248197.title: Workload Management

595248198.text:
A new built-in procedure, the SQL Plan Advisor, compares execution plans for registered SELECT queries and advises which plan promises the best performance.
See [SQL Plan Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/sql-plan-advisor).
595248198.title: SQL Plan Advisor

595248199.text:
SAP HANA APL 2614 is available in SAP HANA Cloud.
See [What's New in SAP HANA APL 2614](https://help.sap.com/docs/apl/91a027b369cc4d1898806a779a23e206/c57b6f4e4e324fcaa1ece849228e67c7.html?version=2614).
595248199.title: SAP HANA APL 2614

595248200.text:
SAP HANA APL 2604 is available in SAP HANA Cloud.
See [What's New in SAP HANA APL 2604](https://help.sap.com/docs/apl/91a027b369cc4d1898806a779a23e206/c57b6f4e4e324fcaa1ece849228e67c7.html?version=2604).
595248200.title: SAP HANA APL 2604

595248201.text:
SAP HANA APL 2602 is available in SAP HANA Cloud.

595248218.text:
New and modified BIMC views:
- BIMC_CUBES (BIMC_ALL_CUBES): New OBJECT_ORIGIN Column
Determines the origin of the CUBES metadata, indicating whether it was deployed by HDI or created using a DDL statement.
- BIMC_DIMENSIONS and BIMC_MEASURES: Filter on IS_HIDDEN Column
Filters based on the IS_HIDDEN column (not visible in the result set) to display only non-hidden attributes or measures in calculation views.
- BIMC_DIMENSIONS_INCLUDE_HIDDEN and BIMC_MEASURES_INCLUDE_HIDDEN: New IS_HIDDEN Column
Includes an IS_HIDDEN column that indicates whether a column associated with a dimension or measure is hidden.
See:
- [Table BIMC_ALL_CUBES](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/table-bimc-all-cubes)
- [Table BIMC_DIMENSIONS](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/table-bimc-dimensions)
- [View BIMC_MEASURES](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/view-bimc-measures)
- [View BIMC_DIMENSIONS_INCLUDE_HIDDEN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/view-bimc-dimensions-include-hidden)
- [View BIMC_MEASURES_INCLUDE_HIDDEN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/view-bimc-dimension-view-include-hidden)

595248220.text:
New Views:
- BIMC_DIMENSION_VIEW_INCLUDE_HIDDEN: Adds an IS_HIDDEN column to identify hidden status of dimension columns, simplifying the management of hidden columns.
- BIMC_ATTRIBUTE_RELATIONS_INCLUDE_HIDDEN: Includes an IS_HIDDEN column to indicate hidden status of attribute relations, providing insights into the intended visibility of attributes..
Modified Views:
- BIMC_DIMENSION_VIEW and BIMC_ATTRIBUTE_RELATIONS: Now filter out entries based on the IS_HIDDEN column, effectively excluding hidden columns from results without directly showing the IS_HIDDEN status.
- BIMC_CUBES: Updated to include DEPRECATED and DEPRECATION_NOTE columns, with DEPRECATED indicating the deprecation status and DEPRECATION_NOTE providing relevant information for a deprecated calculation view.
- [View BIMC_CUBES](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/view-bimc-cubes)
- [View BIMC_DIMENSION_VIEW](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-analytics-catalog-bimc-views-reference/view-bimc-dimension-view)
