595248223.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Build Code, you can now generate HDI artifact definitions from natural-language prompts using SAP Joule, reducing manual effort when creating supported HDI artifacts.
See [Generate HDI Artifact Definitions with SAP Joule](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/65d8751ad0c5471888e04122d6817d4a.html).
595248223.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248224.text:
In the SAP Business Application Studio calculation view editor, a new Keep MDS Cube During Deployment flag is available to retain the existing MDS cube during deployment and block all MDS cube modifications while the flag is active.
See [Quick Reference: Calculation View Properties](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/8a5d5228e41d4083b06e94d60756429b.html).
595248224.title: Calculation Views

595248225.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now open sequence metadata in the Catalog Browser, making it easier to view and verify sequence properties.
See [Context-sensitive Actions on Database Objects in Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/777b7623ca9c4fb58b27ad9f2d5284a8.html).
595248225.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248226.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Business Application Studio, the Project Explorer displays a warning when multiple services are referenced without a target container and offers you an option to select one.
See [Bind Applications to Database Services with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/a3865b12c0354c9fa312f88aa4572b7b.html).
595248226.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248227.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use input parameters to specify client values during currency or unit conversion also in combination with MDS cubes, allowing conversion values to be provided dynamically at query runtime.
See [Define an MDS Cube Based on Elements in a Calculation View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/0e5f70d8c7204cc69839aa9452717753.html).
595248227.title: Calculation Views

595248228.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use Left Outer join type in star joins in combination with multidimensional service (MDS) cubes.
See [Create Calculation Views with Star Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/988f5a9bd87c4492ad5c1e6f7936f0b5.html).
595248228.title: Calculation Views

595248229.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now add restricted (measures) columns to multidimensional services (MDS) cubes.
See [Define an MDS Cube Based on Elements in a Calculation View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/0e5f70d8c7204cc69839aa9452717753.html).
595248229.title: Calculation Views

595248230.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now see a golden key icon next to key columns in the Join Definition tab when creating joins between data sources. This visual cue makes it easier to decide on which columns to join or the join cardinality that should be set.
See [Create Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/2cb2138c9fc04f6f87a3eb88d87df9d6.html).
595248230.title: Calculation Views

595248231.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now open a data source’s design-time artifact from its context menu when tracing data lineage or impact analysis.
See [Trace Objects with Data Lineage](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/13538ddb57924150b3ca62a53749dc99.html).
595248231.title: Calculation Views

595248232.text:
You can now check column lineage in calculation views using the GET_CALC_VIEW_COLUMN_DEPENDENCIES built-in table function.
See [Checking Column Lineage Using Built-In Table Function](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/03669f492ad14ad28fc692dca41cec31.html).
595248232.title: Calculation Views

595248233.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now control column pruning behavior on a calculation view global level to retain columns for further processing in a calculation view.
See:
- [Control Column Pruning in a Calculation View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/dac7170b86f24ed9b389059f75bc214b.html)
- [Quick Reference: Calculation View Properties](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/8a5d5228e41d4083b06e94d60756429b.html)
595248233.title: Calculation Views

595248234.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now create virtual tables that use the SQL on Files syntax directly in the Virtual Table Editor, making it easier to query files stored in SAP Data Lake. In addition, the Virtual Table Editor provides an improved user experience with automatic syntax detection, a syntax selection menu that appears when you open an empty .hdbvirtualtable file, and enhanced error handling.
See [Create Virtual Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/00340d4ede0a43ceb0a67f36bbc46a3a.html).
595248234.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248235.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, the Add Data Source dialog for star joins has been enhanced to show only source objects that can be used in a star join. It now filters out all unsupported source objects, displaying only DIMENSION views or synonyms that reference DIMENSION views.
See [Create Calculation Views with Star Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/988f5a9bd87c4492ad5c1e6f7936f0b5.html).
595248235.title: Calculation Views

595248236.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now choose to minimize memory usage during snapshot creation.
See [Create Snapshots](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/d35f768ce50145d2ad0e5916898f004d.html).
595248236.title: Calculation Views

595248237.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the CARDINALITY, L2NORM, L2NORMALIZE, MEMBER_AT and SUB_VECTOR functions in SQL expressions.
See [Vector Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/613be233134c483cba7b01cb54d12c76.html).
595248237.title: Calculation Views

595248238.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Build Code, you can now optimize SQL statements in the SQL Console using generative AI. From the Run menu, choose Optimize SQL Statement Using AI to generate an optimized version of your query together with a summary of the applied improvements.
See [Optimize SQL Statements Using AI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/c9eb71a2eb7545a5b559be0e9812418d.html).
595248238.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248239.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Build Code, you can now use Joule to generate SQL from natural language using the /hana-sql-gen command, making it easier to get query results without writing SQL manually.
See [Generate SQL from Natural Language Using Joule](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/5e0a1f13559442ce97ba206ebda22f52.html).
595248239.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248240.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Buisness Application Studio, the SAP HANA Projects Explorer now warns if services bound to a database module point to different database hosts, helping you avoid deployment issues.
See [Bind Applications to Database Services with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/a3865b12c0354c9fa312f88aa4572b7b.html).
595248240.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248241.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now bind, unbind, and deploy all modules in a workspace at once using a deployment sequence.
See [Bind Applications to Database Services with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/a3865b12c0354c9fa312f88aa4572b7b.html).
595248241.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248242.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application Dev Space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now view, preview, and download database diagnostic trace files, making it easier to analyze database behavior and performance.
See [Work with Trace Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/af2307a303ca4aeb9ccfd9c2eea56d6c.html).
595248242.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248243.text:
MDS Cubes now support parameter sets, allowing only explicitly defined parameter combinations to be materialized, giving fine-grained control over memory usage and load times.
See [API for Managing MDS Cubes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d70b0b33e4cb4f75bcef56a6d9a7c566.html).
595248243.title: Parameter Set Support for MDS Cubes

595248244.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now convert an existing privilege to a different type (.hdbanalyticprivilege, .hdbstructuredprivilege, or .hdbstructuredfilter) using the graphical editor.
See [Convert Between Different Privilege Types](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/c814b233740d4a65a05ffd494a09c0c5.html).
595248244.title: Calculation Views

595248245.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now choose to show only local objects when adding data sources.
See [Add Data Sources](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/9a0471a69dfd4f92b8c96cf14c731e12.html).
595248245.title: Calculation Views

595248246.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the semi-join (reduce left) in standard join nodes. This join type allows you to efficiently reduce records based on filter values and provides a dedicated option to apply filtering directly within the join.
See [Supported Join Types](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/d5e6e175475f455f95c670bb148abb81.html).
595248246.title: Calculation Views

595248247.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now rename and make alias names unique for previously mapped shared columns.
See [Define Output Columns](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/d4cd2e3bb6794762ab541d12f7b6a3f9.html).
595248247.title: Calculation Views

595248248.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now generate labels for shared alias columns to streamline development and enhance model quality.
See [Assign Labels to Local and Shared Columns](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/3d2c789fda2e444295f108fae5d93005.html).
595248248.title: Calculation Views

595248249.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP HANA in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now duplicate multiple snapshots within a view and copy them between different calculation views based on expressions.
See [Reuse Elements in Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/31dc1587eee24dc8980ae1f8a882e945.html).
595248249.title: Calculation Views

595248250.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for Business Application Studio, you can now remove remote database connections in the SAP HANA Database Explorer.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248250.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248251.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Build Code, you can now use the SAP HANA AI Toolkit for Business Application Studio via Joule to analyze time series data, train forecasting models, and evaluate prediction accuracy. The toolkit also supports visualizing predictions and checking time series characteristics such as trend and seasonality.
See [Use Generative AI for Time Series Forecasting](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/f6f3f7630eae4d419f48c3687a942134.html).
595248251.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248252.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space of SAP Business Application Studio, the database module generator now includes an Advanced Settings option to configure deployment parameters such as stop on error, warning handling, and tracing. The selected options are written to the module’s package.json, enabling easier control of deployment behavior.
See [Create a New Business Application Project](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/f42acff48e164acbb01b1ee969b1282b.html).
595248252.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248253.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space of SAP Business Application Studio, the database module generator now supports binding new database modules to SAP HANA Cloud multi-tenant HDI container services
See [Create a New Business Application Project](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/f42acff48e164acbb01b1ee969b1282b.html).
595248253.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248254.text:
Statement timeouts configured using workload classes now apply for MDS asynchronous batches and non-asynchronous MDS queries.
See [Analyzing Multidimensional Services (MDS) Queries](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-performance-guide-for-developers/analyzing-multi-dimensional-services-mds-queries).
595248254.title: Statement timeout applies for MDS queries

595248255.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space of SAP Business Application Studio, additional SQL Console settings are now available to customize command separation, date and decimal formats, NULL display, result formatting, fractional digits, and the result set limit.
See [User Preferences for SAP HANA Native Application Development Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/57e2fe608bb042d48b799d41a8d121a7.html).
595248255.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248256.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the Explain Plan option in the SQL Console now shows data from both EXPLAIN_PLAN_TABLE and EXPLAIN_CALL_PLANS, providing a more complete view for SELECT statements that internally call procedures or calculation views.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248256.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248257.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Build Code, you can now generate realistic sample data for existing database tables using Generative AI.
See [Generate Sample Data for Tables Using Generative AI](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/5fef1c5b58114d598aa2063a31073254.html).
595248257.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248258.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, table-type input parameters of a table function can be automatically mapped to matching columns from data sources, and scalar input parameters can be mapped to calculation view input parameters or constants.
See [Use Table Functions in Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/7eac113cc1064f71a241a42730360cd7.html).
595248258.title: Calculation Views

595248259.text:
In the calculation view editor within SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use Analytic Data Preview to interactively explore data by toggling measures and dimensions, switching chart types, and viewing tabular data.
See [Preview Calculation View Output](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/903eff885ebd4c5cadb1e0c3e58f681d.html).
595248259.title: Calculation Views

595248260.text:
In the calculation view editor within SAP Business Application Studio, some context menu options have been renamed to improve clarity following the addition of the new Analytic Data Preview option. Specifically, Data Preview has been renamed to Graphical SQL Data Preview, and SQL Editor is now called SQL Data Preview.
See [Preview Calculation View Output](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/903eff885ebd4c5cadb1e0c3e58f681d.html).
595248260.title: Calculation Views

595248261.text:
In the calculation view editor within SAP Business Application Studio, you can now add multi-line comments and labels to the entire calculation view or its individual elements, making it easier to provide clear descriptions, support reuse, and improve team collaboration.
See [Add Comments to Calculation View Objects](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/96e32792ae784fd28f9bbb1619fadd8b.html).
595248261.title: Calculation Views

595248262.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now refactor a view node into a reusable, standalone calculation view to simplify complex models, promote reuse, and improve maintainability.
See [Refactor a View Node into a Standalone Calculation View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/e8eb193ef78243b1b4bfc74268236103.html).
595248262.title: Calculation Views

595248263.text:
In the calculation view editor c, you can now use the HALF_VECTOR data type for calculated columns.
See [Create Calculated Columns](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/5b9254316f854d0fbc3c326c88e8d2e8.html).
595248263.title: Calculation Views

595248264.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now copy and paste one or more hierarchies between different calculation views.
See [Reuse Elements in Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/copying-calculation-view-elements).
595248264.title: Calculation Views

595248265.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now copy and paste one or more window functions between different calculation views.
See [Reuse Elements in Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/copying-calculation-view-elements).
595248265.title: Calculation Views

595248266.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the dependency viewer now enables you to perform the following new actions:
- Expand or collapse all schemas in the dependency graph
- Locate and focus objects with the predictive search box
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248266.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248267.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now copy and paste one or more input parameters, variables, session variables, and fuzzy search parameters between different calculation views.
See [Duplicate Calculation View Elements](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/copying-calculation-view-elements).
595248267.title: Calculation Views

595248268.text:
In SAP Business Application Studio, you can now specify a target SAP HANA database version for a project to control the set of available calculation view features.
See [Set the Database Version for Calculation View Features](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/c02b8f168c9243509ce3bf3af43543e4.html).
595248268.title: Calculation Views

595248269.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now remove temporary views created during intermediate data preview process.
See [Clean Up Intermediate Data Preview Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/29a4bcb2cf0046e38b8f4ef7a7126ddf.html) .
595248269.title: Calculation Views

595248270.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the generative-AI tools included in SAP Build Code to generate SQL statements in the SQL console that use customer-defined data models.
See: [Use a Custom Data Model for AI-Powered SQL Generation](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/caa2444ccccd483c91897c5b64a2af3b.html)
595248270.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248271.text:
The SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio now supports multitenancy, allowing HDI container service instances to be managed via SAP HANA Cloud tenants. The SAP HANA project explorer enables binding database applications to tenant containers of type hdi and schema.
See:
- [Bind Applications to Database Services with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/a3865b12c0354c9fa312f88aa4572b7b.html)
- [Bind an Application to an SAP HANA Cloud Multitenant HDI Container](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4ceaeaaa83d74a3c9a0689e7c4127d89.html)
- [Deploy Artifacts with the SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html)
595248271.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248272.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the Virtual Table Editor to fetch the latest column definitions from the remote source, ensuring that your virtual table reflects any changes to the column structure in the remote database.
See: [Create Virtual Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/00340d4ede0a43ceb0a67f36bbc46a3a.html)
595248272.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248273.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can upgrade the .hdiconfig file for SAP HANA Cloud database modules using the context menu in the SAP HANA Project Explorer or the Explorer tree view of the SAP Business Application Studio.
See: [Upgrading the SAP HDI Container Configuration File](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/fefd891f6a1a416ab299b2118086e589.html)
595248273.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248274.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, an execution hint is now available that lets you control whether currency-converted measures are cast to their target data type before or after aggregation. This option can be accessed from the Select Execution Hint from List dialog.
See [Supported Execution Hints](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/supported-calculation-view-hints) and [Currency Conversion](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/4466fb5b5e3f4388a00b44aad5a4bffa/edd17e36c885447a9b2b66c20e606be0.html) .
595248274.title: Calculation Views

595248275.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now create derived variables that dynamically retrieve values from a selected data source at runtime. Unlike user-provided variables, which require manual input, derived variables are automatically supplied with values by the selected data source.
See [Create Variables](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/77da4b9b6da54529bc699f3338617e81.html).
595248275.title: Calculation Views

595248276.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the VECTOR_EMBEDDING function in SQL expressions.
See [Vector Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/vector-functions).
595248276.title: Calculation Views

595248277.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now copy calculated or restricted columns across different calculations views.
See [Duplicate Calculation View Elements](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/copying-calculation-view-elements).
595248277.title: Calculation Views

595248278.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, an execution hint is now available to enable or disable the automatic removal of duplicate edges in hierarchies, based on local attributes. This option can be accessed from the Select Execution Hint from List dialog.
See [Supported Execution Hints](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/supported-calculation-view-hints).
595248278.title: Calculation Views

595248279.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the SQL console now provides AI-assisted tools that annotate and explain SQL code.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248279.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248280.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the artifact-creation Wizard now supports the following new types of database artifact:
- Fabric Virtual Tables (.hdbfabricvirtualtable)
- Structured Filters (.hdbstructuredfilter)
- Document Store Collection Adjacency Indexes (.hdbcollectionadjindex)
See [SAP HDI Artifact Types and Build Plug-ins Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-deployment-infrastructure-hdi-reference/sap-hdi-artifact-types-and-build-plug-ins-reference).
595248280.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248281.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the Database Explorer to add a new connection to an SAP HANA database.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248281.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248282.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the Database Explorer now provides separate filters for schemas and objects.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248282.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248283.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the Database Explorer provides a new user setting that enables you to specify how to sort the entries in the database list, for example, in ascending or descending order.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248283.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248284.text:
The Structured Filters plug-in (.hdbstructuredfilter) now supports the use of wildcards, for example, when restricting the scope of a calculation view.
See [Structured Filters (.hdbstructuredfilter)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/6671c48d5f314417807aac11e6ae26cf.html).
595248284.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248285.text:
The Analytic Privileges plug-in (.hdbanalyticprivilege) now supports the use of wildcards, for example, when restricting the scope of a calculation view.
See [Analytic Privileges (.hdbanalyticprivilege)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/2d3056363053436898fcf5a3141b482f.html).
595248285.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248286.text:
SAP HDI plug-ins hdbtable and hdbmigrationtable now enable you to take over an existing hdbtable artifact that is not managed by HDI.
See [Migration Tables (.hdbmigrationtable)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/52d1f5acfa754a7887e21226641eb261.html) and [Tables (.hdbtable and .hdbdropcreatetable)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/453d48e28f6747799546236b4b432e58.html).
595248286.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248287.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the SAP HANA Cloud vector engine functions COSINE_SIMILARIT and L2DISTANCE in SQL expressions.
See [Vector Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/vector-functions).
595248287.title: Calculation Views

595248288.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, an execution hint for setting workload classes is now available in the Select Execution Hint from List dialog. The Apply workload class to query on view hint lets you specify the workload class name as the value, for example, WORKLOAD_CLASS("MY_WORKLOAD_CLASS").
See [Supported Execution Hints](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/supported-calculation-view-hints).
595248288.title: Calculation Views

595248289.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now specify for all MDS cubes whether currency conversion should occur at loading time (default setting) or at query time.
See [Quick Reference: Calculation View Properties](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/quick-reference-calculation-view-properties).
595248289.title: Calculation Views

595248290.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, the greedy pruning option is now also available for non-equi joins.
See [Configure Greedy Join Pruning](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/configure-greedy-join-pruning).
595248290.title: Calculation Views

595248291.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, the referential join type is now also available for non-equi joins.
See [Create Non Equi Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/create-non-equi-joins).
595248291.title: Calculation Views

595248292.text:
In SAP Business Application Studio, when adding secured models in the graphical editor of analytic privileges and structured filters, you can now use wildcards to flexibly specify which calculation views should be secured by the privilege.
See:
- [Create Analytic Privileges](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/create-analytic-privileges)
- [Create Static Analytic Privileges](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/create-static-sql-analytic-privileges)
595248292.title: Calculation Views

595248293.text:
You can now use the generative AI assistant Joule in SAP Business Application Studio to get answers to your modeling questions.
See [Get Answers to Modeling Questions (Joule)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/get-answers-to-modeling-questions).
595248293.title: Calculation Views

595248294.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to use the SQL Notebook to test your SQL code on SAP HANA before you run it productively.
See [Test your SQL Code with the SQL Notebook](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4ac88cc7830e43a5bdc6e53eaefed483.html).
595248294.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248295.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the generative-AI tools included in SAP Build Code to help you create SQL code.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
Note
Access to SAP Build Code, the AI-powered Cloud-development environment based on SAP Business Application Studio, requires a subscription.
595248295.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248296.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the generative-AI tools included in SAP Build Code to help you create a new project for your SAP HANA database application.
See [Create a New Business Application Project](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/f42acff48e164acbb01b1ee969b1282b.html).
Note
Access to SAP Build Code, the AI-powered Cloud-development environment based on SAP Business Application Studio, requires a subscription.
595248296.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248297.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the dependency viewer now enables you to perform the following new actions:
- Show cyclic dependencies in the dependency graph
- Restrict dependencies to objects in the local schema
- Limit the direction of the dependency graph
- Set the root object for the dependency graph
See [View DB objects with the DB Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248297.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248298.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now manage HDI objects more conveniently and efficiently in the SAP HANA projects explorer.
See [Deploy Artifacts with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html) and [Restore Design-time Artifacts from the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/e735ec2bac4541339e9301e8cae7ca0b.html).
595248298.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248299.text:
In SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use a graphical editor to create structured filters (artifact .hdbstructuredfilter).
See [Create Analytic Privileges](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/create-analytic-privileges).
595248299.title: Calculation Views

595248300.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use frames in window function nodes. Frames let you flexibly select the scope of the window function calculation.
See [Create Window Function Nodes](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/create-window-function-nodes).
595248300.title: Calculation Views

595248301.text:
When you create snapshots in calculation views, a procedure is now also generated for selectively deleting entries in a snapshot table.
See [Creating Snapshots of Queries on Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-performance-guide-for-developers/creating-snapshots-of-queries-on-calculation-views).
595248301.title: Calculation Views

595248302.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, when you set a transparent filter on a specific node, it is now automatically propagated to the Semantics node. Transparent filters are set on the outgoing side of the column mapping.
See [Use a Transparent Filter](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/use-transparent-filter).
595248302.title: Calculation Views

595248303.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now choose how to make column names unique when propagating columns to the Semantics node.
See [Propagate Columns to Semantics](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/propagate-columns-to-semantics).
595248303.title: Calculation Views

595248304.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, when you delete an intermediate node in a calculation view, you now have the option to connect the adjoining nodes.
See [Connect Adjoining Nodes During Node Removal](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/connect-adjoining-nodes-during-node-removal).
595248304.title: Calculation Views

595248305.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now generate documents for all or a subset of calculation views within a selected folder.
See [Generate a Calculation View Document](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/generate-calculation-view-document).
595248305.title: Calculation Views

595248306.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, the Partition Local Execution option has been renamed Start parallelization based on partitions on the start node and Stop parallelization based on partitions on the stop node.
See [Control Parallelization](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/control-parallelization).
595248306.title: Calculation Views

595248307.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now drag and drop a node onto another node and in this way replace the existing data source.
See [Enrich the Data Flow with Additional Nodes](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/enrich-data-flow-with-additional-nodes).
595248307.title: Calculation Views

595248308.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now copy restricted columns between aggregation nodes in the same calculation view.
See [Duplicate Calculation View Elements](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/copying-calculation-view-elements).
595248308.title: Calculation Views

595248309.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now run intermediate data previews on remote databases as well.
See [Preview Calculation View Output](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/preview-calculation-view-output).
595248309.title: Calculation Views

595248310.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to view the metadata of database tables and indexes.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html) and [Context-sensitive Actions on Database Objects in Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/777b7623ca9c4fb58b27ad9f2d5284a8.html).
595248310.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248311.text:
The SAP HANA projects explorer in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio now provides context-sensitive links to user- and role-management tools in SAP HANA Cockpit.
See [Deploy Artifacts with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248311.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248312.text:
The artifact-creation Wizard in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio now provides additional hints and tips to help with the selection of the artifact type during the creation process.
See [Add Database Artifacts to your SAP HANA Cloud Database Application](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/1aa916563bea48c8a880efba306fb7f9.html).
595248312.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248313.text:
The SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio now enables the user to set a preference (true/false) for fast table migration during deployment.
See [User Preferences for SAP HANA Native Application Development Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/57e2fe608bb042d48b799d41a8d121a7.html).
595248313.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248314.text:
The SAP HANA project explorer in SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio now checks for the HDI deployer version and provides a quick-fix tool that enables you to update the package immediately, if necessary.
See [Deploy Artifacts with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248314.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248315.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, selected graphical editors (for example, for calculation views, synonyms, and virtual tables) now provide a button that enables you to toggle between code and graphical views.
See [Create a Calculation View for your Application in Business Application Studio](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/d74bfe7bb92547d7861e302ee9c062b5.html).
595248315.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248316.text:
The SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio now provides a graphical editor for developing hdbgrants and hdbrevokes files.
See [Bind an Application to a User-Provided Service](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/274e8c16ea244ce3b55edd39d6fb4a7b.html) and [Permissions for Objects in HDI Containers](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/79e8664e99dd4cf98719e7e4e44642e3.html).
595248316.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248317.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, the document generated by the Generate Document function now also includes information about the joins, expressions, MDS cubes, snapshots, and static cache settings used in the calculation view. The information in the General section has also been updated.
See [Generate a Calculation View Document](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/generate-calculation-view-document).
595248317.title: Calculation Views

595248318.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, the selection of data source types last chosen in the Add Data Source dialog is now persisted in the workspace.
See [Add Data Sources](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/add-data-sources).
595248318.title: Calculation Views

595248319.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now copy and paste calculated columns between nodes in a calculation view.
See [Duplicate Calculation View Elements](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/copying-calculation-view-elements).
595248319.title: Calculation Views

595248320.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now enable structured filter checks for a calculation view.
See [Apply Structured Filters or Analytic Privileges](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/apply-structured-filters-or-analytic-privileges).
595248320.title: Calculation Views

595248321.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now validate the syntax of SQL expressions used in non-equi joins.
See [Create Non Equi Joins](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/create-non-equi-joins).
595248321.title: Calculation Views

595248322.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, a target value All Values can now be entered for rank nodes to allow all records to be retrieved.
See [Create Rank Nodes](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/create-rank-nodes).
595248322.title: Calculation Views

595248323.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, the generic join icon that was previously shown for join nodes in the outline pane has now been replaced with join icons that indicate the type of join defined for the join node.
See [Create Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/create-graphical-calculation-views).
595248323.title: Calculation Views

595248324.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, a configurable keyboard shortcut ( Ctrl + Shift + K ) is now available for refreshing the metadata of a calculation view.
See [Keyboard Shortcuts for the Calculation View Editor](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/keyboard-shortcuts-for-calculation-view-editor).
595248324.title: Calculation Views

595248325.text:
In the calculation view editor in SAP Business Application Studio, you can now duplicate window function definitions within a window function node and use the where-used function to find out where a defined window function is used within the calculation view.
See:
- [Duplicate Calculation View Elements](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/copying-calculation-view-elements)
- [Where-Used Functionality](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/where-used-functionality)
595248325.title: Calculation Views

595248326.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to open an SQL console from the SAP HANA project explorer.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248326.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248327.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use a new dedicated Wizard to grant HDI-container schema privileges to other users and roles.
See [Grant HDI-Container Schema Privileges to a Selected User or User Role](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ecd0ce9b48c4f10ad480cd5da1ac8fb.html).
595248327.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248328.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can set a maximum depth for nodes and connections displayed in the dependency viewer.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248328.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248329.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can use the new export feature in the dependency viewer to export a graph snapshot as an image (SVG).
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248329.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248330.text:
In the calculation view editor in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, when you add or delete input parameters in a calculation view, you can now propagate these changes recursively to dependent views.
See [Propagate Adding and Deleting Columns or Input Parameters to Dependent Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/propagate-addition-or-deletion-of-columns).
595248330.title: Calculation Views

595248331.text:
In the calculation view editor in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now flexibly define how column names should be made unique when mapping columns in join nodes.
See [Define Output Columns](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/define-output-columns).
595248331.title: Calculation Views

595248332.text:
In the calculation view editor in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you now have the option to block queries on a deprecated calculation view.
See [Deprecate Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/deprecate-calculation-views).
595248332.title: Calculation Views

595248333.text:
In the calculation view editor in the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now open a calculation view in read-only mode by right-clicking it and choosing Open With…    Calculation View Editor (Read Only).
See [Opening Calculation Views in Read-Only Mode](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-modeling-guide-for-sap-business-application-studio/opening-calculation-views-in-read-only-mode).
595248333.title: Calculation Views

595248334.text:
The handling of NULL values in rank nodes has been aligned with the NULL handling behavior of window function nodes. This means that NULL values are now considered valid values, which is the standard behavior of window function nodes.
Action: To retain the former behavior, a projection node with an IS NOT NULL filter can be added as an input node for the rank node.
See SAP Note [3419990](https://me.sap.com/notes/3419990).
595248334.title: Calculation Views

595248335.text:
The RDF_GRAPH_TO_GRAPH_WORKSPACE built-in procedure maps an RDF graph to a property graph workspace representation.
See [RDF_GRAPH_TO_GRAPH_WORKSPACE Built-In Procedure](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/11afa2e60a5f4192a381df30f94863f9/080-020-000-rdf_graph_to_graph_workspace_builtin_procedure.html).
595248335.title: RDF_GRAPH_TO_GRAPH_WORKSPACE Built-In Procedure

595248336.text:
The RDF_GRAPH_FROM_GRAPH_WORKSPACE built-in procedure maps a property graph workspace to an RDF graph representation.
See [RDF_GRAPH_FROM_GRAPH_WORKSPACE Built-In Procedure](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-property-graph-engine-reference/rdf-graph-from-graph-workspace-stored-procedure).
595248336.title: RDF_GRAPH_FROM_GRAPH_WORKSPACE Built-In Procedure

595248337.text:
The built-in MAX_FLOW function computes the maximum flow possible from a source vertex to a sink vertex.
See:
- [Built-In Graph Algorithms](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/built-in-graph-algorithms)
- [Appendix A - Open Flights, Company and Employees Graph Examples](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/appendix-open-flights-and-company-graph-examples)
- [Appendix C - GraphScript Cheat Sheet](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/appendix-c-graphscript-cheat-sheet)
595248337.title: Max Flow Function

595248338.text:
With QRC 1/2025, the SAP HANA Cloud Graph engine has been renamed to SAP HANA Cloud Property Graph engine. The reason for this change is the introduction of the SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph engine.
Starting with QRC 1/2025, the What's New category for the SAP HANA Cloud Property Graph engine is "Property Graph" and no longer "Graph".
See:
- [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Property Graph Engine Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-property-graph-engine-reference/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-property-graph-engine-reference)
- [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Knowledge Graph Engine Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-knowledge-graph-guide/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-knowledge-graph-engine-guide)
595248338.title: Renaming of SAP HANA Cloud Graph engine

595248339.text:
A Graph Workspace on a JSON collection can be created with a single statement.
See:
- [SAP HANA Graph Data Model](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/sap-hana-graph-data-model)
- [Graph Workspaces](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/graph-workspaces)
- [CREATE GRAPH WORKSPACE Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/create-graph-workspace-statement-data-definition)
- [CREATE ADJACENCY INDEX Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/create-adjacency-index-statement)
- [DROP GRAPH WORKSPACE Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/drop-graph-workspace-statement-data-definition)
- [Appendix A - Open Flights, Company and Employees Graph Examples](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/appendix-open-flights-and-company-graph-examples)
595248339.title: Graph workspace on JSON collections

595248340.text:
The Dijkstra algorithm supports a direction parameter.
See [Graph Traversal Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/graph-traversal-statements)
595248340.title: Direction parameter in Dijkstra algorithm

595248341.text:
GraphScript supports the REAL_VECTOR data type.
See [REAL_VECTOR](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/real-vector)
595248341.title: REAL_VECTOR for GraphScript

595248342.text:
GraphScript table user-defined functions (TUDFs) support debugging.
See [Integration into the SAP HANA Environment](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/integration-into-sap-hana-environment)
595248342.title: Debugging for TUDFs

595248343.text:
The parameter graph_cache_max_size can be changed using the SAP HANA Cockpit.
See [Global Cache Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/global-cache-configuration)
595248343.title: Global Cache Configuration

595248344.text:
GraphScript supports closures. In GraphScript a closure expression can either be defined inline or as a named closure using the CLOSURE keyword.
See:
- [Closures](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/closures)
- [Built-In Graph Algorithms](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/built-in-graph-algorithms)
- [Graph Traversal Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/graph-traversal-statements)
595248344.title: Closures

595248345.text:
In GraphScript the ORDER BY expression can be used on multisets.
See:
- [SEQUENCE](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/11afa2e60a5f4192a381df30f94863f9/58a3522a55ab44dcba2ce1d89974d38c.html)
- [MULTISET](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/11afa2e60a5f4192a381df30f94863f9/9401973fdc25430186a2a7978ea31e57.html)
595248345.title: ORDER BY on multisets

595248346.text:
To define a graph on a JSON collection an adjacency index must be defined.
See:
- [CREATE ADJACENCY INDEX Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/create-adjacency-index-statement)
- [CREATE GRAPH WORKSPACE Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/create-graph-workspace-statement-data-definition)
- [SAP HANA Graph Data Model](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/sap-hana-graph-data-model)
- [Graph Workspaces](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/graph-workspaces)
- [Working with Collections](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/working-with-collections)
- [Complex GraphScript Examples](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/complex-graphscript-examples)
595248346.title: Creation of a graph workspace on JSON collections

595248347.text:
GraphScript supports JSON collection-based graphs. The types for attribute access have to be handled explicitly.
See:
- [SAP HANA Graph Data Model](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/sap-hana-graph-data-model)
- [Graph Workspaces](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/graph-workspaces)
- [Working with Collections](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/working-with-collections)
- [Complex GraphScript Examples](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/complex-graphscript-examples)
595248347.title: GraphScript support for JSON collection-based graphs

595248348.text:
Graph supports SQLScript like type casts.
See [Type Casts](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/type-casts)
595248348.title: Type cast functions

595248349.text:
This statement now supports synonyms for graph workspaces.
See:
- [CREATE SYNONYM Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/create-synonym-statement-data-definition)
- [Complex GraphScript Examples](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/complex-graphscript-examples)
595248349.title: CREATE SYNONYM statement

595248350.text:
The A* algorithm is provided.
See [Built-In Graph Algorithms](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/built-in-graph-algorithms)
595248350.title: Shortest Path Algorithm

595248351.text:
GraphScript supports all spatial functions that do not return ST_GEOMETRY or VARBINARY. In contrast to the use in SQL, the spatial methods are called as functions in GraphScript.
See [Non-Numeric Scalar Types](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/non-numeric-scalar-types)
595248351.title: Spatial functions in GraphScript

595248352.text:
GraphScript supports the cast functions BOOLEAN, TIMESTAMP, DATE.
See [Type Casts](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-graph-reference/type-casts)
595248352.title: Cast functions

595248353.text:
GraphScript supports community detection.
See [Built-In Graph Algorithms](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/11afa2e60a5f4192a381df30f94863f9/3b0a971b129c446c9e40a797bdb29c2b.html)
595248353.title: Community detection

595248354.text:
GraphScript provides the DATE type and DATE functions.
See:
- [Non-Numeric Scalar Types](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/11afa2e60a5f4192a381df30f94863f9/18257903e9944b9c8f1c8f6675db69b4.html)
- [Date and Time Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/11afa2e60a5f4192a381df30f94863f9/7ebb5636217c4186a882dd19880716ab.html)
595248354.title: DATE type, DATE functions

595248355.text:
GraphScript provides the container conversion functions TO_ORDINALITY_MAP and TO_GROUP_SEQUENCE.
See:

595248384.text: The SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine implements GeoSPARQL 1.1. GeoSPARQL is an Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) standard that defines how to represent and query geospatial information in RDF graphs using SPARQL. It provides a standardized approach for working with location-based data in knowledge graphs. See [GeoSPARQL Support](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-knowledge-graph-guide/geosparql-support) and [GeoSPARQL Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sparql-reference-guide/geosparql-functions).

595248391.text:
The SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine lets SAP HANA database users work with knowledge graphs. It's built on the W3C standards and guidelines for graph data, known as Resource Description Format (RDF). RDF contains triples in the format subject-predicate-object. The associated query language is SPARQL. Knowledge graphs are stored in SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine's triple store.
The SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine is an integral part of SAP HANA Cloud. It is an addition to the SAP HANA Cloud multimodel engines.
See:
- [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Knowledge Graph Engine Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-knowledge-graph-guide/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-knowledge-graph-engine-guide)
- [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database SPARQL Reference Guide](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/internal-sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sparql-reference-guide/internal-sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sparql-reference-guide)
With QRC 1/2025, the SAP HANA Cloud Graph engine has been renamed to SAP HANA Cloud property graph engine. The reason for this change is the introduction of the SAP HANA Cloud knowledge graph engine. The name change makes it easier to distinguish between the two products.
Starting with QRC 1/2025, the What's New category for the SAP HANA Cloud property graph engine is "Property Graph" and no longer "Graph".
See [SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Property Graph Engine Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-property-graph-engine-reference/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-property-graph-engine-reference)

A cross encoder is a neural network model that processes two inputs, like a query and a document, together to find their relationship or similarity. It outputs a relevance score. Unlike bi-encoders, which encode inputs separately into vectors, cross encoders analyze the interaction between the input pair at the same time. This allows for clear semantic understanding and accurate results, especially in re-ranking tasks within information retrieval. This quarter, you will be able to use the API interface for the Cross Encoder function. The model is available in the SAP HANA NLP service.
See:
- [Cross Encoder](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/cross-encoder?version=2025_4_QRC)
- [Cross Encoder Model](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/cross-encoder-model?version=2025_4_QRC)
