595248400.text:
The log parse function analyzes logs and extracts log templates.
See [Text Log Parse](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-log-parse?version=2025_4_QRC).
595248400.title: Text Log Parse function (BRAIN)

595248401.text:
Pipeline and AutoML now support the TextEmbedding operator. This feature allows you to convert text data into real vectors for further analysis. You can now process text features similarly to numerical and categorical features for classification and regression tasks in Pipeline and AutoML.
See:
- [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl?version=2025_4_QRC)
- [Pipeline](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pipeline-pipeline?version=2025_4_QRC)
- [Pipeline Operator](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pipeline-operator-pipeline-operator-fd58a3f?version=2025_4_QRC)
595248401.title: New text operator in AutoML

595248402.text:
PAL AutoML for time series can now provide prediction intervals in the prediction results.
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl?version=2025_4_QRC).
595248402.title: Support prediction interval for AutoML time series features

595248403.text:
New parameters, ALLOWED_REGEX_LIST and NOTALLOWED_REGEX_LIST, provide you with the flexibility to use regular expressions for specifying allowed and not allowed lists.
See [Text Tokenize](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-tokenize?version=2025_4_QRC).
595248403.title: Regular expression filter support in text tokenization

595248404.text:
The new PAL_DISTANCE function provides the following distance calculation methods:
- Manhattan
- Euclidean
- Minkowski
- Chebyshev
- Levenshtein (text data)
See [Distance](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/no-content-for-file-distance-md).
595248404.title: Distance function

595248405.text:
Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) is a non-linear dimension reduction method. You can use it for visualization and as pre-processing for other algorithms, such as clustering. The new procedure _SYS_AFL.PAL_UMAP has been added.
See [Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/uniform-manifold-approximation-and-projection)
595248405.title: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP)

595248406.text:
PAL SVM now offers embedded Coreset sampling capabilities with newly introduced parameters: USE_CORESET and CORESET_SCALE. This feature significantly reduces SVM training time with minimal impact on accuracy.
See [Support Vector Machine](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/support-vector-machine-support-vector-machine-901a10d).
595248406.title: Coreset support in Suppot Vector Machine (SVM)

595248407.text:
PAL AutoML now offers new target encoding capabilities. The AutoML framework automatically analyzes dataset cardinality to decide whether to use target encoding or another encoding method. For features with higher cardinality, target encoding can significantly improve performance.
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl).
595248407.title: Target encoding support in AutoML

595248408.text:
The following functions support real vector type from this release:
- Spectral clustering
- Cluster assignment
- Decision tree
- Sampling
- Half-precision vector type support in AutoML
595248408.title: Real vector type support

595248409.text:
The time series outlier detection outputs an outlier threshold. If a data point exceeds this threshold, it is considered a potential outlier without needing to rerun the detection function. The parameter related to this change is OUTPUT_OUTLIER_THRESHOLD. Setting it to one enables the feature, but it introduces additional calculations.
See [Outlier Detection](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/outlier-detection-outlier-detection-17253b4).
595248409.title: Threshold support in time series outlier detection

595248410.text:
PAL introduces tracking and scheduling functions to help you manage machine learning experiments.
- The track function logs parameters, dataset metadata, metrics, model signatures, and figure data to predefined tables when running PAL procedures. You can later reproduce, visualize results, or use derived models for inference and evaluation. The tracking-enabled interface provides additional log tables and APIs for you to trace and manage processes.
- The scheduled execution function allows SQLScript procedures to run in scheduler jobs, focusing on PAL procedures. Unlike traditional synchronous execution, scheduled execution supports asynchronous, time-frequency-based processes.
- The Python Machine Learning Client for SAP HANA includes additional client-side interfaces and a GUI.
See:
- [PAL Track](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pal-track)
- [Calling PAL with Schedule](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/calling-pal-with-schedule)
595248410.title: Machine learning lifecycle management

595248411.text:
Constraints provide extra information to guide the clustering process, ensuring results align with specific requirements or prior knowledge. There are two types of constraints:
- Pairwise constraints: Must-link constraints require two data points to be in the same cluster. Cannot-link constraints ensure two data points are not in the same cluster.
- Triplet Constraints: With an anchor instance (a), a positive instance (p), and a negative instance (n), the constraint shows that instance a is more similar to p than to n.
See [Constrained Clustering](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/constrained-clustering).
595248411.title: Constrained clustering

595248412.text:
The Isolation Forest algorithm has been enhanced:
- A new interface, ISOLATION_FOREST_EXPLAIN_ANY, has been added to support Shapley value output.
- Categorical feature support is now enabled.
- A new interface for massive processing has been introduced.
See [Isolation Forest](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/isolation-forest-isolation-forest-11345d9).
595248412.title: Isolation Forest enhancement

595248413.text:
The new PAL_TEXT_TOKENIZE procedure helps you tokenize input text into tokens for further processing.
See [Text Tokenize](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-tokenize).
595248413.title: Text Tokenize API

595248414.text:
Support for vector types is enabled across the following features and algorithms:
- AutoML, including the fit, prediction, scoring, and pipeline procedures
- K-Nearest Neighbour
- Random Decision Trees
- Multi-Task Multilayer Perceptron
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl), [KNN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/knn-knn-f2440c6), [Random Decision Trees](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/random-decision-trees-random-decision-trees-9ad576a), and [Multi-Task Multilayer Perceptron](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-task-multilayer-perceptron).
595248414.title: Real vector support in AutoML and additional algorithms

595248415.text:
The ARIMA prediction function now supports both continuous indexing and reindexing for time series data.
See [ARIMA](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/arima-arima-dbd52a1).
595248415.title: ARIMA enhancement

595248416.text:
The multi-task multilayer perceptron now supports built-in cross-validation.
See [Multi-Task Multilayer Perceptron](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-task-multilayer-perceptron).
595248416.title: Multi-Task Multilayer Perceptron enhancement

595248417.text:
PAL introduces a new embedding model called SAP_GXY. Below are detailed updates regarding the models and infrastructure improvements:
- The model supports eight languages, with three new languages—Chinese (ZH), Japanese (JP), and Italian (IT)—added compared to the first model, SAP_NEB.
- This model improves accuracy in multiple languages.
- This model enhances short text embedding capabilities.
- This model increases the default maximum token limit to 512.
- The NER model's accuracy and robustness are also improved.
Note
In QRC 2/2025, we switched the serving infrastructure from TensorFlow to PyTorch. This change may cause slight decimal differences in the embedded vector of the previous SAP_NEB model version 20240715. The overall impact on the STS and Q&A task results will be minor. If needed, you can re-embed the previous content to eliminate these differences. This is a one-time change.
See [Text Embedding Model](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-embedding-model).
595248417.title: New NLP model and infrastructure update

595248418.text:
PAL introduced the following enhancements to HGBT:
- Linear Tree Support: Introduced new parameters, MODEL_TREE and LINEAR_LAMBDA, to extend support for linear trees.
- Multi-Target Support: Enhanced the DEPENDENT_VARIABLE parameter to enable multiple target regression when set to REAL_VECTOR or when multiple entities are present. Ensure all targets are continuous features.
- Multiple Classification Enhancement: Implemented the USE_VEC_LEAF parameter to support vector leaf features in multiple classifications.
See [Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-ca5106c).
595248418.title: Enhancements to Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree (HGBT)

595248419.text:
The BM25 search algorithm now accepts plain text input. It automatically extracts keywords from your text for improved search results.
See [BM25 Search](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/bm25-search).
595248419.title: Support for plain text input in BM25

595248420.text:
Multitask MLP has the following enhancements:
- Added support for Shapley value explanation.
- Enabled multitask capabilities in the unified functions.
See [Multi-Task Multilayer Perceptron](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-task-multilayer-perceptron).
595248420.title: Multitask multilayer perceptron (MLP) enhancements

595248421.text:
AutoML now can use the hyperband search method with random search to accelerate the search speed for small datasets.
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl).
595248421.title: New search method introduced in AutoML

595248422.text:
Text embedding is the process of converting words into a numerical form that can be understood and utilized by machine learning algorithms. This method represents a word or a piece of text as a high-dimensional vector within a predefined space, where words or text with similar meanings are positioned closer to one another.
See [Text Embedding](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-embedding).
595248422.title: Text embedding

595248423.text:
The new text analysis service currently supports the following tasks: Named Entity Recognition (NER) NER, also known as named entity identification, entity chunking, or entity extraction, is a sub-task of information extraction. It seeks to locate and classify named entities mentioned in unstructured text into predefined categories such as person names, organizations, locations, medical codes, time expressions, quantities, monetary values, and percentages. Sentiment Analysis Sentiment Analysis assigns a sentiment score, which is a numerical representation of the sentiment or emotion conveyed in a piece of text, such as a tweet, product review, or article. It indicates whether the sentiment expressed is positive, negative, or neutral. This task outputs sentiment at the document, sentence, and word levels. Part of Speech (POS) Analysis POS analysis classifies words based on their role in a sentence. Examples of POS tags include nouns, verbs, and adjectives.
See [Text Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-analysis-textanalysis).
595248423.title: Text analysis

595248424.text:
ANN search is a swift algorithm used to identify the nearest data points to a given input in large datasets. It approximates distances rather than calculating exact values, which saves time and computational resources, making it efficient for searching in high-dimensional spaces.
See [ANN Search](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/ann-search).
595248424.title: Approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search

595248425.text:
Text chunking, also known as shallow parsing, is a process in natural language processing (NLP) that groups words into chunks of information. These chunks usually consist of words that come together to form phrases. The following three major chunking methods are now supported: Character Splitting Character splitting is the simplest form of chunking, where the text is dissected into chunks of N-characters, completely oblivious of the content or structure of the text. Recursive Splitting The shortcoming of character splitting is its neglect of the organization of the document, as it indiscriminately splits based on a fixed character count. Document Splitting The objective of this splitting procedure is to modify the chunking strategy to suit different data formats or languages. The PlainText and HTML splitters are similar to recursive splitting, but they use different separators or are adapted to different languages.
See [Text Chunking](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-chunking).
595248425.title: Text chunking

595248426.text:
A new full-text search method utilizes the BM25 ranking function to rerank the TF-IDF results. BM25 is part of the family of probabilistic information retrieval models and is an extension of the Binary Independence Model (BIM). BM25 is widely used due to its effectiveness and simplicity.
See [BM25 Search](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/bm25-search).
595248426.title: Best matching 25 (BM25) search

595248427.text:
PCA is a tailored version of PCA for vector-based input and output data. In the realm of vector embedding applications, such as word embedding, document embedding, and image embedding, nearly all input and output data are vector-based. In the HANA Cloud database, the vector-based data type is supported by the SQL type REAL_VECTOR. With the procedures provided by this algorithm, you can reduce high-dimensional vector data to lower-dimensional vector data while accounting for as much of the variation in the original data as possible.
See [Vector Principal Component Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/vector-principal-component-analysis).
595248427.title: Vector principal component (VPC) analysis

595248428.text:
The outlier operator is also available in the AutoML regression scenario.
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl).
595248428.title: Outlier operator for AutoML regression

595248429.text:
Multi-task MLP has the following enhancements:
- Supports state model prediction
- Supports online training and fine-tuning
- Supports categorical variables (integer type)
- Replaces the MLP operator in AutoML
- Supports vector type
See [Multi-Task Multilayer Perceptron](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-task-multilayer-perceptron).
595248429.title: Enhanced multi-task multilayer perceptron (MLP)

595248430.text:
The vector data type is supported as input data for the following algorithms:
- PCA
- KMEANS
- HGBT
- Multi-task MLP
- MLP recommender
595248430.title: Vector type support in clustering algorithms

595248431.text:
Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) is a popular clustering algorithm. Hierarchical Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (HDBSCAN) is a novel algorithm that also uses the idea of density but in a hierarchical way.
See [HDBSCAN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hdbscan).
595248431.title: HDBSCAN

595248432.text:
The vector data type is supported as input data for the following algorithms:
- HDBSCAN
- DBSCAN
See [HDBSCAN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hdbscan) and [DBSCAN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/dbscan-dbscan-b2c5511).
595248432.title: Vector type support in clustering algorithms

595248433.text:
The Multi-target MLP now includes the following enhanced features:
- Batch training support: You can enable this feature by setting the new parameter TRAINING_STYLE to '0'.
- ResNet network support: You can use this network type by setting the newly introduced parameter NETWORK_TYPE to '1'.
See [Multi-Task Multilayer Perceptron](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-task-multilayer-perceptron).
595248433.title: Enhanced multi-task multilayer perceptron

595248434.text:
AutoML introduced the following new features:
- Massive interface support
- Auto-selection of the folder number parameter in time series scenarios
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl).
595248434.title: AutoML enhancements

595248435.text:
LTSF now supports two new network types:
- RLinear: This network type uses simple linear layers with reversible instance normalization (RevIN).
- RMLP: You can now use this simple MLP model with reversible instance normalization (RevIN).
See [Long-Term Series Forecasting](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/long-term-series-forecasting-long-term-series-forecasting-060735d).
595248435.title: Long-term series forecasting (LTSF) enhancements

595248436.text:
PAL introduces an enhancement version of the text classification algorithm.
The new text classification algorithm uses RDT as the classifier instead of the old KNN classifier. The accuracy of text classification is also improved. The following two procedures are now added to the PAL library:
- _SYS_AFL.PAL_TEXTCLASSIFICATION_TRAIN
- _SYS_AFL.PAL_TEXTCLASSIFICATION_PREDICT
See [Text Classification with Model (Train)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-classification-train) and [Text Classification with Model (Predict)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-classification-predict).
595248436.title: Text classification

595248437.text:
PAL introduces a replacement MLP function with performance acceleration, and multi-target capability support. The following two procedures are now added to the PAL library:
- _SYS_AFL.PAL_MULTILAYER_PERCEPTRON_NEW
- _SYS_AFL.PAL_MULTILAYER_PERCEPTRON_NEW_PREDICT
See [Multi-Task Multilayer Perceptron](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-task-multilayer-perceptron).
595248437.title: Multi-task multilayer perceptron

595248438.text:
This new _SYS_AFL.PAL_OUTLIER_DETECTION_FOR_REGRESSION function can detect the point outliers from the regression scenario. It supports the following types of regression models:
- linear model
- tree model
See [Outlier Detection for Regression](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/outlier-detection-for-regression).
595248438.title: Outlier detection for regression functions

595248439.text:
- New FINETUNE_BESTPIPELINE function allows you to do continuous update on the selected best pipeline model.
- Random search is now supported in the SEARCH_METHOD parameter to support rarely small configurations.
- AutoML log now supports deletion with the new added procedure: PAL_REMOVE_AUTOML_LOG.
See [Optimization](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/optimization-optimization) and [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl).
595248439.title: Enhancements to AutoML

595248440.text:
In additional to the original Kernel SHAP method, SHAPGlobal surrogate model is added for the EXPLAIN_METHOD parameter of the PAL_PIPELINE_FIT function to provide a light weighted fast method of pipeline explain.
See [Pipeline](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pipeline-pipeline-de96493).
595248440.title: Enhancements to Pipeline

595248441.text:
The Hull-White model is a single-factor interest rate model that plays a crucial role in financial mathematics and risk management. The Hull-White model is particularly significant because it provides a framework for understanding how interest rates evolve over time, which is vital for pricing various financial instruments like bonds and interest rate derivatives.
See [Hull-White](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hull-white).
595248441.title: New algorithm Hull White model

595248442.text:
Benford's Law, also known as the first-digit law, is a statistical technique used to detect anomalies or irregularities in numerical data sets.
See [Benford Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/benford-analysis).
595248442.title: New algorithm Benford Analysis

595248443.text:
New parameter FAIR_EXCLUDE_SENSITIVE_VARIABLE is added to the PAL_FAIRML function to decide whether or not to exclude sensitive variables in the training process. By default the sensitive variables are excluded.
See [Fair ML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/fair-ml).
595248443.title: An enhancement to Fair ML

595248444.text:
- Added a new objective function reweighted square for HGBT regression through the new parameter value 10 of the OBJ_FUNC parameter in the PAL_HGBT method.
- New parameter VALIDATION_SET_METRIC to specify the metric for early stop of HGBT.
- Added new values into the parameter EVALUATION_METRIC for cross validation:
- F1_SCORE
- RECALL
- PRECISION
- New parameters SCALE_WEIGHT and SCALE_WEIGHT_TARGET are added to the scale instance weight with specified labels.
See [Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-ca5106c).
595248444.title: Enhancements to HGBT

595248445.text:
Now MLP recommender can support multiclass classification and regression tasks by specifying different targets in the input DATA table.
See [MLP Recommender](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/mlp-recommender).
595248445.title: MLP recommender support in multiclass classification and regression tasks

595248446.text:
Permutation feature importance is a feature evaluation method that measures the decrease in the model score when PAL randomly shuffles the feature's values. It reveals how much the model relies on the feature for prediction by breaking the association between the feature and the true outcome. Support of unified regression is added this quarter.
See [Permutation Importance](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/permutation-importance-permutation-importance-regression) for unified regression and [Permutation Importance](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/permutation-importance-permutation-importance-regression-pivoted) for unified regression with pivoted data.
595248446.title: Permutation feature importance support for unified regression

595248447.text:
The text mining feature added a group of massive text item input functions as follows:
- get related documents with mass processing
- get related terms with mass processing
- get relevant documents with mass processing
- get relevant terms with mass processing
- get suggested terms with mass processing
See [Text Mining](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/text-mining-text-mining-96687ab).
595248447.title: Massive input interfaces for text mining functions

595248448.text:
New parameter value 2: Matrix enabled searching is added to the METHOD parameter of PAL_KNN and PAL_KNN_CV procedures. The new matrix-enabled searching performs faster but it only works when DISTANCE_LEVEL is set to 2 and the STRING_VARIABLE parameter is specified.
See [KNN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/knn-knn-f2440c6).
595248448.title: An enhancement to KNN

595248449.text:
You can now define and filter parent-child hierarchies in search views, enhancing the ability to organize and retrieve hierarchical data efficiently. This development is beneficial for users who need to manage complex data structures and improve search accuracy by leveraging parent-child relationships.
See [Parent-Child Hierarchies](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/d9162c384487493f963a248155229062.html)
See [Entity Type Annotations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/0c2af3198cdf4218bb477657f5f3ac33.html)
595248449.title: Parent-Child Hierarchy Support

595248450.text:
Fuzzy text searches with MIME TYPE and TOKEN SEPARATORS parameters can now be used with ESH_SEARCH().
See [Fuzzy Search Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/79cbd8c7ec3340848e0654c67b45bc00.html)
595248450.title: Support MIME TYPE and TOKEN SEPARATORS parameters

595248451.text:
To avoid high resource consumption, the maximum number of search terms is limited. The new parameter MaxConsecutiveTerms allows to change this limit.
See [Changing the Token Limit](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/dc159f79c21f491da8d756ace637a999.html)
595248451.title: Block Long Freestyle and Suggestion Searches

595248452.text:
The CREATE FUZZY SEARCH INDEX statement now supports the ONLINE and ONLINE PREFERRED options. Additionally, these options are now supported for the DROP INDEX statement when dropping a fuzzy search index.
See [Fuzzy Search Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/79cbd8c7ec3340848e0654c67b45bc00.html)
595248452.title: Create Fuzzy Search Index Online [Preferred]

595248453.text:
The CHECK_TABLE_CONSISTENCY procedure now supports consistency checks for fuzzy text indexes.
See [Table Consistency Check](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/9357bf52c7324bee9567dca417ad9f8b.html)
595248453.title: Fuzzy Text Indexes Consistency Checks

595248454.text: The performance of the delta merge process for fuzzy text indexes has been improved.
595248454.title: Fuzzy Text Indexes Delta Merge Process Performance

595248455.text:
Fuzzy text indexes now support BLOB columns with text stored in ABAP raw string format or SAP compression format.
See [Fuzzy Text Search](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/19f6ec2fa6734449a3336e6ebdbd08b4.html)
[Fuzzy Text Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/73a3d2544c404d71a7bbd72b20c9bf24.html)
[Migrating From Fulltext Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/9efa6da20d8f459d88e8d62b92a9091a.html)
595248455.title: Fuzzy Text Indexes Support BLOB Columns

595248456.text:
Fuzzy text indexes now support user-defined token separators.
See [CREATE FUZZY SEARCH INDEX Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/9b79b31dde1b4f6d84144fba8d942bd3.html)
[Processing a Search](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/4299719b43724c55b6c9dded704a28f6.html)
595248456.title: Fuzzy Text Indexes Support User-defined Token Separators

595248457.text:
Fuzzy text indexes now support hybrid NCLOBs and are not limited to in-place NCLOBs anymore.
See [Fuzzy Search Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/79cbd8c7ec3340848e0654c67b45bc00.html)
[Fuzzy Text Search](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/19f6ec2fa6734449a3336e6ebdbd08b4.html)
[Migrating From Fulltext Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/9efa6da20d8f459d88e8d62b92a9091a.html)
595248457.title: Fuzzy Text Indexes Support Hybrid NCLOBs

595248458.text:
It is now possible to combine the search option andThreshold with the search options for term mappings and compounds composeWords, decomposeWords.
See [Soft AND](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/9f14874336ac4f8e998e6dbcc7d3652b.html)
595248458.title: Combine andThreshold with Other Search Options

595248459.text:
Several search options of fulltext indexes are now available for fuzzy text indexes.
The new search options are:
- abbreviationSimilarity
- andSymmetric
- phraseCheckFactor
See [Initial Characters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/242a6d9babf44a05ab4f661c7935e14e.html)
[Symmetric AND](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/08266e42d1bd4a23b95869ed7d4594d3.html)[Check for Phrases](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/9558cf96294349dfbd8b958edc94097c.html)
595248459.title: Additional Search Options

595248460.text:
The new Enterprise Search API version 40003 is now available. With version 40003, the columns of a subobject are consistently named <subobjectname>/<columnname> in the whole interface of ESH_SEARCH(), for example ADDRESS/CITY. In previous Enterprise Search API versions, the column name without the subobject name was used in some parts of the interface.
See [API Version Information](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-search-developer-guide/api-version-information).
595248460.title: Updated API Version

595248461.text:
The AUTH: operator can now hide the values of some columns of a row in the search view, instead of hiding the complete row.
See [Access Control](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/8e04a2ae425449698a7e1cc36bc879dd.html).
595248461.title: Hide Sensitive Data

595248462.text:
The new property annotation @EnterpriseSearchHana.genericPersistency.valueElement defines the name of the column that contains the value for the given classification property. It is used to improve the performance of enterprise search calls on views that contain a classification model.
See [Property Annotations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/9d659b938f83495b9ca409a31cb2e400.html).
595248462.title: Reference to the value column of a property

595248463.text:
The fuzzy search modes identifier and alphanum_identifier now support improved search results. For example:
- Hits at the beginning of a value are returned with the highest score
- Identifier search finds values if the terms matches are in the middle of the value. These results are returned with a lower score
See [Identifiers](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/9772ca9db23b4989a8549a8e88c0e685.html?locale=en-US).
595248463.title: Improved Indentifier Search Results

595248464.text:
It is possible to create fuzzy search indexes using the HANA Deployment Infrastructure (HDI).
See [Fuzzy Search Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/79cbd8c7ec3340848e0654c67b45bc00.html?locale=en-US).
595248464.title: Index creation with HDI

595248465.text:
You can now add classification columns to the suggestion columns to get useful suggestions for classification property values.
See [Method 'GetSuggestion' - Suggestion Call](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/5bef7e4e3fd04a649111a3a5d7573f3b.html?locale=en-US).
595248465.title: GetSuggestion Classification Search

595248466.text: It is possible to use fuzzy text search for NCLOB columns.[Fuzzy Search Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/79cbd8c7ec3340848e0654c67b45bc00.html?locale=en-US)
595248466.title: Fuzzy search indexes on NCLOB columns

595248467.text: NCLOB columns are automatically converted to MEMORY THRESHOLD NULL when a fuzzy search index is created on that column.[Fuzzy Search Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/79cbd8c7ec3340848e0654c67b45bc00.html?locale=en-US)
595248467.title: Auto-Conversion of Hybrid NCLOBs to in-Place NCLOBs

595248468.text: It is possible to use fuzzy text search with search rule sets.[Search Rules](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/cf53fc0fd9761014b66eb88440af8a38.html?locale=en-US)
595248468.title: Fuzzy text search for search rule sets

595248469.text:
It is possible to create a fuzzy search index on page-loadable columns (NSE).[Fuzzy Search Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/79cbd8c7ec3340848e0654c67b45bc00.html?locale=en-US)
[Reduce the Memory Footprint Using Page-Loadable Columns in SAP HANA NSE](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/786c621dd35e4534a2f955bf2f04a2e2.html?locale=en-US)
595248469.title: Fuzzy search indexes supports page-loadable columns (NSE)

595248470.text:
The new annotation CREATE FUZZY SEARCH INDEX can be used to create a fuzzy search index on a given column.
[Fuzzy Search Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/79cbd8c7ec3340848e0654c67b45bc00.html?locale=en-US)
595248470.title: Create fuzzy search indexes

595248471.text:
The fuzzy text index stores information that is extracted from all the textual values in the column to make a text search faster.
[Fuzzy Text Indexes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/05c9edaee7fe4d28ab3627d0b1583df6/73a3d2544c404d71a7bbd72b20c9bf24.html?locale=en-US)
595248471.title: Fuzzy Text Indexes

595248472.text:
When using active/active configurations, you can now monitor all audited activities from both your source and read-only replica systems directly in the AUDIT_LOG system table. Audit logs from your replica are automatically shipped to the source system and combined into a unified view, making it easy to track what’s happening across your entire setup.
See:
- [Auditing Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c6c1dbc66caa41499f173220503aec94.html)
- [Active/Active (Read-Enabled) Replicas](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/cf23102e98b94b86b6cbaca493bca4be.html)
595248472.title: Audit Log for Active-Active (read-enabled) Replica

595248473.text:
Strict hostname validation behavior has been enabled for outgoing TLS connection. This ensures that connections are refused if hostname validation fails.
The hostname validation behavior is configurable.
[3656433](https://me.sap.com/notes/3656433)
595248473.title: TLS Hostname Validation for Secure Connections

595248474.text:
It is now possible to configure X.509 identity providers for automatic user creation in conjunction with LDAP group authorization.
This means that if you use an LDAP-compliant directory server to manage users and their access to resources, you can now leverage this infrastructure to provision the database users required for X.509-authenticated users.
A database user can be automatically created for a X.509-authenticated user if the user exists in your LDAP server and this user is a member of at least one LDAP group mapped to at least one SAP HANA role.
See:
595248474.title: Automatic User Creation for X.509 Authentication

595248475.text:
You need to upgrade your trust stores to include the DigiCert TLS RSA4096 Root G5 certificate to ensure compatibility with existing trust bundles, allowing seamless server certificate functionality. This is crucial for maintaining secure connections to SAP HANA Cloud systems, as migration to the regular G5 certificate chain is planned for the end of 2025.
. See [Secure Communication Between SAP HANA and SAP HANA Clients](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/dbd3d887bb571014bf05ca887f897b99.html).
[3397584](https://me.sap.com/notes/3397584)
595248475.title: DigiCert TLS RSA4096 Root G5 certificate

595248476.text:
Audit policies can now be configured to only generate audit log entries based on the user's authentication method of the user connection.
. See [CREATE AUDIT POLICY Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20d3d56075191014af43d6487fcaa603.html).
595248476.title: Authentication-Based Audit Log Configuration

595248477.text:
The introduction of USER_TENANT_NAME and OBJECT_TENANT_NAME columns in the HANA audit log simplifies the analysis of tenant-related activities. These columns provide clear identification of the tenant associated with users and objects.
. See [Audit Trail Layout for Trail Target Database Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/97151bbcef8b4cdaa801ff9df45d0fbf.html).
595248477.title: Tenant Name Columns in Audit Log

595248478.text: It is now possible to assign the same issuer to multiple X.509 providers. The new field PRIORITY is used to determine the order in which the providers are tried for authentication. See [X.509 Certificate-Based User Authentication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/2b335f7eec6a450095f110ea961d77cc.html)[CREATE X509 PROVIDER Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/3b3163d6ad0f4eb9bd73c7c060f49649.html).
595248478.title: Multi-Provider X.509 Issuer Assignment

595248479.text: Enhanced JWT token processing allows the integration of new providers by automatically switching to the next suitable provider if the current one lacks mapping or user creation configuration. This feature minimizes disruptions and ensures smooth transitions when provider priorities change. See [Single Sign-On Using JSON Web Tokens](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/4b3dc4d4b5514dbd9d45cee7bc167c5a.html).
595248479.title: JWT Authentication Checks All Matching Providers

595248480.text: The SAP HANA database now optimizes user connections by ignoring redundant CONNECT statements when the user name matches the current session user. See [Configuration Parameters SAP HANA Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/138dcf7d779543608917a2307a6115f2/5b8196f1bd734e97869b2b03a06e5f9e.html).
595248480.title: Ignore CONNECT SQL statement

595248481.text:
The CONNECT SQL Statement now supports X.509 authentication.
See [X.509 Certificate-Based User Authentication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/2b335f7eec6a450095f110ea961d77cc.html).
[CONNECT Statement (Session Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20d3b9ad751910148cdccc8205563a87.html).
595248481.title: X.509 authentication for CONNECT SQL statement

595248482.text: The SAP Identity Provisioning Service, part of SAP Cloud Identity Services, features a plugin for the SAP HANA Database Service which allows for the management of users and their role assignments.
595248482.title: SAP Identity Provisioning Service for SAP HANA Cloud

595248483.text:
The existing matching rule string for an X.509 certificate now supports '?' as an additional wildcard. If an attribute is matched with a '?', its content will be ignored.
See [X.509 Certificate-Based User Authentication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/2b335f7eec6a450095f110ea961d77cc.html).
595248483.title: X.509 Authentication Certificate Matching Extension

595248484.text:
You can now restrict connections based on the authentication method a user in a user group is using for authentication.
See [Connect Restrictions](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/882d94847a934f6793f2e009a22a3846.html).
595248484.title: Authentication method Connect Restrictions for User Groups

595248485.text:
The SAP HANA database now supports managed certificate collections (Managed PSEs), a dedicated certificate collection which retrieves trusted certificate/keys from another secure location via HTTPS.
See [Managed Certificate Collections](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/d136c1b2296044dfaa99dcbbc7770f38.html).
595248485.title: Managed Certificate Collections

595248486.text:
An alert is triggered when connection attempts fail due to user group connect restrictions.
See:
[HDB User Group Connect Restriction](https://help.sap.com/docs/ALERT_NOTIFICATION/5967a369d4b74f7a9c2b91f5df8e6ab6/fd7421c32a744f7e8ff8edd0410ad0d3.html)
[Connect Restrictions](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/882d94847a934f6793f2e009a22a3846.html)
595248486.title: Alert for User Group Connect Restrictions

595248487.text:
SAP HANA database now supports all SQL capabilities for dynamic analytic privileges, for example the specification of filter conditions.
See:
[Structure of Analytic Privileges](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/349f423ce2154e3e9b39ed525d46aa94.html)
[Examples: Securing Views Using SQL-Based Analytic Privileges](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/63efa79c963d4243ad2a894e2b5bd10c.html)
595248487.title: Full SQL expressiveness for Dynamic Analytic Privileges

595248488.text:
The following cipher suites for the TLS 1.2 protocol are no longer supported due to their non-compliance with SGS standards:
- TLS_RSA_WITH_AES128_GCM_SHA256
- TLS_RSA_WITH_AES256_GCM_SHA384
If you are using an unsupported system, refer to the SAP Note to verify if you are affected and for possible solutions.
See:
[3446927](https://me.sap.com/notes/3446927)
[Secure Communication Between SAP HANA and SAP HANA Clients](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/dbd3d887bb571014bf05ca887f897b99.html)
595248488.title: Discontinued Support for Select Cipher Suites

595248489.text:
You can now replicate data from Delta tables directly into SAP HANA tables when you use the file or deltasharing adapters. You can use a remote subscription or toggle replica tables and choose between user-driven and system-scheduled replication methods.
See:
- [Replicating Delta Tables to SAP HANA](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/replicating-delta-tables-to-sap-hana)
- [Toggle Between Virtual Tables and Replica Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/toggle-between-virtual-tables-and-replica-tables)
595248489.title: Replication for Delta tables

595248490.text:
Certain remote source capabilities and SQL hints allow pushing join, semi-join, and SINGLE aggregation operations to the remote source to reduce data transfer and improve performance.See:
- [Query Performance Optimization](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/192a8e76f58a4112a125f983c25215ba)
- [Remote Join Relocation](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/a8afba5d999f49638b73d560a1226851)
- [Remote Semi-Join](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/0f03b84455f84a2b8589a3c4fb6a6859)
- [Remote SINGLE Aggregation](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/62a40f6722ee4622bcb6096ebce536d4)
595248490.title: Optimize query performance by pushing operations down to remote sources

595248491.text: You can now create a remote source to Google Sheets spreadsheets and Oracle data sources.See [Create a Google Sheets Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/0df3392ed6144a71896aafd8167e56f8) and [Create an Oracle Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/dc30f821f8bd4e0d854d7dcd0b2ca792)
595248491.title: Create Google Sheets and Oracle remote sources

595248492.text:
You can now create virtual tables to Apache Iceberg tables on SQL on Files remote sources using the file adapter. Additionally, time travel queries are supported on remote Iceberg tables, and the built-in functions GET_ICEBERG_SNAPSHOTS and GET_VIRTUAL_TABLE_FILES_PARTITIONS allow you to retrieve information about Iceberg snapshots and their partitions.
See:
- [Create a Virtual Table](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/create-virtual-table)
- [Time Travel Queries on Iceberg Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/time-travel-queries-on-iceberg-tables)
- [GET_ICEBERG_TABLE_SNAPSHOTS Function](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/get-iceberg-table-snapshots)
- [GET_VIRTUAL_TABLE_FILE_PARTITIONS Function](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/get-virtual-table-file-partitions)
595248492.title: Virtual table support for Apache Iceberg tables

595248493.text:
ATR/OSTR replica tables offer a more efficient method for initializing remote table replication (RTR) tables by utilizing local table copies, reducing dependency on network speed. This feature optimizes performance when frequently adding or removing RTR replica tables, especially in environments with Elastic Compute Nodes.
See [Table Replication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/33dd5d248add4b7a8c085846748b80ba.html), [Table Replication Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/7683a6b0e9f649808cb956cd50087c5f.html).
595248493.title: Replica Table Initialization with ATR/OSTR

595248494.text: You can now access Snowflake remote data sources based on your roles / authorization accounts instead of by service account or technical user.
595248494.title: User Propagation to Remote Source

595248495.text:
The adapter property PROP_PUSH_DOWN_HINT lets you push hints to target remote sources to improve query performance.
See [HINT Details](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/4ba9edce1f2347a0b9fcda99879c17a1.html), [Configure Remote Source Hint Pushdown](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/25b2305a4a7a46b0bdb542fce35341f8.html).
595248495.title: Allow hint injection to remote sources

595248496.text:
You can now create a remote source to Snowflake and Azure SQL data sources.
See [Create a Snowflake Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/71c5e12087f44c2089985f1ee05a9437.html), [Data Type Limitations with Amazon Athena, Google BigQuery, and Snowflake](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/363ec4409d704ad5b7e61f61da86b57c.html), [Create an Azure SQL Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/15566ef65ad643f7a80ad770d8d003d0.html).
595248496.title: Create remote sources

595248497.text:
When you create a virtual table for a SQL on Files remote source, you do not need to be able to physically access the remote file during virtual table creation. SAP HANA now validates column and data type compatibility when you access the virtual table by a query.
See [SAP HANA Native SQL on Files: Overview](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/sap-hana-native-sql-on-files-overview).
595248497.title: Create virtual table without remote access

595248498.text:
You can now create a remote source to an SAP HANA Cloud, data lake Relational Engine server.
See, [Create an SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Relational Engine Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-sap-hana-cloud-data-lake-relational-engine-remote-source).
595248498.title: Direct access to SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Relational Engine

595248499.text:
You can now create SQL on Files remote sources to Databricks Delta tables using the deltasharing adapter. Delta sharing allows you to securely access Delta tables without requiring file-level access.
See [Create a Databricks Delta Sharing Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/create-databricks-delta-sharing-remote-source).
595248499.title: Access to Delta tables through delta sharing

595248500.text:
In addition to data lake Files containers, you can now create remote sources to external object storage providers. SQL on Files remote sources are read only and let you access files with the following file formats: CSV, Parquet, and Delta tables.
See [SAP HANA Native SQL on Files: Overview](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/sap-hana-native-sql-on-files-overview).
595248500.title: Direct file access to external object storage providers

595248501.text:
You can now propagate the local session user to a remote SAP HANA database for authentication purposes. This can be particularly helpful if a #OO user is the current user based on the definer mode of the object being executed. The session user option is supported for SAP HANA database remote sources based on the hanaodbc adapter and is available for the secondary credentials mode and JWT single sign-on (SSO).
See [Using a Session User with JWT SSO or Secondary Credentials](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/using-session-user-with-jwt-sso-or-secondary-credentials).
595248501.title: Session user with JWT SSO and secondary credentials

595248502.text:
For virtual parameterized objects based on the hanaodbc adapter, you can now retrieve the default values defined for the input parameters of remote parameterized objects (SQL views, calculation views, and table user-defined functions) from the DEFAULT_VALUE column in the VIRTUAL_TABLE_PARAMETERS and VIRTUAL_FUNCTION_PARAMETERS system views.
In both the VIRTUAL_TABLE_PARAMETERS and VIRTUAL_FUNCTION_PARAMETERS system views, the HAS_DEFAULT_VALUE column now correctly indicates whether default values are defined.
See:
- [Virtualizing Parameterized Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/virtualizing-parameterized-sql-views)
- [System Views for Monitoring Virtual Table User-Defined Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/system-views-for-monitoring-virtual-table-user-defined-functions)
595248502.title: Virtual parameterized views and user-defined functions

595248503.text:
Remote table replication is now also supported for source tables that are already used in SAP HANA smart data integration replication. The previous restriction that source tables could not be used for both purposes has been removed.
See [Unsupported Data Types and Other Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/unsupported-data-types-and-other-limitations).
595248503.title: Remote table replication (<samp class="ph codeph">hanaodbc</samp> adapter)

595248504.text:
The ODBC driver for ABAP now runs on the index server by default instead of on the script server.
See:
- [Create an ABAP Cloud Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-abap-cloud-remote-source)
- [Create an ABAP On-Premise Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-abap-on-premise-remote-source)
595248504.title: ABAP remote sources

595248505.text:
For SAP HANA remote sources (hanaodbc adapter) and ABAP remote sources (abapodbc adapter), the JSON Web token (JWT) exchange flow with the SAP Identity Authentication Service is now supported for principal propagation. The business user identity that is propagated as a session credential is exchanged for a JWT that allows the remote system to process the query within the context of the business user.
See [Personalizing Connections to Remote SAP HANA Databases and Remote ABAP Systems by Exchanging JSON Web Tokens](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/personalizing-connections-to-remote-sap-hana-databases-and-remote-abap-systems-by-exchanging-json-web-tokens).
595248505.title: Propagation of the business user context

595248506.text:
X.509 certificate-based authentication is now supported for connections to remote ABAP cloud systems.
See:
- [Managing Mutual Authentication with X.509 Certificates](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/managing-mutual-authentication-with-x-509-certificates)
- [Create an ABAP Cloud Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-abap-cloud-remote-source)
595248506.title: Mutual authentication with X.509 certificates for ABAP cloud remote sources

595248507.text:
Associations in source tables are now ignored in replica tables and no longer cause errors, provided the prerequisites are met.
See [Unsupported Data Types and Other Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/unsupported-data-types-and-other-limitations).
595248507.title: Remote table replication (<samp class="ph codeph">hanaodbc</samp> adapter)

595248508.text:
You can now create remote sources to data lake Files containers. An SQL on Files remote source is read only and lets you access files with the following file formats: CSV, Parquet, and Delta tables.
See [SAP HANA Native SQL on Files: Overview](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-on-files-guide/sap-hana-native-sql-on-files-overview).
595248508.title: Direct file access to data lake Files

595248509.text:
You can now perform an initial load separately in multiple steps before activating replication. This is recommended when a source table is extremely large and is otherwise likely to cause a timeout or out-of-memory situation.
See [Perform an Initial Load (Smart Data Access HANA Adapter)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/perform-initial-load-smart-data-access-hana-adapter).
595248509.title: Initial load for remote table replication (<samp class="ph codeph">hanaodbc</samp> adapter)

595248510.text:
Regional endpoints can now be configured for Google BigQuery remote sources (bigqueryrest adapter). Regional endpoints support regional isolation by ensuring that users can access only the data that resides in the specified region in the regional endpoint.
See [Create a Google BigQuery Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-google-bigquery-remote-source).
595248510.title: Regional endpoints for Google BigQuery remote sources

595248511.text:
When inbound SAP passports are received, the corresponding outbound SAP passports can now be generated for requests to a remote database. Outbound passports are currently only supported for SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database remote sources and SAP HANA on-premise remote sources, based on the smart data integration HanaAdapter adapter or smart data access hanaodbc adapter.
See [SAP Passport for Remote Systems](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/sap-passport-for-remote-systems).
595248511.title: SAP passport for remote databases

595248512.text:
You can now use a user-based OAuth authentication method based on a session credential. Application users can set a session credential specifically for their own user session, which allows them to authenticate to the Google Authorization Server with their own credentials.
See:
- [Managing User-Based OAuth Authentication for Google BigQuery Remote Sources](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/managing-user-based-oauth-authentication-for-google-bigquery-remote-sources)
- [Create a Google BigQuery Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-google-bigquery-remote-source)
595248512.title: User-based OAuth authentication for Google BigQuery remote sources

595248513.text:
X.509 certificate-based authentication is now supported for connections to remote SAP HANA Cloud, data lake Relational Engine instances. For X.509 authentication, remote sources are created with the credential type 'X509'.
See:
- [Managing Mutual Authentication with X.509 Certificates](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/managing-mutual-authentication-with-x-509-certificates)
- [Create an SAP HANA Cloud, Data Lake Relational Engine Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-sap-hana-cloud-data-lake-relational-engine-remote-source)
595248513.title: Mutual authentication with X.509 certificates for SAP HANA Cloud, data lake Relational Engine instances

595248514.text:
You can now create a remote source to the ABAP SQL service of an ABAP cloud system or on-premise ABAP system, using the SAP HANA smart data access abapodbc adapter. An ABAP cloud or on-premise remote source is read only and lets you access ABAP CDS view entities and parameterized ABAP CDS view entities in the remote ABAP system.
Along with the support for ABAP remote sources, you can now create virtual parameterized views that point to remote parameterized ABAP CDS view entities in a remote ABAP system.
See:
- [Create an ABAP Cloud Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-abap-cloud-remote-source)
- [Create an ABAP On-Premise Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/create-abap-on-premise-remote-source)
- [Virtualizing Parameterized Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/virtualizing-parameterized-sql-views)
595248514.title: ABAP cloud and ABAP on-premise remote sources

595248515.text:
When replicating tables from a remote SAP HANA on-premise system, asynchronous (ASYNC) full-text indexes, fuzzy search indexes, and geocode indexes on source tables are now ignored. These index types previously caused errors in hybrid scenarios.
See [Unsupported Data Types and Other Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/unsupported-data-types-and-other-limitations).
595248515.title: Remote table replication (<samp class="ph codeph">hanaodbc</samp> adapter)

595248516.text:
When using the toggling feature, instead of adding an automatically generated replica table to a virtual table, you now have the option of adding a normal column-store table created in a user schema. User-owned replica tables give you more control over the definition of the replica table.
See [Replica Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-data-access-guide/replica-tables).
595248516.title: Add replica tables to virtual tables

595248517.text:
For SAP HANA remote sources based on the hanaodbc adapter, you can now use a schema alias specified in the configuration of the remote source for remote table replication as well. The schema alias option was previously only supported for federation scenarios. A schema alias lets you dynamically switch the schema of the remote objects referenced in virtual tables when they are accessed.
See [Apply a Schema Alias (Replication)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/51496f69581348649df6257e952588f9.html).
595248517.title: Schema alias

595248518.text:
Partition replication is now supported for remote sources based on the hanaodbc adapter. This means that you can replicate a selected subset of partitions from a source table in a remote SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database or SAP HANA on-premise system (SAP HANA 2.0 SPS 06 or higher) to a replica table in the SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database. For very large tables with multiple partitions, this can help to reduce the initial load.
See [Replicate Partitions of a Table (Smart Data Access HANA Adapter)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/9620723585b3432e8e6341586388ffa4.html).
595248518.title: Table partition replication

595248519.text:
For loopback scenarios (for example, a data provider and data consumer are in the same SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database instance), you can now create an SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database remote source that points to the local SAP HANA database on your SAP HANA Cloud instance.
See [Create an SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA Database Remote Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/275839492fef49318d92d0e31656ea0a.html).
595248519.title: SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA database remote source

595248520.text:
Information about when a replica table was last updated is now available in the M_VIRTUAL_TABLE_REPLICAS monitoring view for all replica tables, including hidden replica tables. For hidden replica tables (that is, replica tables automatically generated into an internal schema by the toggle feature), this information was previously not available at all. The M_VIRTUAL_TABLE_REPLICAS monitoring view displays the last update time in the form of a timestamp in the column LAST_SYNC_TIME.
See:
- [Monitoring the Use of Virtual Tables and Replicas](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/a4474c3889854d768e478992130a6de1.html)
- [System Views for Monitoring Remote Table Replication](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/3b3b8a064f124cacb73afcdf0a4dbc27.html)
595248520.title: Replica table information

595248521.text:
For SAP HANA remote sources based on the hanaodbc adapter, you can now specify a schema alias in the configuration of the remote source. A schema alias lets you dynamically switch the schema of the remote objects referenced in virtual tables when they are accessed.
See [Apply a Schema Alias (Federation)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/fe58b115ffbe41f4b2304d20b5d16c05.html).
595248521.title: Schema alias

595248522.text:
X.509 certificates issued by a trusted identity provider can now be used to authenticate users connecting to remote SAP HANA on-premise systems and other SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA databases. For X.509 authentication, remote sources are created with the new credential type ‘X509’. The ‘X509’ credential type is only supported for the technical user and must be declared as a global credential type for the remote source.
See [Managing Mutual Authentication with X.509 Certificates](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/477aa413a36c4a95878460696fcc8896/e7eb8b19fa87469296a9272bf5c08118.html).
595248522.title: Mutual authentication with X.509 certificates

595248523.text:
ST_Centroid supports linestring, and multilinestring calculations in round-Earth spatial reference systems.
See [ST_Centroid Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/67d9032288a64e53b91e702cbaa39b5a.html)
595248523.title: Additional data types for ST_Centroid

595248524.text:
The following methods are supported on round-Earth spatial reference systems.
See:
- [ST_AddMeasure Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-addmeasure-method)
- [ST_LineInterpolatePoint Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-lineinterpolatepoint-method)
- [ST_LineSubstring Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-linesubstring-method)
- [ST_LocateAlong Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-locatealong-method)
- [ST_LocateBetween Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-locatebetween-method)
- [List of All Supported Methods](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/list-of-all-supported-methods)
595248524.title: Round-Earth support

595248525.text:
For spherical round-Earth spatial reference systems (SRSs), the distance methods ST_Distance, ST_HausdorffDistance, and ST_WithinDistance are supported for all geometries.
For non-spherical round-Earth spatial reference systems (SRSs), the distance methods ST_Distance, ST_HausdorffDistance, and ST_WithinDistance are supported only for point-to-point calculations.
See:
- [ST_WithinDistance Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-distance-method)
- [ST_HausdorffDistance Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-hausdorffdistance-method)
- [ST_WithinDistance Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-withindistance-method)
- [List of All Supported Methods](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/list-of-all-supported-methods)
595248525.title: Distance calculation for spherical round-Earth SRSs

595248526.text:
An R-tree based search index is supported on round-Earth SRSs.
See:
- [How Spatial Indexes Work](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/how-spatial-indexes-work)
- [Column Definition and Column Configuration](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/column-definition-and-column-configuration)
595248526.title: R-tree based search index on round-Earth SRSs

595248527.text:
Starting with SAP HANA Cloud release QRC 3/2024, the LENGTH function throws an error when it is executed with the spatial data type ST_GEOMETRY as input parameter. Until SAP HANA Cloud release QRC 2/2024, the LENGTH function implicitly converted the spatial data type ST_GEOMETRY to a string type and returned the length of the string.
See:
- [LENGTH Function (String)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/length-function-string)
- [Spatial Data Type Conversions](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/spatial-data-type-conversions)
- [SAP Note 3489570 - Changed Behavior of the LENGTH Function](https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3489570)
595248527.title: LENGTH function is not supported for ST_GEOMETRY data type

595248528.text:
Computes the discrete Hausdorff distance.
See [ST_HausdorffDistance Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-hausdorffdistance-method)
595248528.title: ST_HausdorffDistance Method

595248529.text:
The clustering algorithm K-means is supported on round-Earth spatial reference systems.
See [Introduction to Spatial Clustering](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/introduction-to-spatial-clustering)
595248529.title: K-Means on round-Earth

595248530.text:
The clustering algorithm intersection supports clustering for polygons.
See:
- [Intersection](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/intersection)
- [Introduction to Spatial Clustering](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/introduction-to-spatial-clustering)
- [ST_ClusterID Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-clusterid-method)
- [Window Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/window-functions)
- [GROUP CLUSTER BY](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/group-cluster-by)
595248530.title: Clustering for Polygons

595248531.text:
The M_ST_GEOMETRY_COLUMNS system view can be used to quickly determine the spatial extent for the selected data so that the viewport can be adjusted to the selected data.
See:
- [M_ST_GEOMETRY_COLUMNS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/m-st-geometry-columns-system-view)
- [Spatial Extent with SYS.M_ST_GEOMETRY_COLUMNS](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/spatial-extent-with-sys-m-st-geometry-columns)
595248531.title: System view M_ST_GEOMETRY_COLUMNS

595248532.text:
ST_Centroid is supported on round-Earth spatial reference systems.
See [ST_Centroid Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-centroid-method)
595248532.title: ST_Centroid on round-Earth

595248533.text:
Removes a point from a given linestring or point.
See [ST_RemovePoint Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-removepoint-method)
595248533.title: ST_RemovePoint Method

595248534.text:
Returns the length of the linestring or multilinestring in three-dimensional space.
See [ST_3DLength Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-3dlength-method)
595248534.title: ST_3DLength Method

595248535.text:
Tests if a geometry intersects a rectangle.
See [ST_IntersectsRectPlanar(DOUBLE, DOUBLE, DOUBLE, DOUBLE) Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-spatial-reference/st-intersectsrectplanar-double-double-double-double-method)
595248535.title: ST_IntersectsRectPlanar(<samp class="ph codeph">DOUBLE</samp>, <samp class="ph codeph">DOUBLE</samp>, <samp class="ph codeph">DOUBLE</samp>, DOUBLE) Method

595248536.text:
Creates a linestring from multiple points.
See [ST_MakeLineAggr Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/8069ee3e02c44c4f9736c324c011c0a1.html)
595248536.title: ST_MakeLineAggr Method

595248537.text:
Returns a string representing a set of rows in the GeoJSON format.
See [ST_AsGeoJSON Method (Multi-Column)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/899dca06ad9e485cb97056f7be7e1ce9.html)
595248537.title: ST_AsGeoJSON Method (Multi-Column)

595248538.text:
Returns a string representing a set of rows in the EsriJSON format.
See [ST_AsEsriJSON Method (Multi-Column)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/56d5060a2c2a46408b480b2ba5fbd9d9.html)
595248538.title: ST_AsEsriJSON Method (Multi-Column)

595248539.text:
Computes the discrete Fréchet distance between two linestrings.
See [ST_FrechetDistance Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/6c167ac36432419fa0731ed31100b8ed.html)
595248539.title: ST_FrechetDistance Method

595248540.text:
Makes a given geometry valid.
See [ST_MakeValid Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/207f2c2aca5b46c1b064f22b7c3c87a8.html)
595248540.title: ST_MakeValid Method

595248541.text:
Starting with the SAP HANA Cloud release QRC 2/2023, the functions FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, and NTH_VALUE return spatial types (ST_GEOMETRY, ST_POINT) when they are executed with spatial types (ST_GEOMETRY, ST_POINT) as input parameters.
Until the SAP HANA Cloud release QRC 1/2023, the functions FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, and NTH_VALUE returned data type NVARCHAR when they were executed with spatial types (ST_GEOMETRY, ST_POINT) as input parameters.
To keep the former behavior, use the CAST function (for example CAST(SHAPE AS NVARCHAR)).
See:

595248542.text:
The ownership of spatial reference systems and spatial units of measure will be transferred from the user that created the objects to the database internal user SYS. All newly created spatial reference systems and units of measure will also be owned by the internal database user SYS.
As a consequence, it will be possible to drop users that created referenced spatial reference systems and units of measure because they will no longer be the owners of those objects.
See:
- [CREATE SPATIAL REFERENCE SYSTEM <srs-name> Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/604a9d60efd74d6892754b2b951e6e8d.html)

- [CREATE PREDEFINED SPATIAL REFERENCE SYSTEMS Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/bc9e455fe75541b8a248b4c09b086cf5/b115a75df4e342c1b7f960eba56f5be3.html)

- [SAP Note 3331152 - Change of SRS and UOM Ownership](https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/3331152)

Returns the geometry with the direction of all curves reversed.

Grid generators create tables with geometries. The created geometries cover given geometries.

595248575.text: Behavioral change of privileges required for CREATE OR REPLACE { TRIGGER | VIEW | SYNONYM } statements. Executing CREATE OR REPLACE { TRIGGER | VIEW | SYNONYM } statement requires a different set of specific object privileges on the schema where {TRIGGER | VIEW | SYNONYM} is created or replaced. See [3326021](https://me.sap.com/notes/3326021) for details.

595248576.text:
Applying the ORDER BY clause on an LOB column in an aggregation function (for example, STRING_AGG, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, NTH_VALUE) as part of a SQL statement, generates an error message similar to the following:
SAP DBTech JDBC: [264]: invalid datatype: "V" LOB type in ORDER BY clause of aggregation: line 1 col 32 (at pos 31)
This behavior occurs regardless of whether the SQL statement is executed in the HEX engine or legacy engine.
See SAP Note [3580825](https://me.sap.com/notes/3580825/E)for details.
595248576.title: Changed Behavior - ORDER BY clause on LOB column in Aggregation Function

The AutoML algorithm has the following enhancements:

- The AutoML logs is now stored in PAL_CONTENT.AUTOML_LOG.
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/automl-automl).
