595248650.text:
The pipeline algorithm has the following enhancements:
- You can now pass algorithm specific parameters to the predict method of pipeline.
- The AutoExpSm operator is added to replace the SingleExpSm, DoubleExpSm and TripleExpSm operators. The replacement will be made in the preshiped 'default' configuration. But users can still manually add them back if necessary.
- The PolynomialFeatures operator is also supported in the time series scenario now.
See [Pipeline](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/pipeline-pipeline-de96493).
595248650.title: Enhancements to Pipeline

595248651.text:
Fair ML aims at mitigating unfairness of prediction model due to some possible "bias" within data set regarding features such as sex, race, age and so on. It is a framework that can utilize other machine learning models or technologies which makes it quite flexible.
For this release, it only supports HGBT model with binary classification and regression capabilities.
See [Fair ML](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/fair-ml).
595248651.title: New algorithm fair ML

595248652.text:
This function uses neural network to predict binary targets such as click through rates, a fundamental part in recommender systems. Older methods such as ALS and FRM need specific user and item details, and they might not deal well with extra data features. As today's data grows in size and complexity, there are times when we only have unrelated features without any user connection. To work well with this large-scale, complicated data, MLP recommender is designed to boost the prediction performance.
See [MLP Recommender](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/mlp-recommender).
595248652.title: New recommender system function MLPRecommender

595248653.text:
Permutation feature importance is a feature evaluation method that measures the decrease in the model score when we randomly shuffle the feature's values. It reveals how much the model relies on the feature for prediction by breaking the association between the feature and the true outcome.
The following algorithms are supported from this release:
- [ARIMA](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/arima-arima-dbd52a1)
- [Unified Exponential Smoothing](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/unified-exponential-smoothing-unified-exponential-smoothing-0d3683e) (including all sub-functions)
- [Bayesian Structural Time Series](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/bayesian-structural-time-series-bayesian-structural-time-series-b997257)
- [Additive Model Time Series Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/additive-model-time-series-analysis-additive-model-time-series-analysis-7e78d06)
595248653.title: Permutation Feature importance support in time series functions

595248654.text:

- Added voting based algorithm selection logic through the new parameter VOTING_OUTLIER_METHOD.
- Added the massive processing procedure: _SYS_AFL.PAL_MASSIVE_OUTLIER_DETECTION_FOR_TIME_SERIES.
- Added new parameters.
See [Outlier Detection](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/outlier-detection-outlier-detection-17253b4).

595248656.title: Enhancements to AutoML

595248657.text:
Using one-hot encoding on a feature with high cardinality may impact algorithm performance and memory consumption. To address this, two new parameters are introduced for algorithms that support embedded one-hot encoding for categorical features.
- ONEHOT_MIN_FREQUENCY: Defines a minimal frequency for a category. If a category is lower than this parameter, it will be grouped with other low frequency categories.
- ONEHOT_MAX_CATEGORIES: Defines a maximum category number for a feature. If the total categories exceeds this limit, the lowest categories will be grouped.
Affected algorithms include:
- Multi-Class Logistic Regression
- Multilayer Perceptron
- Support Vector Machine
- Multiple Linear Regression
- Spectral Clustering
See [Multi-Class Logistic Regression](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multi-class-logistic-regression-bc5fe09.html), [Multilayer Perceptron](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multilayer-perceptron-ddd236d.html), [Support Vector Machine](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/support-vector-machine-901a10d.html), [Multiple Linear Regression](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/multiple-linear-regression-eedc909.html), and [Spectral Clustering](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/spectral-clustering-d540a57.html).
595248657.title: One-hot encoding enhancement

595248658.text:
The quantile transform algorithm provides an automatic way to transform a numeric input variable with different data distribution, which then can be used as input to a predictive model.
See [Quantile Transform](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/quantile_transform.html).
595248658.title: New algorithm quantile transform

595248659.text:
New objective function Huber Loss is added into HGBT. Also new majorized boosting method is added to enhance several existing objective functions like the pseudo Huber error objective function, making them more robust and efficient.
Relative parameter HUBER_SLOPE is also added to the HGBT function for the Huber/Pseudo Huber objective function.
The Huber loss statistic is similar to the mean absolute error (MAE), which is a type of loss function commonly used in regression problems. The Huber loss is a combination of the mean squared error (MSE) and the MAE, as it behaves like the MSE for small errors and like the MAE for large errors. It is less sensitive to outliers compared to the MSE, making it a popular choice when dealing with data that may contain extreme values or noise.
See [Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/hybrid-gradient-boosting-tree-ca5106c.html).
595248659.title: New objective function and new boosting method support in HGBT

595248660.text:
Originally when the VERBOSE parameter is set for the classification predict method, all relevant classes and confidences for the prediction record are printed into the result table which may cause some performance issues. Now a new parameter VERBOSE_TOP_N is added for the prediction method of the following functions to control the number of output classes.
- Decision trees
- Hybrid gradient boosting tree
- Multi-class logistic regression
- Naïve Bayes
- Random decision trees
- Linear Discriminant Analysis
- Unified classification
- Unified Classification with Pivoted Input Data
See [Verbose TopN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/verbose-topn-unpivot.html) for unified classification and [Verbose TopN](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/verbose-topn-pivoted.html) for unified classification with pivoted input data.
595248660.title: Top N verbose classes in classification methods

595248661.text:
A new time series decomposition method seasonal-trend decomposition using LOESS (STL) is added to seasonality test by the introduction of the new parameter DECOMPOSE_METHOD. SMOOTH_METHOD_NON_SEASONAL decomposition is enriched now with STL_ROBUST and STL_SEASONAL_AVERAGE as parameter values.
By using STL decomposition, the trend component and seasonal component are obtained from multiple steps of LOESS and moving average. The random component can be estimated straightforwardly. If there is 0 or negative value in the time series, STL can only do additive decomposition.
See [Seasonality Test](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/seasonality-test-d990dc7.html).
595248661.title: STL decomposition method for seasonality test

595248662.text:
PAL_LTSF_DECOMPOSE method is added for LTSF in order to decompose the forecasted values into TREND, SEASONAL, and the calculated contribution of every exogenous feature either with or without its reference value. Only XLinear network type is supported for now.
See [Long-Term Series Forecasting](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/long-term-series-forecasting-060735d.html).
595248662.title: Decompose method support in LTSF

595248663.text:
Added some parameters for text mining and TF-IDF, through which customers can have some control over the stopwords function.
ENABLE_STOPWORDS: Specifies whether to enable the stopwords function. The following parameters will only take effect when this parameter is set to true. The default is true.
KEEP_NUMERIC: Determines whether to keep numbers. The default is false.
ALLOWED_LIST: A comma-separated list of words that will be retained by the stopwords logic.
NOTALLOWED_LIST: A comma-separated list of words, which will be recognized and deleted by the stopwords logic.
See [Term Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/term-analysis-0dd1876.html) and [TF-IDF Calculation](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-predictive-analysis-library/tf-idf-calculation-ef2bad0.html).
595248663.title: Enhancements to text mining and TF-IDF

595248664.text:
Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) added three new linear based methods for speed and accuracy purpose. By introducing the new NETWORK_NAME parameter in the _SYS_AFL.PAL_LTSF_TRAIN method, now the following method types are supported:
- 0 (Default) : NLinear, a network utilizing simple linear layers with normalization inside.
- 1: DLinear, a network utilizing simple linear layers with trend and seasonal decomposition inside.
- 2: XLinear, a network based on DLinear, incorporating exogenous data during prediction.
- 3: SCINet, a network employing 1-dimensional convolution layers (Conv1d) and arranging them in a perfect binary tree architecture for interactive learning.
See [Long-Term Series Forecasting](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/060735d9ed4f44f38c7b0b1ae094d98e.html).
595248664.title: Long-term time series forecasting

595248665.text:
Permutation feature importance is a feature evaluation method that measures the decrease in the model score when we randomly shuffles the feature's values. It reveals how much the model relies on the feature for prediction by breaking the association between the feature and the true outcome.
New unified classification will output all feature importance value in the VARIABLE_IMPORTANCE table for all the included algorithms by setting the following parameters:
- PERMUTATION_IMPORTANCE: Whether to calculate permutation importance.
- PERMUTATION_EVALUATION_METRIC: Specifies evaluation metric for model evaluation.
- PERMUTATION_N_REPEATS: Specifies the number of times to permute a feature.
- PERMUTATION_SEED: Specifies the seed for the random number generator.
- PERMUTATION_N_SAMPLES: Specifies the number of samples to draw in each repeat.
See [Permutation Importance](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/ff18019ef40846ffadb0604c9940a1c4.html) for unified classification and [Permutation Importance](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/e36d4e1759c34809b74f6ce4411709bc.html) for unified classification with pivoted input data.
595248665.title: Permutation Feature importance support in unified classification

595248666.text:
PAL has provided prediction interval and confidence interval output in several methods already. You can use this new method to measure the quality of those prediction intervals by considering the following aspects:
- The interval width of significance level;
- A penalty term for observations falling outside the lower or upper bound.
See [Interval Quality](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/cf9e45d8369042dc9dbf51da2d39f7d4.html).
595248666.title: Interval quality measurement method

595248667.text:
Prediction intervals are now available for the HGBT function in Unified Regression. It is calculated by quantile regression. It outputs trained model with the new parameter SIGNIFICANCE_LEVEL in the training method and OBJ_FUNC set to 8. The SIGNIFICANCE_LEVEL parameter in the prediction or scoring procedure is not necessary for using prediction intervals for HGBT.
See [Prediction Intervals and Confidence Intervals](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/f1574492af724203a12c13f5dbc46a0b.html) for unified regression and [Prediction Intervals and Confidence Intervals](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/d854b8c5fbdf46e3bc47c23eabef4197.html) for unified regression with pivoted input data.
595248667.title: Prediction interval supports HGBT in the Unified Regression method

595248668.text:
Outlier detection for time series now supports the new automatic selection of the detection algorithms and also two new algorithms are supported by enhancing and adding the following parameters:
- AUTO: Whether to use the automatic detection method.
- SMOOTH_METHOD:
- 0: Median filter,
- 1: LOESS (New)
- 2: Super smoother
Also it supports detection of intermittent time series by the following method:
- DETECT_INTERMITTENT_TS: Whether to detect intermittent time series. The default value is 0. Only valid when using the automatic detection method.
See [Outlier Detection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/17253b432b324dd1afa0ef3074d4cd38.html).
595248668.title: Outlier detection for time series enhancement

595248669.text:
Now the text Mining, text classification, and standard TF-IDF functions support Portuguese language.
The LANGUAGE parameter has a new value PT for Portuguese.
See [TF-IDF Calculation](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/ef2bad04109d486ca912ace63cbec73b.html) and [Text Mining](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/96687ab4efc74466a7371a11e7ba5bdc.html).
595248669.title: Portuguese language support in text mining

595248670.text:
PAL provides the massive execution interface for isolation forest and forecast accuracy measure.
See [Isolation Forest](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/11345d90db35416e94de653248ac2184.html) and [Forecast Accuracy Measures](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/568723fd2f9e42269b61e993e09ba019.html).
595248670.title: Massive function of isolation forest and forecast accuracy measure

595248671.text:
AutoML now supports explanation on the generated pipeline of classification and regression scenarios. The explanation function uses the Kernel SHAP explainer to explain the predicted value of each record by computing the contribution of each feature to the prediction.
See [Pipeline](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/de964934276b415aa6ae0c71ce72f351.html).
595248671.title: AutoML Explaination

595248672.text:
AutoML now can generate polynomial and interaction features in classification and regression scenarios. The polynomial feature operator can automatically generate a feature table consisting of all polynomial combinations of features with degree between MIN_DEGREE and MAX_DEGREE. Additional inputs are required from users including MIN_DEGREE, MAX_DEGREE, INTERACTION_ONLY, and INCLUDE_BIAS. Because of the potential performance impact, this polynomial feature operator is not included in the lightweight configuration.
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/d1a54bc3a4664937b77e85a865754b17.html) and [Pipeline Operator](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/fd58a3f156a24d80af2791ae60fb27bb.html).
595248672.title: AutoML polynomial feature generation

595248673.text:
You can use the pipeline interface PAL_PIPELINE_EXECUTE to customize the output table columns. The old interface is not impacted.
See [Customizable Output Interface](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/10ac2d0acdda4604bcdfda77808e5996.html).
595248673.title: Customized pipeline support

595248674.text:
ROKCET is an exceptionally efficient algorithm for time series classification. New procedures of PAL_ROCKET_TRAIN, PAL_ROCKET_PREDICT, and PAL_ROCKET_FIT are supported.
See [ROCKET](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/07c9a8cdba6a46039e2a7870896b185e.html).
595248674.title: ROCKET transform for time series classification

595248675.text:
Online Bayesian Change Point Detection (BCPD) is a simple and effective online algorithm for change point detection in time series data.
See [Online Bayesian Change Point Detection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/1398751c21d148e697d1633f67b906ac.html).
595248675.title: Online Bayesian Change Point Detection

595248676.text:
Power Transform is a preprocessing method to transform data by stabilizing variance, reducing skewness and approximating to Gaussian distribution.
See [Power Transform](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/3bc05285c71e4c4bbc304d55d1c46256.html).
595248676.title: Power Transform

595248677.text:
The following two functions in PAL also support precalculated distance matrix input through the unified clustering interface:
- Agglomerate Hierarchical Clustering
- Spectral Cluster
See [Unified Clustering](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/6870a0c219d64263a5ae78db8ef250b6.html) and [Unified Clustering with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/baa7174e919e4303ba4651a19e5f7844.html).
595248677.title: Two more functions support for precalculated distance through unified clustering

595248678.text:
Prediction intervals and confidence intervals now supports Random Decision Tree (RDT) in unified regression.
See [Prediction Intervals and Confidence Intervals](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/f1574492af724203a12c13f5dbc46a0b.html) for unified regression and [Prediction Intervals and Confidence Intervals](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/d854b8c5fbdf46e3bc47c23eabef4197.html) for unified regression with pivoted input data.
595248678.title: Support of RDT in prediction intervals of unified regression

595248679.text:
Random Convolutional Kernel Transform (ROCKET) is an exceptionally efficient algorithm for time series classification. Unlike other proposed time series classification algorithms which attain excellent accuracy, ROCKET maintains its performance with a fraction of the computational expense by transforming input time series using random convolutional kernels. Only a simple classifier is enough to train the transformed features and render the state-of-the-art accuracy.
See [ROCKET](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/07c9a8cdba6a46039e2a7870896b185e.html).
595248679.title: Random Convolutional Kernel Transform

595248680.text:
Prediction/confidence intervals are added to the unified regression function, MLR and GLM is supported in this release.
See
- [Prediction Intervals and Confidence Intervals in Unified Regression](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/f1574492af724203a12c13f5dbc46a0b.html)
- [Prediction Intervals and Confidence Intervals in Unified Regression with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/d854b8c5fbdf46e3bc47c23eabef4197.html)
595248680.title: Prediction/confidence intervals in unified regression

595248681.text:
Unified clustering added a new input format of precalculated distance matrix for K-Medoid. The PRECALCULATED_DISTANCE parameter is also available in the native K-Medoid function with an additional parameter N_CLUSTERS.
See
- [Precomputed Distance Matrix as Input Data in Unified Clustering](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/49f9b467764e4e6a952547b81b766a8b.html)
- [Precomputed Distance Matrix as Input Data in Unified Clustering with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/c627694a0e66457bb1edf4b5d7853ee9.html)
595248681.title: Precalculated/precomputed distances matrix input for K-Medoid

595248682.text:
Stock-keeping-oriented Prediction Error Costs (SPEC), mainly for the sporadic intermittent use cases, was added into Forecast Accuracy Measures.
See [Forecast Accuracy Measures](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/568723fd2f9e42269b61e993e09ba019.html).
595248682.title: Added a new measure to Forecast Accuracy Measures

595248683.text:
- Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree:
- Changed the default value of SPLIT_METHOD to histogram and FEATURE_GROUPING to 1.
- Added a new parameter FG_MIN_ZERO_RATE with a default value of 0.5 as the benchmark to identify whether or not a feature is a sparse feature.
- Random Decision Tree: Changed the default value of MODEL_FORMAT to 1 (JSON).
- Unified classification: Changed the default value of:
- THREAD_RATIO to 1
- JSON_EXPORT to 1 for multi-class logistic regression
- model_format to 1 for RDT
- K-Means and Accelerated K-Means: Changed the default value of USE_FAST_LIBRARY to 1.
- Unified Regression: Changed the default value of JSON_EXPORT to 1.
- Changed the default value of THREAD_RATIO to 1 for the following methods:
- Multiple Linear Regression
- Bi-Variate Geometric Regression
- Exponential Regression
- Polynomial Regression
- Online Linear Regression
- Logistic Regression (with Elastic Net Regularization)
- Multi-Class Logistic Regression
- Online Multi-Class Logistic Regression
- Categorical Principal Component Analysis
- Variance Test
- ABC Analysis
- Changed the default value of THREAD_RATIO to -1 for the following methods:
- Unified classification
- Unified regression
- Unified exponential smoothing
595248683.title: Default parameter value changes

595248684.text:
AutoML now supports the time series forecast configurations with the following major operators:
- ARIMA
- AMTSA
- BSTS
- Exponential smoothing methods
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/d1a54bc3a4664937b77e85a865754b17.html)
595248684.title: Time Series support in AutoML

595248685.text:
This new neural-network based function is designed to solve a critical business application that predicts the values in the long future.
See [Long-Term Series Forecasting](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/060735d9ed4f44f38c7b0b1ae094d98e.html)
595248685.title: Long-Term Series Forecasting method

595248686.text:
Successive halving and hyperband are new fast parameter search mechanisms are now supported for the following functions:
- Multi-class Logistic Regression
- Naive Bayes
- Logistic Regression (with Elastic Net Regularization)
- Multilayer Perception
- Alternating Least Squares
- Factorized Polynomial Regression Models
See [Model Evaluation and Parameter Selection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/aadf7b8fded44f93a426e4c18faaf3eb.html)
595248686.title: New functions supporting successive halving based parameter search

595248687.text:
This function performs power spectral density estimate of the input signal using a periodogram.
See [Periodogram](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/b9253c7c91704664b96461777715e1f3.html)
595248687.title: Periodogram function

595248688.text:
The new early stop mechanism is added to HGBT to allow users to stop training before model gets too complicated to avoid possible overfitting.
See [Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/ca5106cbd88f4ac69e7538bbc6a059ea.html)
595248688.title: Early stop support for HGBT

595248689.text:
The following new outlier detections methods are added to the function.
- isolation forest
- DBSCAN
See [Outlier Detection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/17253b432b324dd1afa0ef3074d4cd38.html)
595248689.title: Time series Outlier Detection enhancement

595248690.text:
Provides massive execution interface for unified clustering method.
See:
- [Unified Massive Clustering](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/5026c5629f324553b1977e673997ec0a.html)
- [Unified Massive Clustering with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/3dcc29bbd319428892e10d33fab7a30e.html)
595248690.title: Unified Massive Clustering

595248691.text:
New parameter NTILES is added to the AUC method which is also available in the unified classification method. It will control the number of output points to accelerate the performance.
See [Area Under Curve (AUC)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/df08788a52744c899fab13a8712d30e8.html)
595248691.title: Area Under Curve (AUC) enhancement

595248692.text:
Successive halving and hyperband are new fast parameter search mechanisms introduced in PAL cross validation and parameter search feature.
It is enabled for the following algorithms:
- Hybrid Gradient Boosting Tree
- K-Nearest Neighbor
- Support Vector Machine
- Multiple Linear Regression
The following new options are added for the parameter RESAMPLING_METHOD:
- cv_sha
- cv_hyperband
- stratified_cv_sha
- stratified_cv_hyperband
- bootstrap_sha
- bootstrap_hyperband
- stratified_bootstrap_sha
- stratified_bootstrap_hyperband
See [Model Evaluation and Parameter Selection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/aadf7b8fded44f93a426e4c18faaf3eb.html)
595248692.title: Successive halving based parameter search

595248693.text:
The function is used to replace the missing values from a given multi-dimentional time series. It provides multiple imputation options for the users:
- 0: NONE
- 1: MODE_ALLZERO
- 2: MODE_MEAN
- 3: MODE_MEDIAN
- 4: MODE_SMA
- 5: MODE_LMA
- 6: MODE_EMA
- 7: MODE_LINTERP
- 8: MODE_SINTERP
- 9: MODE_SEADEC
- 10: MODE_LOCF
- 11: MODE_NOCB
See [Time Series Missing Value Handling](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/368f7552f80a4130b3105b188766a1cf.html)
595248693.title: Time Series Missing Value Handling (new function)

595248694.text:
This function is used to detect the point outliers from the given timeseries.
See [Outlier Detection](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/17253b432b324dd1afa0ef3074d4cd38.html)
595248694.title: Outlier detection for Time Series (new function)

595248695.text:
This function performs one-sample or two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test for goodness of fit.
See [Kolmogorov-Smirnov Test](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/1aab0c69fc2243ef8da0e78eb8938e49.html)
595248695.title: Kolmogorov-Smirnov test (new function)

595248696.text:
- Light weight configuration - A new configuration which only contains quick and less resource consumption algorithms
- 2 new feature selection methods supported:
- 8: Fast Correlation Based Filter (FCBF)
- 10: Spectral Feature Selection (SPEC)
- Performance optimization, and bug fixing
See [AutoML](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/d1a54bc3a4664937b77e85a865754b17.html)
595248696.title: AutoML enhancement

595248697.text:
New accelerated Least Mean square accelerated algorithms are now supported by the following parameters:
- PRECOMPUTE_LMS_SKETCH - By default turned on for LMS sketch algorithm
- STABLE_SKETCH_ALG - Uses numerical stable or not

595248703.text:
The Croston TSB method (for Teunter, Syntetos & Babai) is a forecast strategy for products with intermittent demand. It is a modification of Croston's method. It replaces the demand interval in Croston's method by demand probability which is updated every period. Compared to Croston's method, the forecast of TSB method is not biased and its probability forecast can be used to estimate the risk of obsolescence.
See [Croston TSB Method](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/82038471a3294627a6838f625dcdc2cd.html)

595248704.text:
This function is used to identify whether a time series is stationary by two optional statistical tests: Kwiatkowski-Phillips-Schmidt-Shin (KPSS) test and Augmented Dickey Fuller (ADF) test. Other than the common level-stationarity, this function can also detect the trend-stationarity which denotes the time series fluctuates around a deterministic trend.
See [Stationarity Test](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/1d85b078fd194fa086058d46c502cac2.html)

595248705.text:
Adding the following missing value handling types in the Unified Regression and Unified Classification method, both pivoted and unpivoted functions are supported.
- MODE: Fills all missing values by the mode of the column, that is, the value that appears most often in the column. This type only suits column with categorical variables.
- NONE: Does nothing. Leave the column untouched.
- MEDIAN: Fills all missing values by the median of the column, that is, the value that separates the higher half of the non-missing values from the lower half. If there is an even number of observations, then the median is given by the mean of the two middle values. This type only suits column with numerical variables.MEAN: Fills all missing values by the mean of the column, that is, the average of all non-missing values in the column. This type only suits column with numerical variables.
- ALS: Fills each missing value by the value imputed by a matrix completion model trained using alternating least squares method. This type only suits column with numerical variables.
- SPECIFIED_CATEGORICAL_VALUE: Fills all missing values by a specified categorical value. This type only suits column with categorical variables.
- SPECIFIED_NUMERICAL_VALUE: Fills all missing values by a specified numerical value. This type only suits column with numerical variables.
- DELETE: Deletes all rows with missing values. The entire row in table will be deleted.
- MEAN: Fills all missing values by the mean of the column,NONE: Does nothing. Leave the column untouched.
See:
- [Unified Classification with Pivoted Input Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/319d36de4fd64ac3afbf91b1fb3ce8de/5f37c0a5129d4b5dad92a8b3fbb7fdd3.html)
