See [Bind Applications to Database Services with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/a3865b12c0354c9fa312f88aa4572b7b.html).
595248742.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248743.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to use the SAP HANA Project Explorer's artifact-creation Wizard to create an enterprise-search configuration object (.hdbeshconfig).
See [Enterprise Search Configurations (.hdbeshconfig)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/eb019bb757404a0591182ac7acf05400.html).
595248743.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248744.text:
HDI developers can now use the new build plug-in .hdbremotetablereplica to support the generation of the new database artifact type "remote-table-replication" in database applications.
See [SAP HDI Artifact Types and Build Plug-ins Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/9789224788a34d93a86080cab993575c.html).
595248744.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248745.text:
Optimize join columns are now supported for non-equi-joins.
See [Optimize Join Execution](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/6100bb67b2e445329605a3b4650f6e46.html)
595248745.title: Calculation Views

595248746.text:
You can now add objects to calculation views based on associations, and also add objects with join information.
See [Add Objects Based on Association](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/c81cdcbe844745ee9a067fc546723503.html)
595248746.title: Calculation Views

595248747.text:
You can now specify start and end times for application-time-period tables.
See [Add System Time and Application Time](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/7421507f46ef4e64b060b013076d1b8c.html)
595248747.title: Calculation Views

595248748.text:
User-defined functions are now permitted in non-equi-join expressions, data masking expressions, and restricted columns.
See [User-Defined Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/150a8dec9cc64aad96bafb452df29a7b.html)
595248748.title: Calculation Views

595248749.text:
You can now open SQL Editor from the context menu of calculation view nodes.
See [Preview Calculation View Output](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/903eff885ebd4c5cadb1e0c3e58f681d.html)
595248749.title: Calculation Views

595248750.text:
You can now choose which display option is started by Data Preview:
- Analysis (default)
- Raw Data
See [Configuring Data Preview Behavior](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/92883c2b13c74649b183590c4b5744ae.html)
595248750.title: Calculation Views

595248751.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to use the SAP HANA Project Explorer to bind an application to a database schema service.
See [Bind an Application to a Database Schema Service](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4f5add96a6a04d9f81dbaed135bf84ab.html).
595248751.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248752.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to use the SAP HANA Project Explorer to bind an application to a service managed by the Service Manager.
See [Bind an Application to a Service Managed by the Service Manager](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/818a87c6299a43488f80f92fa8453d4b.html).
595248752.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248753.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to use the SAP HANA artifact-creation Wizard to add a job-schedule artifact (.hdbschedulerjob) to your database application.
See [Scheduler Jobs (.hdbschedulerjob)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/f92e31d2a23f4470829ab300dcce850e.html).
595248753.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248754.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to use the embedded SAP HANA Database Explorer to create CALL statements.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248754.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248755.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to filter the list of databases displayed in the embedded SAP HANA Database Explorer.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248755.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248756.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to filter by name the list of objects displayed in the CATALOG pane of the embedded SAP HANA Database Explorer.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248756.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248757.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA Project Explorer now displays a warning if an application is using an outdated version of the HDI deployer (@sap/hdi-deploy).
See [Deploy Artifacts with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248757.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248758.text:
HDI now provides support for the alteration of table partitions in the HDI mgiration-table artifact.
See [Migration Tables (.hdbmigrationtable)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/52d1f5acfa754a7887e21226641eb261.html).
595248758.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248759.text:
HDI now provides support for the UPDATE statement with migration tables (.hdbmigrationtable).
See [Migration Tables (.hdbmigrationtable)](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_HANA_PLATFORM/3823b0f33420468ba5f1cf7f59bd6bd9/52d1f5acfa754a7887e21226641eb261.html).
595248759.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248760.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to use the Database Explorer's SQL console as a custom editor.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248760.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248761.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the Project Explorer provides support for SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) projects and access to tools that help you to maintain native SAP HANA database artifacts.
See [Working with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/166f4fbbcbc64df3bd74220fd75c5b1e.html).
595248761.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248762.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to display syntax suggestions and dependency information in a side panel in the Database Explorer's SQL console.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248762.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248763.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA Project Explorer now allows you to include trace information in the deployment log displayed in the terminal pane.
See [User Preferences for SAP HANA Native Application Development Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/57e2fe608bb042d48b799d41a8d121a7.html).
595248763.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248764.text: Improved Data Preview: The tabular format can now be displayed, even if no value axis is assigned.
595248764.title: Calculation Views

595248765.text:
You can now generate fiscal time data using SQL statements only.
See [Generating FISCAL_CALENDAR Data Using SQL](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/c4571d02faa14dcd9ccec8c6f3ce0a46.html)
595248765.title: Calculation Views

595248766.text:
You can now choose between different directions for filter mapping.
See [Map Filters Between Join Partners](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/997ec7b767794160a373894ee96a365f.html)
595248766.title: Calculation Views

595248767.text:
You can now change the position of output columns in the mapping pane.
See [Changing the Sequence of Elements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/ffe1a32156414237901d6ada03beb0ef.html)
595248767.title: Calculation Views

595248768.text:
You can now change the sequence of the data sources in nodes that support multiple data sources.
See [Changing the Sequence of Data Sources in Nodes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/fe537212b56447ee9dacdbb5527fa0dd.html)
595248768.title: Calculation Views

595248769.text:
During modeling, you can specify which attributes you expect to be used in the GROUP-BY when reporting on a certain measure.
See [Define Expected Aggregation Granularity](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/75d591f3bb6d4b01a2ac988cf5e2c01d.html)
595248769.title: Calculation Views

595248770.text:
You can now create your own functions to use in SQL expressions.
See [User-Defined Functions](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/150a8dec9cc64aad96bafb452df29a7b.html)
595248770.title: Calculation Views

595248771.text:
HDI now provides support for SCHEMA_NAME when specifying column mappings in table-data property definitions (.properties).
See BIMC_DESCRIPTIONS in [Table Data Properties (.properties)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/f4da2181909f48a6a36904b7f5599780.html).
595248771.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248772.text:
It is now possible to migrate an hdbtable artifact by comparing source and target tables and automatically generating the ALTER statements required to transform the existing table to the new table definition.
See try_fast_table_migration in [Build Plug-in Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/e2d3e543067e4f3282bf6dbf880c6b2d.html#build-plug-in-parameters) and [Tables (.hdbtable and hdbdropcreatetable)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/453d48e28f6747799546236b4b432e58.html#fast-migration).
595248772.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248773.text:
HDI now provides support for fuzzy-search indexes in the index plug-in (.hdbindex).
See FUZZY SEARCH INDEX in [Indexes (.hdbindex)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/58fdf2d2ffae44b6a3dd0e9a3f5ae8c5.html).
595248773.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248774.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the SQL console now provides AI-assisted tools that annotate and explain SQL code.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248774.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248775.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the artifact-creation Wizard now supports the following new types of database artifact:
- Fabric Virtual Tables (.hdbfabricvirtualtable)
- Structured Filters (.hdbstructuredfilter)
- Document Store Collection Adjacency Indexes (.hdbcollectionadjindex)
See [SAP HDI Artifact Types and Build Plug-ins Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-deployment-infrastructure-hdi-reference/sap-hdi-artifact-types-and-build-plug-ins-reference).
595248775.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248776.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the Database Explorer to add a new connection to an SAP HANA database.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248776.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248777.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the Database Explorer now provides separate filters for schemas and objects.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248777.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248778.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application dev space for SAP Business Application Studio, the Database Explorer provides a new user setting that enables you to specify how to sort the entries in the database list, for example, in ascending or descending order.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248778.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248779.text:
The Structured Filters plug-in (.hdbstructuredfilter) now supports the use of wildcards, for example, when restricting the scope of a calculation view.
See [Structured Filters (.hdbstructuredfilter)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/6671c48d5f314417807aac11e6ae26cf.html).
595248779.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248780.text:
The Analytic Privileges plug-in (.hdbanalyticprivilege) now supports the use of wildcards, for example, when restricting the scope of a calculation view.
See [Analytic Privileges (.hdbanalyticprivilege)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/2d3056363053436898fcf5a3141b482f.html).
595248780.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248781.text:
SAP HDI plug-ins hdbtable and hdbmigrationtable now enable you to take over an exisiting hdbtable artifact that is not managed by HDI.
See [Migration Tables (.hdbmigrationtable)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/52d1f5acfa754a7887e21226641eb261.html) and [Tables (.hdbtable and .hdbdropcreatetable)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/453d48e28f6747799546236b4b432e58.html).
595248781.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248782.text:
The calculation view editor now lets you undo and redo operations on calculation views.
See [Undo and Redo Modeling Operations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/74d4fa8d18724f3e9ffb09b82c7553b5.html)
595248782.title: Undo and Redo Modeling Operations

595248783.text:
The following new options are available for snapshots in a calculation view:
- Create Snapshot After Deployment Automatically
- Keep Snapshot During Redeployment
- Mode of Generated Procedure
See [Create Snapshots](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/d35f768ce50145d2ad0e5916898f004d.html)
595248783.title: Additional Options for Snapshots

595248784.text:
You can now apply filters to both partners of a join. Filters that are applied to one join partner can also be applied to mapped columns of the other join partner.
Filter Mapping can be defined in each join node.
See [Map Filters Between Join Partners](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/997ec7b767794160a373894ee96a365f.html)
595248784.title: Filter Mapping

595248785.text:
SAP HDI now supports the deployment of Scheduler Jobs (.hdbschedulerjob) artifacts to SAP HANA.
See [Scheduler Jobs (.hdbschedulerjob)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/f92e31d2a23f4470829ab300dcce850e.html) .
595248785.title: SAP HDI Plug-ins and Artifacts

595248786.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA projects explorer now provides direct access to online help for the specific database artifact type that you are creating.
See [Add Database Artifacts to your SAP HANA Cloud Database Application](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/1aa916563bea48c8a880efba306fb7f9.html).
595248786.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248787.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the SAP HANA Project Explorer to recover design-time artifacts by binding to a user-provided service.
See [Restore Design-time Artifacts from the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/e735ec2bac4541339e9301e8cae7ca0b.html).
595248787.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248788.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA Project Explorer now supports the multitarget resource type org.cloudfoundry.managed-service.
See [Configure an SAP CAP Application to Work with Native SAP HANA Artifacts](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/ef0377f5e9d84ce3aeb43a7e4baa5fe4.htm).
595248788.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248789.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA Project Explorer now enables you to set (in user preferences) the automatic configuration of the "development mode" feature when deploying migration tables.
See [User Preferences for SAP HANA Native Application Development Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/57e2fe608bb042d48b799d41a8d121a7.html#loio57e2fe608bb042d48b799d41a8d121a7__section_n2h_q44_nsb) and [Migration Tables (SAP HANA Cloud HDI Reference)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/52d1f5acfa754a7887e21226641eb261.html).
595248789.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248790.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the standard artifact-creation Wizard for database objects to add a virtual table to your database application.
See [Create Virtual Tables](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/00340d4ede0a43ceb0a67f36bbc46a3a.html).
595248790.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248791.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to use the Database Explorer's SQL console to select local or SAP HANA database connections.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248791.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248792.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the Database Explorer's SQL console now provides new context menu items that enable you to open SQL files and display the contents directly in the SQL console itself.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248792.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248793.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, new context-menu items in the Database Explorer enable you to generate a SELECT or CALL statement for supported database artifacts.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248793.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248794.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to view the data of supported artifacts in the Database Explorer's SQL console.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html) and [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248794.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248795.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the Project Explorer now enables you to bind a database module to a user-provided service.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248795.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248796.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the Project Explorer now displays a warning if services bound to a database modules do not match the current Cloud Foundry space. Users can choose to automatically unbind these services by setting a user preference.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html) and [User Preferences for SAP HANA Native Application Development Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/57e2fe608bb042d48b799d41a8d121a7.html).
595248796.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248797.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the Project Explorer now displays a warning if services bound to a database modules do not match the database ID defined in the mta.yaml file.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248797.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248798.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the Project Explorer to recover design-time artifacts in your workspace from the deployed artifacts in an HDI container.
See [Restore Design-time Artifacts from the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/e735ec2bac4541339e9301e8cae7ca0b.html).
595248798.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248799.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the Project Explorer to synchronize the deployment state of a database module with the deployment state from the database.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248799.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248800.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio,you can now use the Project Explorer to create a procedure grantor when adding a new database connection.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248800.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248801.text:
You can now create snapshots based on a specific query in a calculation view.
[Create Query Snapshots](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/d35f768ce50145d2ad0e5916898f004d.html)
595248801.title: Query Snapshots

595248802.text:
A new aggregation option MEDIAN is available for:
- Measures in a calculation view with aggregation or star join
- Calculated columns with measure type, if client side aggregation is enabled
- Mapping for a node, if the column is a measure
[Supported View Nodes for Modeling Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/346dcfd19b3e4fe3a95ac1a1609c9c40.html)
595248802.title: New Aggregation Function

595248803.text:
You can now map session variables to input parameters.
Up to now, it was only possible to map parameters and variables to input parameters.
For more information about mapping input parameters, see [Map Input Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/c5a5e12a5cc84196991d40ef0dd2003f.html)
595248803.title: Map Session Variables

595248804.text:
You can now quickly find out where elements in a calculation view, such as calculated columns, input parameters, restricted columns, or variables, are used.
[Where Used Functionality](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/d79577f0cda74f4faa1ba5a8b0a6ba45.html)
595248804.title: Where Used for Objects in a Calculation View

595248805.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to export a package that includes selected objects from an SAP HANA HDI container, for example, if required for testing by support teams.
See [Export an SAP HDI Container for Support Purposes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e4c3403b64d40f093a8a2cb78f9944b.html).
595248805.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248806.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to create a default "hdbgrants" file for the automatic assignment of privileges when adding a new database connection in the SAP HANA Projects explorer.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248806.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248807.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now set the user preference "auto-commit" in the SAP HANA SQL Console to ensure that any changes to the database required by the code you run in the SQL Console are performed immediately, for example, when inserting or updating data in tables.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248807.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248808.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA SQL Console now allows you to run SQL queries that include parameters.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248808.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248809.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA Projects explorer now checks the details of the target schema details when binding to an existing service.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248809.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248810.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, it is now possible to switch between database connections in the SAP HANA SQL Console.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248810.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248811.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, you can use context-sensitive menus in the SAP HANA Database Explorer's Catalog Browser to copy the simple or fully qualified name of a database object to the clipboard.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248811.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248812.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, you can use the SAP HANA Database explorer's Catalog Browser to generate the SQL code that was used to create the selected database object.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248812.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248813.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA Projects explorer now enables you to bind a user-provided service to a target HDI container.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248813.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248814.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA Projects explorer now enables you to bind to (or unbind from) all services displayed in the Database Connections pane.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html) and [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248814.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248815.text:
When replacing a node of a calculation view, it is now also possible to map input parameters.
See [Replacing Nodes and Data Sources](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/a83035bf66b84bf682a3f954580e8220.html)
595248815.title: Parameter Mapping and Replacing Data Sources

595248816.text:
In the Find Data Source dialog, you can now select/unselect ‘Show Services’ to show/hide the Service column in the result table, which contains the service information of each object in the table.
See [Create Calculation Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/5aeb56cba39e4df4ae62b43a0dc2fad4.html)
595248816.title: Usability

595248817.text:
The data preview allows the preview of hierarchies on SAP HANA Cloud.
See [Preview Calculation View Output](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/903eff885ebd4c5cadb1e0c3e58f681d.html)
595248817.title: Preview of Hierarchies

595248818.text:
A new configuration option was added to explicitly configure whether a data preview query should be automatically executed.
See [Preview Calculation View Output](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/903eff885ebd4c5cadb1e0c3e58f681d.html)
595248818.title: Preview Calculation View Output

595248819.text:
Input parameters of a calculation view can now be mapped to the input parameters of a consumed calculation view if this calculation view is consumed via SDA.
See [Map Input Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/c5a5e12a5cc84196991d40ef0dd2003f.html)
595248819.title: Mapping Input Parameters

595248820.text:
In addition to constant mapping and the use of pruning configuration table, column-based pruning is now also supported.
Column-based pruning allows you to prune individual data sources of a union node, based on whether a data source contributes certain columns
See [Create Column-Based Pruning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/d625b46ef0b445abb2c2fd9ba008c265/04b541d4b9364e00b33575bbc390de66.html)
595248820.title: Union Node Pruning

595248821.text:
The SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio now provides access to SAP HANA database development tools from an SAP CAP project.
See [Configure an SAP CAP Application to Work with Native SAP HANA Artifacts](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/ef0377f5e9d84ce3aeb43a7e4baa5fe4.html).
595248821.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248822.text:
During the creation of a new application project, the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio now checks if the project's .gitignore file contains an entry for the SAP HANA native database application .env file.
See [Create a New Business Application Project](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/f42acff48e164acbb01b1ee969b1282b.html).
595248822.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248823.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the list of SAP HANA Database Explorer connections can be hidden using the Show Database Explorer Connections setting in User Preferences.
See [User Preferences for SAP HANA Native Application Development Tools](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/57e2fe608bb042d48b799d41a8d121a7.html).
595248823.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248824.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, local database connections can now be added using credentials stored in the SAP HANA User Store.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248824.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248825.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the SQL console can open content from (and save content to) files.
See [Use the SQL Console for SAP HANA to Query the Database](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/7ffe3cc490f04ca997e22326e013e73f.html).
595248825.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248826.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the SAP HANA Database Explorer on SAP Business Technology Platform can now be opened from each SAP HANA Database Explorer connection.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248826.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248827.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the catalog browser now shows the list of database objects. The objects can be filtered by schema. The (filtered) list of objects can be also be searched using the standard Visual Studio Code functionality for the tree view.
See [View Database Objects with the Database Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/0e5ac0b0625b411c8f05346566a3341f.html).
595248827.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248828.text:
The SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio now provides context-sensitive descriptions of tags and properties in JSON-based HDI artifacts, for example: hdbrole and hdbroleconfig, hdbgrants, hdbsynonym and hdbsynonymconfig. For common scenarios, templates are provided, too.
See [Create a Database Role (Getting Started)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/492729c3918c4cb7a645f69a6bdfbc56.html).
595248828.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248829.text:
The SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio now provides JSON syntax validation for the HDI artifacts hdbtabledata and hdblogicalschemaconfig.
See [SAP HDI Artifact Types and Build Plug-ins Reference (SAP HANA Cloud Database)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/9789224788a34d93a86080cab993575c.html).
595248829.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248830.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now use the project explorer to bind a module to the default service. A new option also enables you to bind (and unbind) all the services specified in an application's mta.yaml file. When binding a module to an existing service, a new warning is shown.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248830.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248831.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the project explorer now provides a setting for clearing the deployment log when a new deployment is started.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248831.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248832.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, you can now validate connection details when adding a new database connection to a project.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248832.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248833.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, a confirmation dialog is now displayed asking if auto-undeploy should be disabled when binding an application to an existing container.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248833.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248834.text:
In the SAP HANA Native Application extension for SAP Business Application Studio, the project explorer now shows HDI configuration files in the application project's file tree.
See [Deploy Artifacts and Set up Database Connections with SAP HANA Projects Explorer](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2b99f19e9264c4d9ae9221b22f6f589/4bbbaae1d8694005adcfe1ec06a5cd46.html).
595248834.title: SAP HANA Native Applications

595248835.text:
New versions of the SAP HDI clients are available for download from the NPM and Maven Central public repositories:
- sap-hdi 4.2.0 (npmjs.com)
- sap-java-hdi 2.2.0 (Maven)
- @sap/hdi-deploy 4.3.0 (npmjs.com)
- @sap/hdi-dynamic-deploy 2.3.3 (npmjs.com)
See the [Node.js NPM](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sap/hdi) or [Maven](https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.sap.hana.di/hdi) repository, respectively.
595248835.title: SAP HDI Clients

595248836.text: The IS_DYNAMIC column was added to support dynamic partitions. [TABLE_PARTITIONS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/c81d9beea383495c99ad48789b983708.html)
595248836.title: TABLE_PARTITIONS system view

595248837.text: The DYNAMIC_RANGE_INTERVAL column was added to support dynamic partitions. [TABLE_PARTITIONS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/c81d9beea383495c99ad48789b983708.html)
595248837.title: TABLE_PARTITIONS system view

595248838.text: Starting and stopping the kernel profiler now supports a rolling strategy. [ALTER SYSTEM {START | STOP | SAVE | CLEAR} KERNEL PROFILER Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/864e9b9851bb467e9c0c4c1f285bef12.html)
595248838.title: ALTER SYSTEM {START | STOP | <samp class="ph codeph">SAVE</samp> | <samp class="ph codeph">CLEAR</samp>} KERNEL PROFILER statement

595248839.text: The columns REPLICA_LOAD_UNIT and COMPUTE_REPLICA_LOAD_UNIT were added to this view. [TABLE_PLACEMENT System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/522cc8ecebbe4508b572d0f61cec8e28.html)
595248839.title: TABLE_PLACEMENT system view

595248840.text: The clauses REPLICA_LOAD_UNIT and COMPUTE_REPLICA_LOAD_UNIT were added to the statement. [ALTER SYSTEM ALTER TABLE PLACEMENT Statement](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/0715b97c91cd4c87982040cdd341d676.html)
595248840.title: ALTER SYSTEM ALTER TABLE PLACEMENT statement

595248841.text: Several new columns for REPLICA_ and COMPUTE_REPLICA_have been added to these views. [TABLE_PLACEMENT System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/522cc8ecebbe4508b572d0f61cec8e28.html), [M_EFFECTIVE_TABLE_PLACEMENT System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/f3f74ec66f5b1014850e8cb59fd084ef.html)
595248841.title: TABLE_PLACEMENT and M_EFFECTIVE_TABLE_PLACEMENT system views

595248842.text: Several new columns have been added to this system view. See [M_REMOTE_CONNECTIONS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20b91d7375191014940dedfed99e278f.html).
595248842.title: M_REMOTE_CONNECTIONS system view

595248843.text: Several new columns have been added to this public monitoring view. See [M_REMOTE_STATEMENTS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20b9a2217519101483f6949244f55513.html).
595248843.title: M_REMOTE_STATEMENTS system view

595248844.text: The INSERT statement now supports the NOWAIT parameter. See [INSERT Statement (Data Manipulation)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f7f70975191014a76da70c9181720e.html).
595248844.title: INSERT statement

595248845.text: This statement has been extended to allow auditing of credential management. See [CREATE AUDIT POLICY Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20d3d56075191014af43d6487fcaa603.html)
595248845.title: CREATE AUDIT POLICY statement

595248846.text: This statement now supports adding an existing replica table to virtual table. See [ALTER VIRTUAL TABLE Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/51826981a2d24e7aa872f4278220b579.html).
595248846.title: ALTER VIRTUAL TABLE statement

595248847.text:
These new functions return information on connection restrictions.See:
- [VALIDATE_USERGROUP_CONNECT_RESTRICTION_DETAILS Function (Security)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/508e1735f86a4c97a9072627e1e265de.html)
- [VALIDATE_USERGROUP_CONNECT_RESTRICTION Function (Security)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/c7a96e0bcc51447fa2af31413dbaff41.html)
595248847.title: VALIDATE_USERGROUP_CONNECT_RESTRICTION and VALIDATE_USERGROUP_CONNECT_RESTRICTION_DETAILS functions

595248848.text: The REMOTE_DURATION column has been added to this view. See [M_REMOTE_STATEMENTS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20b9a2217519101483f6949244f55513.html).
595248848.title: M_REMOTE_STATEMENTS system view

595248849.text: The REMOTE_SERVER_VERSION column has been added to this view. See [M_REMOTE_CONNECTIONS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20b91d7375191014940dedfed99e278f.html).
595248849.title: M_REMOTE_CONNECTIONS system view

595248850.text: The <connect restriction> clause now supports restrictions by application in addition to restrictions by IP addresses. The USERGROUP_CONNECTION_RESTRICTIONS system view has been updated to reflect this new restriction type. See [CREATE USERGROUP Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/9869125ea93548009820702f5bd897d8.html).
595248850.title: CREATE USERGROUP statement

595248851.text: You can now remove cache entries by the hash value of the cached entry. See [ALTER SYSTEM REMOVE CACHE Statement (System Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/e4a2ad5facb04ae2b76b6c885f7913ff.html).
595248851.title: ALTER SYSTEM <samp class="ph codeph">REMOVE</samp> CACHE statement

595248852.text: This view displays the relationship between subqueries and the main query for Asynchronous Batch requests. See [M_MULTIDIMENSIONAL_STATEMENTS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/4de7e92c6015491aa380bdfe26070aa0.html).
595248852.title: M_MULTIDIMENSIONAL_STATEMENTS system view

595248853.text: You can now export multiple files into the PARQUET or CSV file formats. You can now export query results into CSV, PARQUET, or JSON file formats. See [EXPORT INTO Statement (Data Import Export)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/6a6f59bbfbb64ade84d83d7f87789753.html).
595248853.title: EXPORT INTO statement

595248854.text: You can now choose a HIVE or DELTA directory type when importing data. See [IMPORT FROM Statement (Data Import Export)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f712e175191014907393741fadcb97.html).
595248854.title: IMPORT FROM statement

595248855.text: A new value has been added to the COMPILATION_OPTIONS column of this view to return a STATEMENT HINT ON INNER STATEMENT option when the SQLScript compiler applies a statement hint to one of the inner statements of this SQLScript plan. See [M_SQL_PLAN_CACHE System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/m-sql-plan-cache-system-view.html).
595248855.title: M_SQL_PLAN_CACHE system view

595248856.text: Three new columns have been added to this view to provide additional information on statement hints. See [STATEMENT_HINTS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/statement-hints-system-view).
595248856.title: STATEMENT_HINTS system view

595248857.text: The LAST_SYNC_TIME column displays the time of the last replication synchronization. See [M_VIRTUAL_TABLE_REPLICAS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/2686e15ce25848db9bc1da827830d815.html).
595248857.title: M_VIRTUAL_TABLE_REPLICAS system view

595248858.text: This view provides information on the running status of SQL Plan Advisor. See [M_SQL_PLAN_ADVISOR System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/afa22f3bfcab4d5e8bac20529209ae56.html).
595248858.title: M_SQL_PLAN_ADVISOR system view

595248859.text: The SCORE function has been extended to supported new clauses. See [SCORE Function (Miscellaneous)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20e6f8e97519101489a0cd3c29991e72.html).
595248859.title: SCORE function (miscellaneous)

595248860.text: This new function returns the relevance of grouped records found. See [GROUP_SCORE Function (Miscellaneous)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/89bc59e4df254c29b66f8feed2b785dc.html).
595248860.title: GROUP_SCORE function

595248861.text: The REPLACE option allows you to control the behavior if the export file already exists in the specified directory when performing an EXPORT INTO. See [EXPORT INTO Statement (Data Import Export)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/6a6f59bbfbb64ade84d83d7f87789753.html).
595248861.title: EXPORT INTO statement

595248862.text: This new view displays details of authentication errors occurring during connection using a client or SQL statement. See [AUTHENTICATION_ERROR_DETAILS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/818ef2c9866842cf94a3adb36050b2a7.html).
595248862.title: AUTHENTICATION_ERROR_DETAILS system view

595248863.text:
Connection attempts by members of a user group can be restricted using IP / Network addresses.See:
- [CREATE USERGROUP Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/9869125ea93548009820702f5bd897d8.html)
- [ALTER USERGROUP Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/aa94ca874c01458da5a275aac8883c23.html)
- [USERGROUPS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/ac342d0868b244b0b42e16b3dbb5d7bc.html)
- [USERGROUP_CONNECT_RESTRICTIONS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/57d3364557d140c291e6cc5fb09eef7c.html)
595248863.title: CREATE/ALTER USERGROUPS statement

595248864.text: The columns CCM_CONNECTION_ID and CCM_CONNECTION_VERSION have been added to the view to provide connection information from the Central Connection Management (CCM) service. See [REMOTE_SOURCES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20ccdd3975191014af6fc087f30c56da.html).
595248864.title: REMOTE_SOURCES system view

595248865.text:
These functions now return spatial data types (ST_POINT, ST_GEOMETRY) when they are executed with spatial types as input parameter. See:
- [FIRST_VALUE Function (Aggregate)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/034b17549b5d4b7d913e2c2770eea45b.html)
- [LAST_VALUE Function (Aggregate)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/32e95b7fac5c4b489d938c11ce5b4695.html)
- [NTH_VALUE Function (Aggregate)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/6522df94eee542d5b1700a7766e6e6a2.html)
595248865.title: FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, NTH_VALUE aggregation functions

595248866.text:
These functions now support the Factory And Holiday Calendar. The parameters <table_name_suffix> and <client> have been added to these functions.See:
- [ADD_WORKDAYS Function (Datetime)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/d22c8391d2951014815a84e76cf66501.html)
- [WORKDAYS_BETWEEN Function (Datetime)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/d232c253d295101486a3dee449981b3f.html)
595248866.title: ADD_WORKDAYS and WORKDAYS_BETWEEN functions

595248867.text: You can now specify a procedure/function definition for the target query. When specified, the given hint is implicitly applied. See [ALTER SYSTEM {ADD | ALTER | REMOVE} STATEMENT HINT Statement (System Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/1ec23ef0839b45b7991a785eff19fd2c.html).
595248867.title: ALTER SYSTEM {<samp class="ph codeph">ADD</samp>/ALTER/<samp class="ph codeph">REMOVE</samp>} STATEMENT HINT statement

595248868.text: You can now specify a procedure/function definition for the target query when enabling or disabling a hint. See [ALTER SYSTEM {ENABLE | DISABLE} STATEMENT HINT Statement (System Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/8505e6f5023c4092901735116d03fdce.html).
595248868.title: ALTER SYSTEM {ENABLE/DISABLE} STATEMENT HINT statement

595248869.text:
The parameter ENABLE | DISABLE ROLE ADMIN allows a user with the object privilege GRANTOR is now able to rescind the special right on this role group for ROLE ADMINS.See:
- [CREATE ROLEGROUP Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/6cf193279bb4481faf8f2c77f137250c.html).
- [ALTER ROLEGROUP Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/bb0d9c0c86f6421cb3c37e48dc513d38.html).
595248869.title: CREATE/ALTER ROLEGROUP statements

595248870.text:
The column STATEMENT_HASH has been added to these views.See:
- [M_ACTIVE_PROCEDURES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/f3d23305d0dd495590e0061c3546de9a.html).
- [M_SQLSCRIPT_PLAN_PROFILER_RESULTS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/3f527e6958e24226879a1dd656f6e3bc.html)
595248870.title: M_SQLSCRIPT_PLAN_PROFILER_RESULTS and M_ACTIVE_PROCEDURES system views

595248871.text: A new clause, <collation_clause>, supports collation at the statement. See [SELECT Statement (Data Manipulation)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20fcf24075191014a89e9dc7b8408b26.html).
595248871.title: SELECT statement

595248872.text: A new view has been introduced to display reclamation statistics on a data volume. See [M_DATA_VOLUME_RECLAIM_STATISTICS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/a46bcb1203fa4c8691875a0b9e806b61.html).
595248872.title: M_DATA_VOLUME_RECLAIM_STATISTICS system view

595248873.text: Several columns have been added to the view to display information on the minimum, maximum, average of CPU time and memory size. See [M_ABSTRACT_SQL_PLAN_STATISTICS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/35af7f289b924f7a9302f11629127f27.html).
595248873.title: M_ABSTRACT_SQL_PLAN_STATISTICS system view

595248874.text:
You can now include APPLICATION SOURCE as a key value when creating and altering workload mappings. The WORKLOAD_MAPPINGS System View has also been extended to display this value.See:
- [CREATE WORKLOAD MAPPING Statement (Workload Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/996978a669b847ea89ca7f2cce41d916.html)
- [ALTER WORKLOAD MAPPING Statement (Workload Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/81fc16bfa4904943b730bcd1848cd37d.html)
- [WORKLOAD_MAPPINGS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/89a066058d3f4e7f873216c6050181de.html)
595248874.title: CREATE / ALTER WORKLOAD MAPPINGS statements

595248875.text: This new view provides REST statistics data, aggregated per SQL statement and categorized as ADMIN/READ/WRITE. See [M_OUTBOUND_NETWORK_IO System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/36582b7ca52247928b852399eea20c95.html)
595248875.title: M_OUTBOUND_NETWORK_IO system view

595248876.text:
This new view provides information on outbound connectivity status to external SAP-managed services running in SAP HANA cloud.
See [M_REMOTE_SERVICES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/a4bbb3b6d2e246d8bf4938f7c9c413b2.html).
595248876.title: M_REMOTE_SERVICES system view

595248877.text:
The CALL statement now supports the cascading of hints into internal SQL statements after optimization. When there are nested CALL statements, CASCADE hints are also propagated into the nested procedures.
See [CALL Statement (Procedural)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20d364c175191014b592f500ccb5510c.html).
595248877.title: CALL statement

595248878.text:
The PARTITION ADMIN system privilege has been introduced to allow the execution of non-destructive partitioning clauses in the ALTER TABLE Statement.
See:
- [GRANT Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f674e1751910148a8b990d33efbdc5.html)
- [Non-Heterogeneous Alter Partition Clauses](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/f7ae27ca1b954471a4e1a7feab2c24d7.html)
- [Heterogeneous Alter Partition Clauses](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/a4258b865710423b8712b06fb5b8e7c5.html)
595248878.title: <samp class="ph codeph">GRANT</samp> statement

595248879.text:
The audit log table is now configured to use SAP HANA Native Storage Extensions (NSE) by default. You can also choose to load it completely into memory as before.
See [ALTER SYSTEM ALTER AUDIT LOG (System Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/f135e4a7883746f4b4b7c06b8605a589.html).
595248879.title: ALTER SYSTEM ALTER AUDIT LOG statement

595248880.text:
The IS_VALID column has been added to this view to indicate whether the workload mapping is valid or not.
See [WORKLOAD_MAPPINGS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/89a066058d3f4e7f873216c6050181de.html).
595248880.title: WORKLOAD MAPPINGS system view

595248881.text:
You can now specify schema names for some DDL based audit actions. The Audit Actions system view has been extended to include this information.
The audit actions IMPORT, IMPORT SCAN, and EXPORT statements can now be tracked by the audit policy.
See:
- [CREATE AUDIT POLICY Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20d3d56075191014af43d6487fcaa603.html)
- [AUDIT_ACTIONS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/b856cdd2d8bf44c1a79dac7976f10119.html)
595248881.title: CREATE AUDIT POICY statement

595248882.text:
The M_CACHE and M_CACHE_ENTRIES system views now include information on the time of the last access of the cache instance.
See:
- [M_CACHES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20a93aa875191014b777dfd020006ba1.html)
- [M_CACHE_ENTRIES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20a907b675191014b6e8a18b2968e12f.html)
595248882.title: M_CACHE and M_CACHE_ENTRIES system views

595248883.text: Fuzzy search indexes now support NCLOB columns.See [CREATE FUZZY SEARCH INDEX Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/9b79b31dde1b4f6d84144fba8d942bd3.html).
595248883.title: CREATE FUZZY SEARCH INDEX statement

595248884.text: You can now set the minimum number of days when creating an audit policy with the RETENTION syntax for the TABLE trail type.See: [CREATE AUDIT POLICY Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20d3d56075191014af43d6487fcaa603.html)
595248884.title: CREATE AUDIT POLICY statement

595248885.text: Duplicate certificates are supported as long as a certificate name is specified and unique.See [CREATE CERTIFICATE Statement (System Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/ba87935fc4a84f4eb805d5eba9a7b480.html).
595248885.title: CREATE CERTIFICATE statement

595248886.text:
The CREATE REMOTE SOURCE statement has been extended to support X509 <PSE_name>.See:
- [CREATE REMOTE SOURCE Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20d48343751910149985a2c925e12190.html)
595248886.title: CREATE <samp class="ph codeph">REMOTE</samp> SOURCE statement

595248887.text:
You can now remove all or only invalid related objects of the captured plan. Information related to the related object definition have been added to the M_ABSTRACT_SQL_PLAN_OVERVIEW system view.See:
- [ALTER SYSTEM {ENABLE | DISABLE | REMOVE} ABSTRACT SQL PLAN (System Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/031158f3b53342b095ab4d49ffd95a3e.html)
- [M_ABSTRACT_SQL_PLAN_OVERVIEW System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/03aa3adec2ba48ee9e2e25ba26df6cb7.html)
595248887.title: ALTER SYSTEM <samp class="ph codeph">REMOVE</samp> ABSTRACT SQL PLAN RELATED OBJECT DEFINITION statement

595248888.text:
The CREATE ADAPTER system privilege has been added to support the creation of adapters to which object privileges can be granted. The ADAPTERS system view has been modified to display information on this new tye of adapter.See:
- [GRANT Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f674e1751910148a8b990d33efbdc5.html)
- [REVOKE Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20fc91cb75191014ac15eb4d6f2d7dde.html)
- [ADAPTERS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/6d91840b7a6849a385b9e08400b81d97.html)
595248888.title: <samp class="ph codeph">GRANT</samp> / <samp class="ph codeph">REVOKE</samp> statement

595248889.text: SAP passport information has been added to the AUDIT_LOG system view to assist in the analysis of errors related to SAP Passport.See [AUDIT_LOG System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/d1fe1244d29510148f69be8b0e060dcc.html).
595248889.title: AUDIT_LOG system view

595248890.text:
Audit policies now supports the specification of usergroups in addition to users for explicit inclusion or exclusion in the logging of audit events. The AUDIT_POLICIES system view has been modified to reflect this changed.See:
- [CREATE AUDIT POLICY Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20d3d56075191014af43d6487fcaa603.html)
- [AUDIT_POLICIES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/209e4d3d75191014b419a2dc6e6a202a.html)
595248890.title: CREATE AUDIT POLICY statement

595248891.text:
You can now import from publicly readable cloud storage.See:
- [IMPORT Statement (Data Import Export)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f75ade751910148492a90e5e375b8f.html)
- [IMPORT FROM Statement (Data Import Export)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f712e175191014907393741fadcb97.html)
- [IMPORT SCAN Statement (Data Import Export)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f79b2175191014a45f9947577a2e85.html)
595248891.title: IMPORT / IMPORT FROM / IMPORT SCAN statements

595248892.text: Some limitations to support thread limits on hierarchical workload class have been removed. See [CREATE WORKLOAD CLASS Statement (Workload Management)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/dc417c30b1b3460c8860f6c7ea2a7faa.html).
595248892.title: CREATE WORKLOAD CLASS statement

595248893.text:
The M_PREPARED_STATEMENTS and M_ACTIVE_STATEMENTS views have been enhanced to support thread limits.See:
- [M_PREPARED_STATEMENTS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20b7ea517519101496d5ecc1166ba4b9.html)
- [M_ACTIVE_STATEMENTS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/d20500acd2951014b54ce5af8c1cf675.html)
595248893.title: M_PREPARED_STATEMENTS and M_ACTIVE_STATEMENTS system views

595248894.text:
Two public monitoring views are now available to provide information about locked tables and threads waiting to lock tables, from the perspective of the Column Store lock manager (IndexMgr).See:
- [M_CS_TABLE_HANDLES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/de4f805158a84e349504f1f9bc2348cf.html)
- [M_CS_TABLE_LOCKS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/d1e58889c4bb4f9e88411a0e5a5e3590.html)
595248894.title: M_CS_TABLE_LOCKS and M_CS_TABLE_HANDLES system views

595248895.text:
You can now create a fuzzy search index on NVARCHAR columns. The index name has also been added to the M_FUZZY_SEACH INDEXES system view.See:
- [CREATE FUZZY SEARCH INDEX Statement (Data Definition)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/9b79b31dde1b4f6d84144fba8d942bd3.html)
- [M_FUZZY_SEARCH_INDEXES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20b027ca75191014a424a892c83e9c8f.html)
595248895.title: CREATE FUZZY SEARCH INDEX statement

595248896.text: The size of the FUZZY_SEARCH_MODE column has been increased to display 32 characters. See [TABLE_COLUMNS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/2100d33a75191014868bbcd89274199c.html).
595248896.title: TABLE_COLUMNS system view

595248897.text:
Three new columns have been added to the view to support searches for effective privileges and roles, respectively, for a given role.See:
- [EFFECTIVE_PRIVILEGES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20a2f3ea75191014a4c1d9b0859b9917.html)
- [EFFECTIVE_ROLES System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20a3229a75191014a9f0893bb1ea23d5.html)
595248897.title: EFFECTIVE_PRIVILEGES and EFFECTIVE_ROLES system views

595248898.text:
Two new privileges, DROP and GRANTOR, have been added to the GRANT and REVOKE statements to control the ability to manage user groups.See:
- [GRANT Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20f674e1751910148a8b990d33efbdc5.html)
- [REVOKE Statement (Access Control)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20fc91cb75191014ac15eb4d6f2d7dde.html)
595248898.title: <samp class="ph codeph">GRANT</samp> / <samp class="ph codeph">REVOKE</samp> statement

595248899.title: Arrays

595248900.text: The column PERSISTENT_MEMORY_SIZE_IN_TOTAL has been added to the view to display persistent memory consumption (in bytes) for every column store table. See [M_TABLE_PARTITIONS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/6e819179eebd4560a09cb1679748c025.html)
595248900.title: M_TABLE_PARTITIONS system view

595248910.text:
SAP is changing the root certificate authority (CA) that is used to sign its transport layer security (TLS) connections to HANA Cloud servers from "DigiCert Global Root CA" to "DigiCert Global Root G2". DigiCert has stopped signing certificates with the root "DigiCert Global Root CA". For more details about this change, see:
[https://knowledge.digicert.com/general-information/digicert-root-and-intermediate-ca-certificate-updates-2023](https://knowledge.digicert.com/general-information/digicert-root-and-intermediate-ca-certificate-updates-2023)
[3327214](https://me.sap.com/notes/3327214)
[3399573](https://me.sap.com/notes/3399573)

595248911.text:
You can now restrict connections of applications for user groups.
See [User Groups](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/b9174d035f274ce481387700c13b7d2c.html)

595248912.text:
You can now validate all connect restrictions, active and inactive, of a user group using the functions VALIDATE_USERGROUP_CONNECT_RESTRICTION and VALIDATE_USERGROUP_CONNECT_RESTRICTION_DETAILS.
See [SQL Statements and Authorization for User Group Administration (Reference)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/bdc34546fcdf4d24b58b1235dda68ec8.html)

[VALIDATE_USERGROUP_CONNECT_RESTRICTION Function (Security)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/c7a96e0bcc51447fa2af31413dbaff41.html)
595248912.title: Validate Connect Restrictions of a User Group

The TLS 1.3 protocol is now supported.
See [Secure Communication Between SAP HANA and SAP HANA Clients](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/dbd3d887bb571014bf05ca887f897b99.html)
595248913.title: TLS 1.3 Protocol Support

You can now restrict connections of members of a user group using IP / Network addresses.
See [User Groups](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/b9174d035f274ce481387700c13b7d2c.html)

You can now troubleshoot authentication errors of SQL connections by viewing the system view SYS.AUTHENTICATION_ERROR_DETAILS .
See [Troubleshooting Authentication Problems](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/a8f043bd2989477a9fe7fda604fcbec4.html)
