595248916.text:
Integration with SAP Data Custodian Key Management System is now possible to support customer-controlled encryption keys (CCEK) when you configure SAP HANA Cloud instances.
See [Customer-Controlled Encryption Keys (CCEK)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/07785561304e459aa7a311f69a8151b5.html).
595248916.title: Integration with SAP Data Custodian Key Management Service (KMS)

595248917.text: The authentication database trace topic has been reworked to show all relevant information to diagnose authentication problems as part of the Warnings trace level. This is a work in progress.
595248917.title: Improved authentication error reporting in HANA database trace

595248918.text:
The audit log now displays the name of the authentication method used to authenticate the connection.
See [AUDIT_LOG System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/d1fe1244d29510148f69be8b0e060dcc.html).
595248918.title: Authentication Method for Audit Log

595248919.text:
The SQLScript procedure GET_INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGE_ERROR_DETAILS (SYS) now displays SAP passport information to better understand authorization errors.
See [GET_INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGE_ERROR_DETAILS (SYS)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/9a73c4c017744288b8d6f3b9bc0db043.html).
595248919.title: SAP Passport Error Details

595248920.text: The new SET USERGROUP statement allows you to specify the user group to which all users created within the current session are automatically added. You do not have to specify the role group explicitly for every new user (until you execute the UNSET USERGROUP statement).See [SET USERGROUP](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/19918539993849888af17415d43382b5.html) and [UNSET USERGROUP](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/996f99709bfa4037a9dcce812b6d57d9.html).
595248920.title: Default user group for new users

595248921.text:
It is now possible to configure SAML and JWT identity providers for automatic user creation in conjunction with LDAP group authorization. This means that if you use an LDAP-compliant directory server to manage users and their access to resources, you can now leverage this infrastructure to provision the database users required for SAML- and JWT-authenticated users.
A database user can be automatically created for a SAML-/JWT-authenticated user if the user exists in your LDAP server and this user is a member of at least one LDAP group mapped to at least one SAP HANA role.
See:
- [Single Sign-On Using SAML 2.0](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/db6db355bb571014b56eb25057daec5f.html)
- [Single Sign-On Using JSON Web Tokens](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c82f8d6a84c147f8b78bf6416dae7290/4b3dc4d4b5514dbd9d45cee7bc167c5a.html)
- [Configure SAML or JWT Authentication with LDAP-Based User Provisioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/8a0c391b1b104f8b8e9b0ccb74155390.html)
595248921.title: SAML and JWT authentication with automatic user creation

595248922.text:
You can now use the HDI Administration app in SAP HANA Cloud Central (HCC) to assign schema privileges and roles for SAP HANA Deployment Infrastructure (SAP HDI). To access the HDI Administration app, navigate to the User & Authorization Management card of your instance.
See [SAP HDI Administration in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/grant-and-revoke-sap-hdi-schema-privileges).
595248922.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248923.text:
You can now use the HDI Administration app in SAP HANA Cloud Central (HCC) to manage the SAP HANA Deployment Infrastructure, HDI container groups, and HDI containers. To access the HDI Administration app, navigate to the User & Authorization Management card of your instance.
See [SAP HDI Administration in SAP HANA Cloud Central](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/sap-hdi-administration-in-sap-hana-cloud-central).
595248923.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248924.text: To provide better performance of statement execution when systems are not under load, a configuration parameter has been introduced to ignore workload class limitations when the system is below a given load level. This is the default_statement_concurrency_max_limit parameter which is set to 50% by default. If the load on the system is below 50% then no thread or concurrency limits will be applied. See [Managing Workload with Workload Classes](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/managing-workload-with-workload-classes)
595248924.title: Ignore concurrency limits when not required

595248925.text: You can now use the MOVEABLE partition property to pin RANGE partitions to a specific location. See [Partition Properties](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/partition-properties)
595248925.title: Pin partitions to a hosting

595248926.text:
The HDI hdbsystemversioning plug-in now supports the creation of system-versioned tables with transactional system-time.
See [System Versioning Tables (.hdbsystemversioning)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/5794b348711f4963999266a2d2e6f8de.html).
595248926.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248927.text:
The HDI hdbmigrationtable plug-in now supports the UPSERT statement for table migrations.
See [Migration Tables (.hdbmigrationtable)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/52d1f5acfa754a7887e21226641eb261.html).
595248927.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248928.text:
The default setting for the HDI build plug-in parameter "force_drop_columns" is now "true".
See [SAP HDI Parameters (Build Plug-in Parameters)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/e2d3e543067e4f3282bf6dbf880c6b2d.html).
595248928.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248929.text: See [Data Loading Characteristics on Replicas You can determine the data loading characteristics of a table (page or column loadable) by setting the PAGE_LOADABLE attribute for each table. Using table placement you can now set the loading characteristics (PAGE or COLUMN LOADABLE) of tables on replicas by setting a value for the TABLE_PLACEMENT.REPLICA_LOAD_UNIT field. This is for indexserver replicas but additionally a column is available for use in scale out systems COMPUTE_REPLICA_LOAD_UNIT which applies to the Elastic Read Node.](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/table-placement-rules)
595248929.title: Set the Load Unit of a Replica

595248930.text: You can determine the data loading characteristics of a table In the area of Partitioning a ‘Safe’ repartitioning option has been introduced to prevent expensive statements from being submitted unnecessarily. This is the CHECK NO DATA MOVE clause which can be added to repartitioning statements and which will automatically cancel a statement if it will involve expensive operations such as moving data. See [Safe Repartitioning (CHECK NO DATA MOVE)](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/partitioning-operations)
595248930.title: ‘Safe’ Repartitioning

595248931.text: Multidimensional services is the processing engine in SAP HANA Cloud to handle analytics data. An external API is now available to manage and maintain MDS Cubes. Requests are submitted by client libraries over HTTP(S) in JSON format and are handled by the SAP internal protocol 'InA' (InformationAccess). See [Administration of MDS Cubes](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/managing-and-monitoring-mds-cubes)
595248931.title: Multidimensional Services API

595248932.text: Parameters are now available to select and sort the API results. You can apply 'filter' and 'orderby' to any of the attributes in the response. See [APIs for Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/apis-for-metrics)
595248932.title: Metrics API Filtering the Output

595248933.text: You can improve the effectiveness of a cache by removing specific obsolete entries. Options are now available to remove individual cache entries (identified by a CACHE_ID value) instead of clearing a cache completely. See [Cache Management](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/cache-management)
595248933.title: Cache Management

595248934.text: You can now append a select statement to the EXPORT INTO command and update a target text file in storage with the set of data returned from the query. Three file formats are possible: CSV, Parquet, and JSON. See [EXPORT INTO Using a Query as a Data Source](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/importing-open-table-format-delta-lake-data)
595248934.title: Export to Text File

595248935.text: You can now use the IMPORT FROM statement to import data from open-source data sources using the open table format. HIVE PARTITION and DELTA LAKE formats are supported. See [Support for Open Source Formats](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/importing-open-table-format-delta-lake-data)
595248935.title: CSV and Parquet Files

595248936.text: With CSV and Parquet formats you can import and export multiple files at the same time. If the specified path points to a directory then all files in the directory will be imported or the data is exported to multiple files. In parquet format the number of output files is determined by the grouping defined in the source file, you can use the ROW GROUP SIZE value in the export statement to manage the size of the output files. See [IMPORT / EXPORT CSV and Parquet Files](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/importing-and-exporting-with-microsoft-azure-storage)
595248936.title: CSV and Parquet Files

595248937.text:
The HDI administrator can now use the new HDI build plug-in parameter revoke_external_parameters to revoke privileges granted to .hdbrole artifacts.
See [SAP HDI Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/e2d3e543067e4f3282bf6dbf880c6b2d.html).
595248937.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248938.text:
The HDI administrator can now add the build plug-in for the new database artifact type remote-table replication (.hdbremotetablereplica) to the list of plug-ins available in an HDI container.
See [SAP HDI Artifact Types and Build Plug-ins Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/9789224788a34d93a86080cab993575c.html).
595248938.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248939.text:
The HDI administrator can export an HDI container to (and import from) a Cloud Store with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Storage.
See [Export an SAP HDI Container for Copy Purposes to a Cloud Store](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/96d3500aff614d878ef919badd2a53fd.html) and [Import an SAP HDI Container for Copy Purposes to a Cloud Store](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/f11927de04b44bfa9a12bb85850c39d9.html).
595248939.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248940.text:
The HDI administrator can export an HDI container to (and import from) a Cloud Store with SAP HANA Cloud, data lake Files (HDLF).
See [Export an SAP HDI Container for Copy Purposes to a Cloud Store](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/96d3500aff614d878ef919badd2a53fd.html) and [Import an SAP HDI Container for Copy Purposes to a Cloud Store](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/f11927de04b44bfa9a12bb85850c39d9.html).
595248940.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248941.text: The trace file format has been enhanced. The new value is shown at M_MERGED_TRACES.W3C_TRACE_ID and W3C_SPAN_ID columns. If the raw trace file content exposed in CONTENT column of M_TRACEFILE_CONTENTS view is parsed by external tools, the parser should skip the new header column enclosed in '<' and '>'. See [M_TRACEFILE_CONTENTS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/m-tracefile-contents-system-view) and [M_MERGED_TRACES](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-sql-reference-guide/m-merged-traces-system-view).
595248941.title: Trace File Format

595248942.text: The workload class feature now includes a Monitoring page with an overview of workload classes, as well as a detailed workload class page where users can analyze statistics and individual SQL statements.See [Monitor Workload Classes](https://help.sap.com/docs/hana-cloud-database/sap-hana-cloud-sap-hana-database-administration-guide/monitor-workload-classes).
595248942.title: Workload Class Monitoring

595248943.text:
To safeguard the system from overloading, a default value of 25 % is now applied to the configuration parameter default_statement_concurrency_limit_rel. Parallel execution of a single statement is therefore restricted to 25% of the number of logical cores in the system.
See [Controlling Parallel Execution of SQL Statements](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/5c012ca1def64bceb5f29028325193bd.html).
595248943.title: Statement Concurrency Limit

595248944.text:
You can now use the native storage extension (NSE) Advisor to get recommendations on load units for tables, partitions, or columns according to how frequently they are accessed. Only available in Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.
See [Understanding the SAP HANA NSE Advisor](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ae95f13e417447f28cdff08cd7ab43f3.html).
595248944.title: NSE Advisor

595248945.text:
You can now create an SAP HANA service instance from another SAP HANA service instance. You can do this either when provisioning a new instance in HANA Cloud Central or from the command line.
See [Cloning an SAP HANA Database Instance](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD/9ae9104a46f74a6583ce5182e7fb20cb/59cc7a523fad4164aa511f7a58278c3e.html)
595248945.title: Instance Cloning

595248946.text:
SQL Plan Stability can now be used to capture and apply Abstract SQL Plans of SELECT queries that include SQLScript-generated temporary tables.
SQL Plan Stability resource management has also been improved: once storage capacity is full, older or invalid plans are automatically deleted to create space for new plans.
See [SQL Plan Stability with SQLScript Procedures](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/0d1544c74b534ea8a2761790d2ac6620.html)
595248946.title: Support SQLScript procedures

595248947.text:
A hierarchical relationship of up to three levels of workload classes is now supported so that values for memory limits and thread limits can be inherited by other workload classes.
See [Hierarchies of Workload Classes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/5ab8523b61cc4d2ba3fb41fe36bbca29.html).
595248947.title: Support Three Hierarchy Levels

595248948.text:
Authentication and authorization at subaccount level is now supported, with appropriate JSON Web Tokens, so that metrics from multiple SAP HANA Cloud instances are available from one single API call.
See [REST API Quick Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/ac092f55b0e148618bcff61c76049573.html).
595248948.title: Metrics API

595248949.text:
More options are now available when importing and exporting CSV and parquet files. A WITH REPLACE option is now supported so that any existing file with the same name will be overwritten. Importing parquet files is now improved with support for a WITH COLUMN LIST clause to filter and manage the data as it is imported.
See [Importing and Exporting Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/261937915fa5438ca545b8278b2979b7.html).
595248949.title: CSV and Parquet Files

595248950.text:
The HDI administrator can now use a group configuration parameter to enable and disable access to all HDI containers in an HDI container group for an application run-time user.
See [Enable and Disable Access to all Containers in a Container Group for Application Users](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/9dd270383b4c4a5f8b4a1e6fd3c3b757.html).
595248950.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248951.text:
The new HDI configuration parameter api.enable_flowgraph_access provides access to flow graphs.
See [SAP HDI Configuration Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/1d9582a464344b6c86bcd3489dca7554.html).
595248951.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248952.text:
The system views M_SQL_PLAN_STATISTICS and M_SQL_PLAN_CACHE now display the total, average, maximum, and minimum size of NSE pages read from disk into the buffer cache.
See [M_SQL_PLAN_STATISTICS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/84d12a5a4b9449cf8bc3c5ccb16c30c6.html).
See [M_SQL_PLAN_CACHE System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/20c57b8e75191014b22fcc8222b15970.html).
595248952.title: NSE disk read statistics per plan

595248953.text:
The new parameter unload_threshold specifies the percentage of the buffer cache's maximum size to which it should be reduced automatically when buffer capacity is not fully used.
See [Adjusting the Buffer Cache Size](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/2436bae042054ec880ff5d1f436ef0a0.html).
595248953.title: Adjust buffer cache size dynamically

595248954.text:
The DECIMAL(p,s) data type is now supported for the range partitioning column.
See [Dynamic Range Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/6ebea7782b9e4758baeed923e388ee32.html).
595248954.title: Dynamic Range Partitioning - Data Types

595248955.text:
Using HASH partitioning it is now possible to use the NUMA Nodes property to specify a list of preferred nodes for the partitions.
See [Partition Properties](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d82cb8dfcc1444d0a663c5cfc0931d4c.html).
595248955.title: Multi-Tier Partitioning

595248956.text:
Using heterogeneous partitioning, partitioning over three-levels is now possible for some multi-level partitioning combinations. RANGE-RANGE-HASH and RANGE-RANGE-RANGE are now supported.
See [Partitioning Over Three-Levels](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/17633d723f6c44ac9f00c06bd03cbdc7.html).
595248956.title: Multi-Tier Partitioning

595248957.text:
Some restrictions related to write operations which can be performed on replication tables when Autocommit DDL mode is set to 'off' have now been removed.
See [Table Replication Limitations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/7683a6b0e9f649808cb956cd50087c5f.html).
595248957.title: Table Replication Limitations

595248958.text:
Plan Stability has been modified so that the capture abstract SQL plans process is automatically enabled by default.
See [Using SQL Plan Stability](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/f735efe8524348399224989eebd239ce.html).
595248958.title: Capture Abstract Plans

595248959.text:
You can now connect to SAP Converged Cloud (CCloud) to import and export data using the Amazon S3 file management API. CCloud uses an Open-Source Object Storage System built on top of the Swift OpenStack service. Details of the path representation required are given in the documentation.
See [Importing and Exporting with SAP Converged Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/23d848d4fcc34a90ae70cd56307d1f7e.html).
595248959.title: Support for SAP Converged Cloud

595248960.text:
The workload mapping property 'Application Source Name' is now available, corresponding to the session variable APPLICATION_SOURCE.
See [Properties for Workload Classes and Mappings](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/3ae17c3b1d6c4adea6f0ddfec3041dd4.html).
595248960.title: Workload Class Mapping

595248961.text:
HDI now provides support for fuzzy-search indexes in the index plug-in (.hdbindex).
See FUZZY SEARCH INDEX in [Indexes (.hdbindex)](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/58fdf2d2ffae44b6a3dd0e9a3f5ae8c5.html).
595248961.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248962.text:
HDI now provides support for the database artifact type Scheduler Jobs (.hdbschedulerjob).
See Scheduler Job in [SAP HDI Artifact Types and Build Plug-ins Reference](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/9789224788a34d93a86080cab993575c.html).
595248962.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248963.text:
HDI now provides the following new _SYS_DI views: M_ALL_CONTAINER_CONFIGURATIONS and M_ALL_GROUP_CONFIGURATIONS.
See [_SYS_DI Monitoring Views](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/78e1657f43f04741b9c2b161632e4fe5.html).
595248963.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248964.text:
It is now possible to use the HDI container-group API to enable cross-container access between HDI containers in the same HDI container group.
See Container-Group-Specific Configuration Parameters in [SAP HDI Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/e2d3e543067e4f3282bf6dbf880c6b2d.html) and [Enable and Disable Cross-Container Access](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/c3c34fdeccae423ea2071fd61acba787.html).
595248964.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248965.text:
Two new columns are available for M_BUFFER_CACHE_STATISTICS and M_BUFFER_CACHE_POOL_STATISTICS:
- IO_READ_SIZE displays the disk I/O reads size by the cache in bytes
- MISS_COUNT displays the cache miss count of the cache group
See [M_BUFFER_CACHE_POOL_STATISTICS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/4c417c702d7f4ec4ac39c4abcde5abfc.html) and [M_BUFFER_CACHE_STATISTICS System View](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c1d3f60099654ecfb3fe36ac93c121bb/67939bc3ace4409ea01ac9aaa1ec6407.html)
595248965.title: Additional Columns for Buffer Cache Statistics

595248966.text:
Values for the following metrics can now be retrieved by API call: HDBEstimatedMemorySize, HDBBackupTotalSize.
See [Overview of Available Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/46e370ced3ef4d2bbd0ec2337df5f565.html)
595248966.title: Metrics API

595248967.text:
The PARTITION ADMIN system privilege is now available; with this privilege users can modify the partitioning structure of a table without the need for specific object privileges.
See [Table Partitioning - Privileges](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c2ea130bbb571014b024ffeda5090764.html)
595248967.title: Privileges

595248968.text:
To support dynamic range partitioning of existing tables, the NVARCHAR data type is also now accepted as a date/time value to define an INTERVAL threshold.
See [Dynamic Range Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/6ebea7782b9e4758baeed923e388ee32.html)
595248968.title: Supported Data Types

595248969.text:
Dynamic Range Partitioning has been enhanced by the addition of dynamic aging which makes it possible to automatically manage at which point in time older partitions can be moved to the 'warm' data store.
See [Dynamic Aging](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/97e7c96f8a9d43ed90fc448c0d0b7f09.html)
595248969.title: Dynamic Aging

595248970.text:
It is now possible to view past statistics of M_BUFFER_CACHE_STATISTICS and M_BUFFER_CACHE_POOL_STATISTICS using HOST_BUFFER_CACHE_STATISTICS and HOST_BUFFER_CACHE_POOL_STATISTICSSee:
- [HOST_BUFFER_CACHE_STATISTICS](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/323c57a017234d47a0e7da3e22345822/14b6d3b479ea440ea31ea217012fd329.html)
- [HOST_BUFFER_CACHE_POOL_STATISTICS](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/323c57a017234d47a0e7da3e22345822/126a9bc5b592494581d9ba2967eebc5d.html)
595248970.title: Historized Monitoring Views for NSE

595248971.text: Changes and additions have been made to the default value of some SAP HDI configuration parameters, for example, Connection.max_tries_for_initializationSee [SAP HDI Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/1d9582a464344b6c86bcd3489dca7554.html)
595248971.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248972.text: It is now possible to use the HDI container-group API to enable cross-container access between HDI containers in the same HDI container group.See Container-Group-Specific Configuration Parameters in [SAP HDI Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/c3c34fdeccae423ea2071fd61acba787.html)
595248972.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248973.text:
Geo-spatial data types (ST_POINT and ST_GEOMETRY) in the partitioning column can now be used for repartitioning where a new location is specified.
See [Partitioning Operations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c359de53bb571014966699a9229af09d.html)
595248973.title: Partitioning Using New Locations

595248974.text:
Negative numbers are now supported in the dynamic range partitioning column and entries with negative values are added where necessary to the OTHERS partition. New dynamic partitions are created for numbers greater than the partition boundary (greater-than in a positive direction).
See examples in Negative Numbers in [Dynamic Range Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/6ebea7782b9e4758baeed923e388ee32.html)
595248974.title: Dynamic Range Partitioning

595248975.text:
Additional resource usage metrics are now supported in SAP HANA Cloud: the Get Metric Values API can now be used to aggregate values over a specific period of time.
See [Overview of Available Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/46e370ced3ef4d2bbd0ec2337df5f565.html) and [APIs for Metrics](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c20295e8e76345da98f2c374a94bda3c.html)
595248975.title: API for Metrics

595248976.text:
Anonymous access to cloud storage resources to retrieve public data (where no authorization is required) is now possible (this option not supported for SAP HANA Cloud Data Lake Storage)
See [Importing and Exporting Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/261937915fa5438ca545b8278b2979b7.html)
595248976.title: Anonymous Import

595248977.text:
The workload class properties Statement Thread Limit and Total Statement Thread Limit are now supported for use in hierarchical classes.
See [Hierarchies of Workload Classes](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/5ab8523b61cc4d2ba3fb41fe36bbca29.html)
595248977.title: Thread Management

595248978.text:
Ranges are normally specified as 'bounded' ranges with both an upper and lower limit. Unbounded ranges with no upper bound are also now supported.
See [Range Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c338627bbb571014ae7d9533861b600f.html)
595248978.title: Range Partitioning

595248979.text:
The data type NVARCHAR is now supported for the interval property. The text value representing numbers is mapped to the BIGINT type.
See [Dynamic Range Partitioning](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/6ebea7782b9e4758baeed923e388ee32.html)
595248979.title: Dynamic Range Partitioning

595248980.text:
When the partitioning property Persistent Memory has been applied to a partition, consumption is now shown in PERSISTENT_MEMORY_SIZE_IN_TOTAL in monitoring view M_TABLE_PARTITIONS.
See [Partition Properties](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/d82cb8dfcc1444d0a663c5cfc0931d4c.html)
595248980.title: Persistent memory usage

595248981.text:
A new session variable TENANT has been introduced and a corresponding workload class mapping property TENANT NAME. Administrators can use this mapping to limit resource consumption for all statements executed in the context of a tenant.
See [Properties for Workload Classes and Mappings](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/3ae17c3b1d6c4adea6f0ddfec3041dd4.html)
595248981.title: Workload class mappings

595248982.text:
To analyze the effectiveness of partition pruning, you can now enable the collection of additional detailed statistical information. When the feature is enabled data can be retrieved from the monitoring view M_TABLE_PRUNING_STATISTICS.
See [System Views for Monitoring Partitions](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/9d829883639d445884cc0d9210f14394.html)
595248982.title: Pruning statistics

595248983.text: Changes and additions have been made to some SAP HDI parameters, for example, batch_size (for the HDI build plug-in com.sap.hana.di.tabledata) and also stop_on_error (true/false), which enables you to ensure that a DI.MAKE run keeps deploying files after encountering an error during deployment.See [SAP HDI Parameters](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/c2cc2e43458d4abda6788049c58143dc/7c989fa6770d46109d37e8ad2a54447a.html?locale=en-US&version=2022_1_QRC)
595248983.title: SAP HDI Administration

595248984.text:
The use of wildcard characters for matching workload classes with the client has now been extended. The wildcard character can now be used on its own without any prefix character so that any value for the property will match successfully.
See the examples in [Properties for Workload Classes and Mappings](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/3ae17c3b1d6c4adea6f0ddfec3041dd4.html)
595248984.title: Workload Class Mappings

595248985.text:
The default value of the admission control CPU queuing parameter (queue_cpu_threshold) has been changed. The parameter was previously set to 0 (and the feature was therefore disabled by default). The new setting of 90% means that the feature is now enabled by default and the workload class will queue new requests if the load on the system reaches 90% of available CPU capacity until the load on the system reduces.
See [Workload Classes and Admission Control](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/72cd0d40bbe04ee0a353a4e622b8d320.html)
595248985.title: Admission Control

595248986.text:
The Plan Stability feature has been introduced to SAP HANA Cloud and can be used to guarantee the consistent optimal performance of select statements by capturing query execution plans so that exactly the same plan can be reused when the query is executed again.
Plan Stability now also includes a test mode which can be used to enable a saved plan for just the current session rather than for the system as a whole.
See [SQL Plan Stability](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/deab4aee414e4b00a3df5666a44adfff.html)
595248986.title: Plan Stability

595248987.text:
It is now possible to import all CSV files in a named directory in a single IMPORT statement.
See [Importing and Exporting Data](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/261937915fa5438ca545b8278b2979b7.html)
595248987.title: CSV Import

595248988.text:
It is now possible to specify a location when you merge partitions.
See [Partitioning Operations](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/c359de53bb571014966699a9229af09d.html)
595248988.title: Merging Partitions

595248989.text:
It is now possible to retrieve details of Alert rules from an SAP HANA Cloud instance by API calls.
See [APIs for Alerts](https://help.sap.com/docs/HANA_CLOUD_DATABASE/f9c5015e72e04fffa14d7d4f7267d897/81d5c960888741cc8875ab225c540f0a.html)
595248989.title: API access
